row.name: 100th Bug Brigade
row.detailed_description: 100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time. Expected playtime: 1 hour. Don't let the Robugs win! Lead the underdog forces of the 100th Bug Brigade and defend your home tree! Though the battle is dire, hope rests with you! Clever tactics utilizing each member's unique active and passive abilities can turn the tide of the war. Possess your enemies, throw your allies, or put your life on the line for an ultimate attack. Use the ability tooltips to exploit every aspect of your team's abilities to overcome the odds. Manipulate the battlefield to your advantage (or the Robugs will!). Dynamic battlefields altered by your actions and the story combined. Retake conquered areas, revealing new bosses and environmental mechanics. But beware! If the Robugs can't chomp on you- they'll chomp on your defenses. Understand the emotions of the 100th Bug Brigade to discover hidden strengths and weaknesses. The Robugs may not have feelings, but your team does. Use clues from their dialogue on the battlefield to uncover strategies against the unfeeling Robugs. But if the Robugs don't feel, what motivates them...? You are not alone! Though you are their leader, the 100th Bug Brigade will serve not just as your soldiers, but also your advisors during battle. New to tactics or roleplaying games? Don't worry. The 100th Bug Brigade, and the development team behind them, have got your back. We designed the game to be accessible to new players, while retaining the depth of strategy that veterans expect.
row.short_description: 100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time.

row.name: Words Guesser
row.detailed_description: Words Guesser is an engaging word puzzle game that brings the thrill of collaborative gameplay directly to your Twitch stream. In this game, you and your viewers work together to uncover hidden words from a jumbled board of letters displayed on your screen. With each round, you'll need to find as many words as possible, relying on your community’s quick thinking and sharp eyes. Each level presents a unique board of scrambled letters, challenging you to discover a majority of the hidden words to advance. The game progressively increases in difficulty by introducing trick letters and mystery letters that only reveal themselves after a certain time or when a player successfully guesses them. While Words Guesser is designed as a single-player experience on Steam, the true magic happens when you involve your Twitch audience. Your viewers become your teammates, helping you navigate through increasingly challenging word puzzles in real-time. Targeting Twitch streamers and fans of collaborative mini-games, Words Guesser is a fun and interactive way to engage your audience while testing your collective word-solving skills. Exclusively available on PC via Steam, the game launches in its complete form, ready to provide hours of word-guessing entertainment for you and your community.
row.short_description: With your Twitch live community, try to guess as many word as possible using the available letters before timer ends !

row.name: Timerift Raiders: The Past Awakens Playtest
Old Timer Transport
row.detailed_description: Mobility scooters, chaos, and laughs—welcome to the wildest ride of your life! Ready to unleash some ridiculous scooter-driven mayhem? Take on the role of an old, grumpy driver in a turbocharged mobility scooter as you race through the city of Bompidorm. Your mission? Pick up humans scattered throughout the madness and deliver them to safety—all while outmaneuvering your equally grumpy rivals. PvP? Oh, you bet. Ragdoll physics? Absolutely. Laughs? Guaranteed. It’s you versus everyone else! Whether you're blasting rivals off the track with a well-timed explosion or speeding toward the hospital, the only thing standing between you and victory is a city full of chaos. Who will be the ultimate grumpy champion? Expect the unexpected —because in this game, anything can (and will) happen. From scooters flipping out of control to pedestrians being hilariously thrown across the map, it's all part of the fun. Embrace the unpredictability, and just go with the flow (or the crash). What's better than causing chaos alone? Causing chaos with friends, of course! Play with your buddies, or make some new enemies—because nothing brings people together like throwing them off their scooters in hilarious fashion. Think you have what it takes to be the ultimate grumpy driver? Grab your scooter, rally your friends, and dive headfirst into the most ridiculous game of your life. The city’s waiting—just don’t crash (too hard). 🚀 'Buckle up, it’s going to be one wild ride!' Get ready to laugh, rage, and everything in between. Join the madness, and remember: scooters aren’t just for getting around—they’re for domination. 🏆
row.short_description: Hop on your turbocharged mobility scooter as a grumpy old driver! Race through Bompidorm with friends, commit vehicular manslaughter, and deliver your victims to the hospital to dodge lawsuits!

row.name: Text Your Life
row.detailed_description: As a fourth-year Law student with a part-time job at the Catal Café, you might as well end up going bald from stress. Fortunately, you can keep in touch with your peculiar group of friends and Daniel, your long-distance boyfriend, through your favorite messaging app (😉). They help you see the fun side of your busy life, as well as keep every hair in its place (or not). Now you've just moved out of home and into your new apartment, and everyone knows that means... party time! Music, alcohol, laughter, kisses... Wait, what?! Kisses?! Your memories are blurry, but somehow you clearly recall the feeling of someone's lips on yours. A warm and pleasant feeling. Hold on!! Pleasant!? 😳 Who did you kiss that night? Will you be able to find out with the help of your girlfriends-turned-detective? How will that kiss affect your relationship with Daniel? And most importantly - how much does a good wig cost 😱? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated. -Play as if it were a real messaging app. Chat, receive and make calls, browse the profiles of your contacts... -Shape the protagonist's personality with every choice you make, as well as her level of affinity with every character. Your personality and your choices will affect the course of the story. -The complete game will have a total of 10 chapters (Common route: chapters 1-4. Specific love interest’s route: chapters 5-10). 7 different routes, and 6 unique love interests. Will you continue your relationship with Daniel, or will you catch feelings for someone else? Surely you won't end up in a love triangle with two best friends, right...? -Only Chapters 1 and 2 are available for now, with more than 73,600 words of content and roughly 644 choices (about 7 hours for playthrough). Make a choice every 20 messages at most! Already finished the available content? Play again and change your choices to experience completely different playthroughs! -This game was originally written in Spanish, and it's been completely translated into English. What are you waiting for? Log in, create your profile, put an inspiring quote that makes no sense as your status, and start chatting right now! ⏳ Why does the game take so much time to load, especially after choosing/changing the language? 👉 On some devices, the Android version of TYL may take a few minutes to load. This happens because the game needs to restart, while also deleting any existing save games in order to prevent it from getting buggy after the language change. We would love to give you a solution to this problem, but we have yet to find one 😞 We recommend giving the game a bit more time and wait a few more minutes, and in case the problem persists, exit the game and leave it running in the background, then return to it, since doing this has worked for some players. 🤔  Can I choose the main character’s gender/pronouns? 👉 We are sorry, but that’s not possible. TYL’s story revolves around a female protagonist, and her gender/pronouns along with some other information about her (such as, for example, her degree or the members of her family) are set from the beginning. Even so, we hope that this does not keep you from enjoying the game and having a fun time with the Supergroup 😊 Thank you for your understanding. ⏩ I’m a fast reader. Can I increase the speed of the messages? 👉  Yes! 🥳 You can do so by adjusting the 'Messages speed' bar on the 'Settings' screen.  Keep in mind that the messages speed plays a big role in the storytelling  (doubting when typing, deleting messages, etc). Speeding up the messages might not let you appreciate those details.  📝 Does my progress automatically save (autosave)? 👉  No, you must save your game manually. You can do this from the game menu (bottom left corner of the screen). Keep this in mind so you don't lose your progress! 😨 Also remember that changing the language will cause all your saved games to be deleted. 📊 Where can I keep track of my personality stats, and my friendship/romance progress with the characters? 👉  You can do so by accessing the “Stats” screen from the game menu. There, you can: ✔️ Keep track of the changes in your friendship/romance levels with every character ❤️ ✔️ See how the choices you’ve made are affecting your personality stats 😎
row.short_description: Who did you kiss that night? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated.

row.name: Valley of Tribes
row.detailed_description: Valley of Tribes is a 1v1v1 strategy game where three tribes battle to be the last tribe standing. Send units and construct buildings to destroy enemy tribes and ensure your tribe's survival. The game consists of a day/night cycle where you plan your actions during the night while nobody can see and then those actions are executed simultaneously once it reaches day. Construct Buildings. Buildings are an essential part of keeping your tribe alive. Construct defensive towers to defend your tribe against enemy attacks, or build resource harvesters to boost your tribe's economy. The more resources you have, the more actions you can take. Send Units. Attacking with units is the only way to win the game. Whether you swarm your enemy with mushrooms or send archers to take the other tribes out from afar, just remember that your enemies could have the same idea. Climb The Ranks. Want to prove your skills? Valley of tribes has a ranked ladder where players gain LP to reach rank milestones and show that they can be the best player in the game. Level Up Your Tribe. As you play games you will gather experience towards the tribe you were playing. Reaching certain levels will give that tribe bonuses to help take out your enemies more swiftly.
row.short_description: Valley of Tribes is a 1v1v1 strategy game where three tribes battle to be the last tribe standing. Send units and construct buildings to destroy enemy tribes and ensure your tribe's survival.

Embark on a thrilling quest to uncover hidden treasures, explore mysterious stages, and piece together a long forgotten past that holds the key to their survival. Along the way, you might discover powerful secrets or unexpected rewards that could turn the tide in your favor. Face off against formidable enemies using a vast array of weapons, each with its own unique critical strikes that can change the course of battle. Strategically wield every idol’s special skills, combining their strengths to outwit enemies and overcome the dangers lurking in the depths. Only by working together and mastering their abilities can they hope to break free from the darkness and return to the sunlight above. Are you ready to guide them to victory and uncover the mysteries of the Abyss? row.name: Reaper Rules
row.detailed_description: Reaper Rules: The Beginning of the Mystery Reaper Rules is a short and straightforward game that blends different gameplay styles to tell a story full of surprises. Face a variety of levels — from 2D platforming to top-down shooting — while exploring an intriguing world filled with memorable characters and hidden details. It’s a compact adventure designed to be played in a single sitting, focusing on pacing, variety, and fun. Features ■ Short story with a touch of mystery ■ Varied gameplay: platforming, top-down shooting, challenges, and high difficulty ■ Pixel art visuals and charismatic characters ■ An experience made with passion The journey leaves a few questions unanswered — it’s up to you to interpret, theorize, and imagine what lies beyond this story. If you enjoy short games with personality and creative gameplay, Reaper Rules is for you.
row.short_description: Mix 2D platforming, action, and mystery in a compact adventure designed to be played in a single sitting. Reaper Rules is short, challenging, and full of personality.

row.name: Across Icaria
row.detailed_description: A boy called Ica decide to visit sea. Born into a military empire, he was tired of war and inventing weapons. After transforming an old gunboat with stolen Flying Wings, Ica began his journey of escape. It is said that 'ships' were originally used for 'navigation', but in this world, the sea has disappeared for half a century. Features Escape from the battlefield by gunboat, cross the Ikaria continent, and enjoy the vast world outside the restricted area. Dispatch cannons, launch missiles, repair engines However, please note that operating the outdated gunboat system requires manual input of commands. Confront all kinds of enemies - with your observation and typing speed! About This mini game started with a gamejam, and with a passion for classic STG, typing games and 90s anime, we boldly attempted this experimental gameplay combination. After multiple rounds of adjustments and polishing, we realized our wish that more people to try this idea, so we decided to release it for free. The game consists of 6 levels and a carefully crafted fantasy story, hoping you will enjoy it.
row.short_description: A boy called Ica decide to visit sea.

row.name: [ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality
row.detailed_description: Step into the eerie world of '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality,' a retro analog horror game that takes you on a spine-chilling journey through a series of events. Each tape you find brings you closer to uncovering a dark secret, but beware—the anomalies are always lurking. Explore: Navigate through 8 main levels, each filled with unique challenges and atmospheric horror. Survive: Use a handheld camera perspective to document your journey and avoid deadly anomalies that stalk you relentlessly. Adapt: Each entity you encounter has unique gameplay mechanics. Learn and adapt quickly to survive the different challenges posed by each entity. Discover: Piece together the story behind the anomalies and your connection to them. Not everything is as it seems. Analyze: Replay the game to uncover subtle clues and hidden details that reveal the truth behind this place. In a world where reality bends and twists, you are thrust into something sinister. As you navigate a series of haunting environments, each more disturbing than the last, document your journey along the way. But be careful—each step forward brings you closer to a terrifying revelation. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you'll find yourself questioning your own sanity. What dark secrets lie beyond the tapes? '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality' invites you to explore, survive, and uncover the truth—if you dare.
row.short_description: Uncover the truth in '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality'. Navigate through haunting levels, survive deadly anomalies with unique mechanics, and piece together a chilling mystery hidden within the tapes. Dare to uncover the secrets?

row.name: Ramhart
row.detailed_description: Ramhart is a small indie game from a single developer with turn-based combat, RPG elements and a story set in the not-too-distant future.  Use the latest implantation technology to develop your character. Immerse yourself in the story of the fighter Ramhart and find out who kidnapped his brother and why, and how the kidnapping is connected to the fateful events unfolding in the world in 2034. 2034: Digital Rubicon In the world of the near future, most creative and intellectual tasks have been transferred to artificial intelligence, many people have been left without work. The main character of the game, Ramhart, is forced to fight in the arena to earn a living. His brother Christian is more fortunate - he is developing new models of Artificial Intelligence. Or rather, he was until recently - Christian disappeared from his home. Ramhart is sure that his brother was kidnapped, and undertakes to find him at all costs. Dance of Steel and Lead The game offers hand-to-hand combat, in which firearms are sometimes used. The battle is carried out in turns, each turn you choose one of the melee attacks or make a shot. Ammo is a scarce commodity, and in a battle of cyborgs reinforced with implants, punches and kicks can be as powerful as firearms. Balancing on the edge of humanity The future has not made people happy, but technology has stepped forward compared to today. In the game, your hero will have access to implantation technologies. Each implant affects 2 characteristics: it increases one, and slightly decreases the other. You will be able to create a unique character build, strengthening it in the chosen directions. Fighters of the new world Not only Ramhart, but also his opponents have access to combat implant technologies. You will face the powerful and unprincipled Abaddon corporation, on whose side not only ordinary mercenaries but also cyborgs fight. In the game, you will find many colorful enemies, both ordinary opponents and bosses.
row.short_description: Ramhart is a small indie game from a single developer with turn-based combat, RPG elements and a story set in the not-too-distant future.

row.name: Heaven's Ladder
row.detailed_description: Prepare for an exhilarating journey in this platforming adventure, where every step is a test of skill and perseverance. Ascend towering platforms, execute breathtaking leaps of faith, and navigate the narrowest of paths with precision. You'll find yourself standing in places you never imagined possible. The game’s realistic physics and unique control mechanics demand patience and mastery, offering a rewarding experience for those who rise to the challenge. Immerse yourself in a world of serene landscapes accompanied by a soothing soundtrack, making each climb both a challenge and a pleasure.
row.short_description: Embark on a challenging platforming adventure where precision, patience, and skill are key to navigating breathtaking landscapes and reaching new heights.

row.name: Proportions
row.detailed_description: Jump into the exciting world of Proportions, a multiplayer game where players have different roles. Some players are Minis who need to complete tasks, while one player is the Giant trying to find and stop them. Use voice chat to talk to your team, but be careful—the Giant can hear you if you’re close! Play as a Mini ! Complete the objectives to defeat the giant. Bite the Giant to free yourself ! Free others from giant's traps ! …or end up in its traps. Play as a Giant ! Catch the Minis ! And trap them !
row.short_description: Jump into the exciting world of Proportions, a multiplayer game where players have different roles. Minis complete tasks while a Giant tries to stop them. Use voice chat to talk to your team, but be careful—the Giant can hear you if you’re close!

row.name: Oneiro Man
row.detailed_description: Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay all night drafting reports to avoid being fired from his job. His boss asks him to draft 8 reports and submit them every hour and a half. Each time Oneiro finishes a report, he will fall asleep and have a dream that he must overcome to avoid getting stuck in the dream world (and completely asleep at work). What you can find: It can last 40 minutes or more, depending on your skill. It has 4 endings that depend on the number of mistakes you make. It has 3 difficulty levels. It has 7 challenges (achievements). It has 7 unique minigames. Custom music for each minigame. It has 3 cinematics.
row.short_description: Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay up all night writing reports to avoid losing his job. The game combines typing mechanics with various mini-games. It’s a 30-40 minute experience with multiple endings depending on your performance.

row.name: Food Rush
row.detailed_description: Food Rush is a Restaurant Sim where the player must battle the ever-rising costs of business. Reach the goal day without going out of business to pass the level. Customize the kitchen and the front of the restaurant to your liking, provide fast service to get high streaks of customers served for extra cash, Hire workers to assist you in running the store from Waiters, Cleaners and Cashiers, and Manage the finances of the rising upkeep of daily costs, food and staff costs. Customize the store Run the kitchen Hire staff Manage Finances Reach high scores
row.short_description: It's time for the Food Rush! Customize your very own restaurant to your liking, provide fast service and get high streaks of customers served for some extra cash! Hire staff to keep your franchise running and manage your ever-increasing upkeep and other financial matters. Oh.. and rush that food!

row.name: Digital Influence
row.detailed_description: In 'Digital Influence,' you're hired in 2010 to create and manage a groundbreaking social media platform. Your decisions will shape its growth, user trust, and societal impact. Key Features: - Daily Choices: Make impactful decisions on features, privacy, monetization, and censorship. - Ethical Dilemmas: Balance user satisfaction, financial success, and ethical integrity. - Real Reactions: See the effects of your choices through dynamic social media feeds, news broadcasts, and financial reports. - Multiple Endings: Discover diverse outcomes based on your management style. Are you ready to leave your mark on the digital world?
row.short_description: You're hired in 2010 to create and manage a groundbreaking social media platform. Your decisions will shape its growth, user trust, and societal impact.

row.name: 피크? 삐끗!(Peak? Slip!)
row.detailed_description: About This Game Peak? Oops! is a unique card game that blends stylish action with rhythm-based gameplay. Unlike traditional turn-based card games, you can actively participate even during your opponent’s turn. Key Features No More Waiting Turns Play rhythm mini-games during your opponent’s turn to gain additional advantages. Rhythm Gameplay Meets Card Strategy Timing and strategy come together for a fresh and engaging experience. Stylish Art and Visual Effects Enjoy flashy effects and a distinctive visual style that makes every battle exciting. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master Accessible gameplay with deep card combinations and strategic choices. Curious about mixing rhythm games with card strategy? Jump into Peak? Oops! and experience a new kind of card battle today.
row.short_description: A stylish card game combined with rhythm-based action. Don’t wait for your turn — stay in the fight at all times.

row.name: The Story Is You - Look Within
row.detailed_description: A place where you can come to relax and reflect. Take a look at over 85 illustrations about life in a beautiful, and at times haunting, real-time 3D environment. A subtle background of 30 ambient songs play to mellow you out and get you into an introspective mood. This is not a FPS nor a Myst-style pixel hunt. Aesthetically pleasing, but it's a very different type of 'game.' Freely fly around a beautiful outdoor castle ruins environment, taking a long look at the emotional imagery and captions. The climax is the ones you'll find high-up in the sky, surrounded by snowy mountains! Also, you'll go inside the castle, through dark, torch-lit passages opening into larger rooms. This experience is designed to draw you in, help you get contemplative, and to see what you see in yourself, reflected by the in-game visuals. You may be moved to make a change or try something new in your life. You are encouraged to give these things some thought, and perhaps journal. Features: - Real-time 3D environment; castle ruins, nature, mountains - Contemplative music selection (toggle enable/disable) plays 30 songs in random order (different every time) - Mouse and keyboard controls, including X and Y axis inversion - Zoom with mouse wheel without quality degradation - 85+ High resolution images with captions on many principles of life, to get you reflective - Free fly camera without collision detection, which allows you to explore at will - Automatically saves your preferences and last position, and picks up next time where you left off There are no puzzles, no enemies to kill, just you and this place. Hope you enjoy!
row.short_description: A freely navigable and open first-person real-time 3D reflective experience. Come see what you see in you. Explore a beautiful and immersive environment that touches on lots of areas of life. See what resonates.

row.name: World of Squares
row.detailed_description: This is the alpha release for World of Squares, a cute social MMO to relax and immerse in. You can pet foxes (and fox-morphed players) with your mouse cursor! Fishing, particle physics, painting, parkour, playing music, cooking, fighting — a plethora of game systems combine together to form limitless possibilities. Add your friends and chat with them online or offline. Emotes let you express yourself to your friends. Hang out together or enjoy each others' presence in an adorable world. Start by choosing your favorite color for your character! On ensuring your enjoyment: - This game exists for your enjoyment and health — a monthly price of a $5 coffee unlocks all content, keeps the servers running, the developer alive, and ensures that the relationship between the game and its players is strictly symbiotic! Game progress, cosmetics, and stash-slots are strictly an in-game fun experience; they cannot be purchased with real world money. - This is a social game. You can still log in, move around the world, and message your friends even if you can't afford membership. Exactly the extent of free-to-play content is to be determined, but that much is the philosophy. - To me, it feels strange to commit time to an MMO if I know my progress is on someone else's server. I promise I will release a playable local version in a timely manner that has all of your progress if the game must go down and stay down (I won't be alive forever, or perhaps the player-base supporting the servers moves on)
row.short_description: A feel-good MMO with rich mechanics. Paint with your friends, play a cube violin in the woods, discover an ancient ruins, fight valiant knights and dangerous mobs, become a fox sacrificing yourself to a dangerous altar at midnight, chill with a fishing rhythm game, upgrade your gear and character.

row.name: Entwined Time
row.detailed_description: A two time manipulation puzzle game. Two robots, Heavy and Light, have their own timelines that can independently record and rewind actions. Solve hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, learning increasingly time-bending mechanics in the process. Background Heavy and Light are maintenance robots working onboard the Chrono Station, a fantastical installation in low orbit that takes time from places where it's not needed and transfers it to where it is. Tragically, the station has suffered from chronic understaffing - so when one day the Chrono Helix catastrophically fails, they're the only robots available to deal with the crisis. Flung to the edge of the Chrono Station, they find that the Chrono Station has been blown into hundreds of puzzles, containing increasingly exotic matter the closer you get to the Reactor Lab - and that their timelines have been isolated from one another. They can now move and rewind independently, and learning every consequence and nuance of this will be necessary to make it back in time and fix things before they get worse. Features A turn based, tile based thinky puzzle game. No dexterity elements or hidden information - Build a mental model of how the game works to succeed. Hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, each one introducing new elements, from being able to break and come back to life to exotic matter that alters the very concept of rewinding itself. Copy, paste and scrub through replays, so you'll never go 'wait, I forgot how I did that' again. Gain Insight mode. Stuck? Check out a puzzle that's an easier or remixed version - you still have to solve it yourself, and you might gain the necessary insight in the process. Advanced and post-game puzzles, for those ready to master space-time itself. A level editor and Community Puzzles tab. Hundreds of custom puzzles made by fans, and if you come up with something I haven't seen before, it can be included in the game!
row.short_description: A two time manipulation puzzle game. Two robots, Heavy and Light, have their own timelines that can independently record and rewind actions. Solve hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, learning increasingly time-bending mechanics in the process.

row.name: Idle Dino
row.detailed_description: Idle Dino is an idle game set in prehistoric times. Collect and grow over 60 species of Dinosaurs and watch as the world refills with life. Use the gold you earn to buy upgrades to make help speed up your journey of repopulating the Earth with Dinosaurs!
row.short_description: Click to grow dinosaurs and earn gold to unlock upgrades that enable you to purchase new dinosaurs and fill out the viewing scene. Explore the viewing scene to play minigames and unlock powers.

row.name: Farming & Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: SEE ALSO About the Game 'This Prologue lets you produce and trade with the limited version of Farming & Supermarket Simulator. Complete your fun Farming & Supermarket experience by adding the full game to your wishlist!' Grow, Harvest, Use Make the best use of your harvested products: either fill the supermarket shelves or use them as feed for your animals. The choice is yours! Feed and Collect Feed your animals and reap the rewards! Feed your chicken a tomato, collect fresh eggs, and enjoy the fruits of your labor. Invest in Machines Expand your production by purchasing machines! Process your harvested goods to produce valuable items for your supermarket. Cashier Quickly scan items, accept payments in cash or credit, and ensure your customers leave happy with their shopping experience! Work Smart Quickly move your product crates to the market, fill the shelves, and meet your customers' demands! Supermarket Expansion Grow your supermarket with the money you earn! More space, more products, and more customers mean more sales. Strategically organize your shelves and highlight popular products. Offer the products you collect to customers in your supermarket. Build a loyal customer base by increasing customer satisfaction. Grow your supermarket by making strategic plans and attract more customers by offering the best service.
row.short_description: Embark on a relaxing yet challenging journey to manage your own supermarket. Grow organic crops, care for your animals, and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you transform your supermarket into an empire?

row.name: Sphere vs Gravity
row.detailed_description: Sphere vs Gravity is a physics-based puzzle platformer that challenges your reflexes skills where you navigate through dynamic, gravity-defying environments. Be prepared—this game is hard and requires time to adapt. Key Features Gravity-Defying Gameplay: Master the art of controlling a sphere as you traverse intricate levels filled with gravitational anomalies. Every surface can be your path if you can defy gravity's pull. Progressive Difficulty: As you advance, the levels become more challenging, introducing new mechanics and obstacles that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. Content You Can Expect: Multiple Levels: Over 25 levels that increase in complexity. Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide to achieve the best times.
row.short_description: Reach the gravity pole and make it fall.

row.name: Summon The DUDES!
row.detailed_description: Summon The DUDES! is a quirky 2D puzzle platformer where your most powerful tool is… the DUDES! Use the ability to Summon The DUDES to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles, you’ll need to think strategically and use summoning of DUDES to clear each level! Features Different levels with its own set of puzzles and platforming challenges! Jump, run, fall and create the environment you need to pass the levels, using your The DUDES! Balance of puzzle-solving and platforming action! Summon The DUDES!
row.short_description: A quirky 2D puzzle platformer where your most powerful tool is… the DUDES!

row.name: The Crimson Call
row.detailed_description: In a world ravaged by decay and despair, where civilization crumbles and hope fades, lies the enigma known only as The Great Apperance. Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind. Story: In the aftermath of an apocalypse that left the world decaying, survivors live in small societies. The Great Appearance, an unknown presence, communicates with some of the survivors through their dreams or in some other way. The Crimson Call follows the journey of Behich and his friend Yerchi, two young pilgrims determined to uncover the truth behind this enigmatic force. As they traverse a landscape of decay and desperation, they will encounter other survivors and learn their stories. Features: A Rich Story Atmospheric Visuals Ambient Music A Few Puzzle Elements One Ending (However, depending on your choices you might get slightly less or more content.)
row.short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind.
row.notes: This game may contain texts describing violence and some other depressing themes.

row.name: Just Squat
row.detailed_description: Let’s defeat the Barbell Boss, which is getting stronger! Get Ready to Squat The boy's fear of squats turned out to be a monster! Face new fears as you grow the boy step by step! Just Squat has 12 distinctive barbells! If the boy sweats hard, no matter how slow it is, the barbell moves toward the end! Experience all kinds of funny and absurd stories that happen at the gym and at school! The gym is always full of the sound of iron and the smell of humid sweat, and the school is always loud with the noise of friends. The boy will react and grow with the people around him according to your choice! In Just Squat, you can meet a total of 30 NPCs in 20 omnibus stories! You can experience all sorts of funny and absurd episodes at the gym and watch how the boy overcomes bullying at school! Game Features! 'Just Squat' is a shmup game that combines an omnibus-style visual novel and bullet hell action. Face the barbell armed with various bullets and attack patterns, and succeed in the squat! You have to lift the barbell all the way up! Enjoy your own story! In 'Just Squat', the story branches out depending on your choices! As the boy grows, new talents will be revealed! Lift the barbell with stronger and more unique abilities! Add your own favorite exercises! The boss's attack pattern will change depending on the exercises you add! Grow a boy by meeting all sorts of weirdos at a sweaty gym! Overcome the absurdity and bullying of bad friends with the boy at school!
row.short_description: Just Squat is a shmup and visual Nobel game that focuses on boss fight by growing up a boy. Grow the boy by encountering various events at the gym and school, and push Babel out with all your might! The difficulty of boss fight and the boy's growth will be determined by the exercise you choose!

row.name: GEO-DEUX
row.detailed_description: “Wake up, wake up! Can you hear me Geo-Duck? The moment of truth has arrived.” You are but a lowly lizard summoned to greatness by celestial voices. Jesus has gone missing and only you can bring him back alive. Lead a band of angels on a quest to find Jesus and save Christmas from hyper-secularization. Dress those angels up in the latest fashions, including but not limited to khakis, polo shirts, dreadlocks, hotpants, mohawks, and many more. Collect many instruments along the way, each with a unique play style, and use them to dissemble inanimate objects through the power of sound. Never forget your cosmic origins! Walk the line between fantasy and reality in a world that really is out to get you. GEO-DEUX is the long-awaited sequel to Geo-Duck, a 2d musical platformer from the pioneering glitch-hop duo Your Infamous Harp. Based to some extent on a true story, and featuring a lovable cast of characters that were personally trained, housed and fed by the developers. “Are you feeling lonely? Are you tired or depressed? Come visit the CLINIC to get rid of your stress!” Pay a visit to the CLINIC to dissolve your ego and resolve your existential angst - forever. Traverse a 6x6 grid of levels encompassing the entire visible universe and beyond. Described as “fun” by one tester, you just won’t not want to play!
row.short_description: Do not forget your cosmic origins! Travel the universe to find Jesus and save Christmas once and for all.

row.name: Invention 6
row.detailed_description: Invention 6 is a 3D first-person shooter with Scrollshooter elements. The events unfold immediately after the end of the previous part of the game. Dorian shot down Casey's plane and took his revenge. It would seem that the main villain is defeated. However, this time the player will have to play as Casey Jefferson herself! The girl survived the plane crash and faced trouble: someone named Frederick captured her company and sent robots to kill her. Having tried to call for help, she managed to contact only her enemy - Dorian, who himself would not mind sending the girl to the depths of hell. So what? Will the former enemies be able to unite and fight the new evil - Frederick? Invention 6 is a 3D shooter with Scrollshooter elements, as well as a small share of logical puzzles that must be solved to complete the level. Learn the story of Casey and Dorian, shoot robots and zombies, and fight powerful bosses to the fiery Heavy Metal.
row.short_description: Invention 6 is a 3D shooter with Scrollshooter elements, as well as a small share of logical puzzles that must be solved to complete the level. Learn the story of Casey and Dorian, shoot robots and zombies, and fight powerful bosses to the fiery Heavy Metal.

row.name: Coming From Above!
row.detailed_description: They're 'Coming From Above!' is a first-person perspective puzzle game. You are playing the arcade game “Coming From Above!' in the arcade game. You control the player and the falling blocks to achieve a high score. 【Play time】 Arcade Mode (Story Mode) 20 ~ 60 minutes ※Excluding EX stage. 【BGM】 You can change the BGM played during the game. Hidden BGM will be released by achieving achievements. 【Rules】 Seven types of blocks fall from the top of the stage. Place the blocks on the stage by manipulating them. The first row of blocks in a row is erased. If two or more rows are erased at once, an item will appear. Keep playing and aim for a high score. Game Over Conditions ・The player falls from the stage. ・The player falls off the stage or touches another block when it appears. List of items ・Super Shock Drop all the floating blocks down until they hit the ground! Also, the dropped blocks don't disappear all at once, but are processed at the same time as the next block falls. Therefore, it is possible to erase four or more rows at once! ・Color Chaser Eliminate the same type of blocks as the falling block. Earn 20 points x the number of blocks eliminated. ・Pay Day Earn 10 points x the number of blocks remaining in the current stage! ・Level Down Decrease the level! Blocks will fall slower. (Current level - 3) * 0.8 Round down to the nearest whole number. ・Hyper Bomb Blasts the 8 surrounding squares that the block touches. Earn 20 points for each block erased. ・Easy Beat Increases the grace period for consecutive block clearing bonus judgment by 2. This effect lasts until the consecutive block clearing bonus ends. ・Jump UP Warps the player to the top. ・Right To Right Move all the blocks to the right. ・Left To Left Move all the blocks to the left. 【Operating Instructions】 ※There is no key configuration function. ※Mouse and keyboard operation only. WASD: Move the Player Space: Jump Q: Rotate Block Left E: Rotate Block Right C: Block Move Left V: Block Move Right Mouse: Move viewpoint Left click: Ground the block instantly Right click: Hold block T: Skip to Next Track 1 or 2: Switch Camera
row.short_description: In an arcade game somewhere. Aim for a high score while stacking blocks falling from the sky and avoid falling off the stage!

row.name: Ocero 3D
row.detailed_description: A free, Sega Saturn-inspired 3D fighting game. Soar through the sky and master your powerful techniques! Take on Kuro in intense battles with fast-paced, but easy-to-learn fighting controls! Master punches and unleash your ultimate attack to win every battle! Originally started as a junior-year college project focused on developing a game engine from scratch, this game is now maintained as a hobby. Stay tuned for updates, likely coming in mid-2025!
row.short_description: A free, Sega Saturn-inspired 3D fighting game. Soar through the sky and master your powerful techniques!

row.name: Call The Abyss
row.detailed_description: You cannot survive the relentless forces of good alone. Better call allies from the Abyss! Gather the necessary ingredients and summon them from your cauldron. Description Call the Abyss is a thrilling 2D survival arcade game packed with action and magic. This unique experience challenges you to push your limits while defending a dark and mysterious world. And the best part? It's completely FREE ! Game Features Survival Mode: Face endless waves of enemies in frantic and strategic combat. Summoning Theme: Developed in three days for Ludum Dare Jam. The theme was Summoning , so the player starts off weak, but don't worry, your summoned allies are the key to victory! Allies: Gather resources and use your magical cauldron to summon powerful allies. Totems: Use totems to boost your team stats while they remain alive. Aim with Your Mouse: Direct all your allies' attacks by aiming with your mouse. Global Leaderboards: Climb to the top of the leaderboard and leave your mark on history. Hand Drawn Style: Enjoy the dark fantasy style with meticulously crafted graphics. 100% Free: Yes, we know, some just do it for the fun. Combat Styles Choose your preferred survival style and adjust your strategy to dominate the battlefield. -------------------------------------------- Melee -------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------- Ranged ------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------- Elite --------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------- Totem -------------------------------------------- Download now and dive into the abyss... if you dare!
row.short_description: 2D Survival Arcade Game packed with Action and Dark Magic. You cannot survive the relentless Forces of Good alone. Better call allies from the Abyss!! Gather Resources and Summon them from your Cauldron. Conquer the worldwide Leaderboard. Completely FREE TO PLAY!! For now...

row.name: Poker Train
row.detailed_description: Poker Train is a western themed casual game that combines VIDEO POKER with incremental stat-building and idle gaming elements. Play scoring hands ( JACKS OR BETTER  and DEUCES WILD ) to keep your steam locomotive moving. Stat Building: Level up and earn special items that provide unique bonuses like Wild Cards and Bonus Draws. Idle Mode: Unlock 35 strategies to set up your train's autopilot. Sit back and relax as your chosen strategy selects the best hands to play for you. Master the art of playing the perfect poker hand! Progressive Progression: Use loot to purchase upgrades to aid you on your journey, and earn poker achievements and stats to track your progress. Prestige System: Allows you to reset your upgrades while keeping your stats and achievements intact, granting you additional consumables for an added edge.
row.short_description: Poker Train is a VIDEO POKER game where you play scoring hands to keep the wheels turning. Use your best combinations to build steam and run the train as far as you can. Complete quests and find all the secrets the railroad has to offer!

row.name: Jenny's Adventures
row.detailed_description: Jenny's Adventure is a 2D platformer where you guide Jenny, a cat, through an interconnected world of biomes. Use abilities like wall jumps and sprints while managing stamina to explore and collect flowers. Focused on platforming and discovery, it offers a relaxing, combat-free experience. Features Exploration: With a heavy emphasis on exploration and discovery, Jenny's Adventures is a metroidvania filled with unlockable abilities and secrets. Find your way to the summit using your curiosity as the guide. It features an interconnected world with different biomes. Uncover a world with areas like forests and beaches. Use your skills to tackle several platforming puzzles to find the path to an area. Jumping: Jenny's Adventures uses a slightly different approach to jumping which is commonly seen in traditional platformers. Player needs to hold the jump button and then release it. If the player releases in a specific window, it results in a 'perfect jump' which increases the jump height. Game also features a stamina system. Some abilities like sprinting consumes stamina which can be refilled by collecting flowers or perfect jumps.
row.short_description: Play as a cat in this 2D world where you discover new abilities and paths to finally reach the summit. What's there? Even I don't know. Yet. Oh, it now has local co-op.

row.name: Hope of Taru
row.detailed_description: You wake up to find your world has changed. Can you remember what happened and find a cure to the curse upon the silent village of Taru? Find the hints to your past and bring back life to your village in this small indie 2D platformer. Enjoy stunning artwork and an original soundtrack while unravelling the story of the petrified villagers of Taru in six increasingly challenging levels. You’re not alone in this. Collect all stone fragments lost in the village and deliver them to priest Yuri high up in the temple to fix what is broken. Can you defeat all dangers and reach him in time for the final ritual? ============================== This game was created as our second family summer holiday project (🏝️😎💻🏖️).
row.short_description: Find the hints to your past and bring back life to your village in this small indie 2D platformer. Enjoy stunning artwork and an original soundtrack while unravelling the story of the mysterious village Taru in six increasingly challenging levels.

row.name: No Vacation for an Executioner Playtest
Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror
row.detailed_description: IT'S NOT A REMASTER. IT'S A RECONSTRUCTION. Step back into the shoes of a tormented detective in Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror , a complete, from-the-ground-up remake of the original mystery. We've thrown out the old blueprints and rebuilt the entire experience in a modern engine to deliver the definitive version of the story. This is not just a coat of paint; it's a new foundation, addressing the feedback and limitations of the original to create the game it was always meant to be. Immerse yourself in a dark, rain-soaked city where every shadow hides a secret and every character has something to lose. A renowned musician has been found dead under murky circumstances. As you delve deeper, you'll uncover a web of lies and despair that threatens to consume you, forcing you to confront not only the city's demons, but your own. A TRUE REMAKE FROM THE GROUND UP Experience the story with the quality and polish it always deserved. We've re-engineered every aspect of the game to create a modern and deeply immersive investigative experience. Rebuilt in a New Engine: Enjoy a stable, polished, and smooth gameplay experience impossible in the original, with faster loading times and modern performance. Completely Revamped Art Direction: We've created a brand-new visual identity to fully immerse you in the game's moody, noir atmosphere. Modernized User Interface: Investigate with ease. A sleek, redesigned UI allows you to navigate your clues, notes, and deductions more intuitively than ever before. Enhanced Sound and Music: Let the unforgettable, melancholic jazz soundtrack envelop you, now with a fully remastered, high-quality score. BECOME THE DETECTIVE Search for Clues: Scour detailed, atmospheric locations for hidden objects and crucial evidence. Every item tells a part of the story. Interrogate Witnesses: Engage in tense conversations where your choices matter. Use empathy, aggression, or direct logic to uncover the truth, but be mindful of the consequences. Solve the Case: Piece together the evidence, challenge your own conclusions, and make the final deduction. Will you bring justice, or will the case remain unsolved? Face Your Inner Demons: The city's darkness is not the only thing you'll be fighting. The detective's past is always lurking, and your psychological state will be tested. WILL YOU UNCOVER THE TRUTH, OR WILL THE DARKNESS CONSUME YOU? The city has secrets, but the greatest mystery might be the one lurking in your own mind. Wishlist Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror and play the free demo to begin your investigation today!
row.short_description: Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror is a noir graphic adventure where your greatest enemy is your own mind. Investigate, interrogate, and survive in this point-and-click remake, rebuilt from the ground up. Play the free demo and wishlist now!
row.notes: "Gloomy Clues" is a narrative mystery and murder adventure, so some of its content may not be appropriate for all audiences. Violence: While the game's aesthetic is anime-style, crime scenes are depicted with the presence of blood. Players will encounter bodies as part of the investigations, but there is no explicit gore or gratuitous graphic violence. The gravity of the acts is conveyed through the atmosphere, dialogues, and clues that are discovered. Sensitive themes: The plot explores the psyche of a detective tormented by his past and the struggle against his own darkness. Themes such as guilt, psychological trauma, and loss are addressed. While there are no explicit depictions of abuse, past events are implied that could be disturbing to some players. Other aspects: The game does not contain nudity, explicit sexual content, or obscene language. The consumption of drugs or alcohol is not encouraged. Age recommendation: Taking the above into account, we recommend "Gloomy Clues" for players over 16 years old.

row.name: Apartment Escape
row.detailed_description: One day, you, suddenly kidnapped, wake up in a quiet apartment... Doors locked with bars and locks, puzzles that look dangerous, apartments with no help... Will you be able to solve all the puzzles and get out safely? This game is a lateral scroll 2d Sirius escape game. Find and use/combine items, and use them in the right place. Use the clues hidden everywhere to solve the puzzle and take a step closer to the truth.
row.short_description: Kidnapped by someone! You have to escape no matter what! This is a lateral scroll 2d escape game. Use/combine items, solve puzzles, and escape. Step towards the truth hidden all over the place.

row.name: Twin It! Virtual Museum
row.detailed_description: Since the 1980s and 1990s, museums, libraries, galleries and archives have been digitising their collections. In the past decade, 3D digitisation has become an increasing part of this activity. The European Union encourages its Member States to 'digitise in 3D, all monuments and sites deemed at risk, 50% of the most physically visited cultural and heritage monuments, buildings and sites, and pay special attention to specific categories of heritage assets with low level of digitisation’ by the year 2030. This is an exciting decade for 3D digitisation! The Twin it! 3D for Europe's culture campaign invited the Ministries of Culture of the 27 EU Member States to submit at least one 3D digitised heritage asset to the common European data space for cultural heritage, stewarded by the Europeana Foundation. This exhibition showcases those assets and explores how 3D digitisation helps us to preserve, explore and enjoy Europe’s cultural heritage. To learn more about these objects and their place in European history, visit Europeana's online exhibition via the website shortcut on the store page.
row.short_description: Stroll through this virtual museum and explore how 3D digitisation helps us to preserve, explore and enjoy Europe’s cultural heritage.

Features A total 40 levels Various gimmicks such as ice, button, anti-apple, turn item, duplicate item, etc. Supports the undo feature 1~4 hours play time

row.name: Mint's Hints
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO THE SET... As the previous showrunner of beloved children’s TV series Mint’s Hints, you never expected to find yourself on set again - especially after the show had been abruptly cancelled. However, you find yourself corrected after being mysteriously abducted. COLLECT HINTS It’s showtime like you’ve never experienced before. Find paw-shaped Hints with special ghost-detecting Flashbrights, and discover the secret behind the show’s closure with your Happy-Go-Lucky Notebook. Journey through the abandoned studio and its dark corridors, but be careful, the stars of the show are after you. EXPLORE, AND RUN...! Get a glimpse behind the scenes and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the Mint’s Hints original set in this thrilling puzzle adventure horror game. KEY FEATURES: Average playtime: 30 minutes Stunning visuals Made in Unreal Engine Unique yet intuitive gameplay Original characters and lore
row.short_description: Mint’s Hints is a cancelled children’s show, and you’ve found yourself on the old set. Find paw-shaped Hints with special ghost-detecting Flashbrights, and discover the secret behind the show’s closure with your Happy-Go-Lucky Notebook, but be careful, the stars of the show are after you.

row.name: Climb Quest
row.detailed_description: Awakened by Death itself, you must ascend through a world shattered into floating islands and fragmented landscapes in Climb Quest . Though you weren't the first choice, you are now the realm's last hope. Your mission is to destroy the Crystal of Chaos—the destructive source tearing the realm apart—and restore peace to the fractured world. Key Features Climb Anything: Navigate a world where every surface is a potential path to victory. Cooperative Play: Team up with friends to conquer challenges and unlock new paths. Precision Platforming: Master challenging jumps and maneuvers as you ascend. Traps: Avoid traps designed to push you back and test your skills. Abilities: As you climb higher you unlock a new ability In this vertical adventure, every step counts. Navigate treacherous environments and master challenging platforming mechanics to uncover the hidden secrets of this shattered realm. Face powerful gusts of wind, collapsing platforms, and a variety of devious traps designed to push you back down. Utilize strategic teleportation runes and collect mystical artifacts that unlock hidden paths, enhancing your journey to stop the chaos. Whether you climb alone or with friends, the fate of countless souls rests on your shoulders. Join the quest, ascend to greatness, and put an end to the destruction before it's too late! Begin your quest, defy the odds and vanquish the chaos!
row.short_description: Climb Quest is a challenging vertical platformer where you navigate through a fragmented world of floating islands and overcoming devious traps. Your goal is to ascend to the top, close the source of destruction solo or with your 3 friends.

row.name: 44 Hidden Naomis
row.detailed_description: Check out our game of origin! If you love adorable Naomi, don't forget to check out our game of origin 'Uberich: Advent Sinners' . They share the same origin and use the same characters. About the Game The Great Naomi Hunt! In the world of simple lines, Naomi is playing hide-and-seek for mysterious reasons. Your keen eye and sharp observation skills will be put to the test as you search for a large amount of unique Naomis, each with their own quirky charm waiting to be uncovered. Game Features: > Multiple beautifully designed levels! > 44 Naomis per level! > Catchy tunes! > Handy hint button! > Intuitive controls! > 71 achievements in the first 2 levels! > Leaderboards! > Inherit DEMO progress! > Inherit DEMO achievements! > Super adorable Naomis! > Wacky Naomi varieties! > Completely hidden Naomis too! row.short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey to discover hidden Naomis scattered throughout meticulously crafted scenes. Can you find them all? This cozy hidden objects game challenges your attention to detail and perceptiveness. Capture the simple fun!

row.name: Super Multitasking GO!
row.detailed_description: How many games can you play at once? Unlock your hidden potential with Super Multitasking GO! It's a special FREE version of Super Duper Multitasking! Using an intuitive control scheme and your amazing gaming skills, you'll soon be playing up to 4 minigames at a time! Discover how far you can go, wow your streaming audience, and compete with players around the world! The screen is split into 4 portions, each controlled by a different part of your gamepad: left stick, right stick, face buttons, and top buttons. You can use your keyboard as well! You'll use these 'mini-screens' to play minigames as they appear and disappear, shuffling in and out. You'll start with just one at a time, but before you know it, you'll be unlocking your hidden talents and playing multiple minigames at once! The Tutorial allows you to learn the basics in just 2 minutes! Then, try the Quickplay mode! It starts off easy and gets tougher as you go. Last as long as possible without making any mistakes! How far can you go? Aim for the top of the Leaderboards! Next, you can take the challenge of Mission Mode's 15 unique scenarios. How many can you clear? If you get stuck, you can adjust the difficulty to make it easier. This infinitely-replayable workout for your brain is full of options and surprises! It's great at parties, for warming up before long gaming sessions, or for pushing yourself to your limits! Your streaming audience will cheer you on and celebrate when you clear tough Missions or set new personal bests! Experience it with your friends for a night of screams, shouts, and cheers! It's wild, unpredictable, and a ton of fun...it's Super Multitasking GO! This unique experience is absolutely FREE! And, if you love it, and want a whole lot more, check out Super Duper Multitasking! Note: Super Multitasking GO! contains a unique subset of Super Duper Multitasking's minigames.  Apart from that, all of the content in this version is contained within Super Duper Multitasking.
row.short_description: Yes, YOU can play up to 4 continuously-shuffling minigames at the same time, using just a split screen and a single controller or keyboard! Super Multitasking GO! offers the tools...but YOU unlock your hidden potential!

row.name: Ace Squared
row.detailed_description: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers and different gamemodes. Key Features MODIFIABLE WORLD - The world is fully modifiable! Build and destroy structures, and build them back again! Dig tunnels behind enemy lines and collapse their bunkers. GAMEMODES - Includes different gamemodes. Fight other team against kills or steal the enemy flag! COMMUNITY SERVERS - Host community servers with your own configuration as you see fit. MODDING SUPPORT - Create your own mods and configure your server! Play Free Experience the classic mode for FREE! Shoot with mortars, set enemies to fire with flamethrower, capture flags by playing as a team. Unlock full game with DLC Join the game in any of the many modes using DLC classes such as «Zombie», «Team Death Match» and «Capture The Flag». We’ve got a hero for every playstyle and skill level: Commando . A towering powerhouse armed with a minigun and a rocket launcher. Perfect for players who enjoy crushing enemies with raw force. Engineer . True to the classics, deploys turrets and soars with a jetpack. Support your team or push forward aggressively. Sniper . Land precise headshots and control key areas of the map from long range. Miner . Carve tunnels, level structures, and tear through opponents with close-range firepower.
row.short_description: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers, different classes and gamemodes.

row.name: Idle Lust - Succubus in Training
row.detailed_description: Sad News! As some of you have already read, we have announced the closure of Idle Lust for early October. We are taking this decision with a sad heart. Yes, the development of the game was bumpy and even if we were hopeful to catch up and iterate often, something prevented its success. Contrary to what some might believe, we have listened to our players throughout the game's lifecycle and we've taken the decision to step back to better move forward. That said, we've taken the decision to 'pivot', and bring back your favorite Succubus in a totally fresh gameplay. We cannot confirm a time frame just yet, but we are hopeful that we can resurge in late December 2025 or early in the new year. In the meantime, we ask that all players spend their stones before the closing date, and stay tuned for more development news. The sad news is for both the Nutaku and Steam versions. Thank you to all the players who have played the game! Evil Twin
row.short_description: Idle Lust is a unique hybrid of clicker, incremental, idle and harem card battle genres all in one! Unlock dungeons, sinful sexy training stations to extract Lust and upgrade, and summon seductive succubus, each with their own back-story and sizzling hot NSFW adults-only lewd art scenes.

row.name: Dino Clicker
row.detailed_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure through time with Dino Clicker, a fun and addictive clicker game where you'll crack open an ancient egg to uncover a vast array of fascinating dinosaurs! With each egg you'll unlock a species, ranging from common favorites to rare and elusive creatures. Will you be able to collect them all? In Dino Clicker, your goal is simple: tap the egg repeatedly to hatch new dinosaurs. The more you click, the higher your chances of unlocking a new species. But beware - some dinosaurs are much rarer than others, requiring luck and perseverance to discover. As you progress, you'll build a collection of prehistoric creatures, each with its unique characteristics. Multiple Dinosaurs: Unlock 9 different dinosaurs, ranging from common to rare species Addictive Gameplay: Simple yet engaging clicker mechanics will keep you coming back for more Randomized Egg Hatching: Each click brings an element of surprise and excitement Casual Fun: Perfect for players looking for a lighthearted, relaxing experience Play Dino Clicker today and start your journey through time to collect all the amazing dinosaurs. Will you be able to crack open the rarest eggs and become the ultimate dinosaur collector? There's only one way to find out!
row.short_description: Tap repeatedly to crack open an ancient egg and collect 9 different dinosaurs, from common to rare and elusive creatures. Try out this addictive clicker game that challenges you to unlock them all through luck and perseverance!

The game's battle scenes are very rich and varied, with different maps such as volcanoes and forests for players to challenge. Players can take advantage of the terrain and power-ups to fight, using a variety of unique weapons and skills to defeat their opponents.

row.name: Hide and Seek with Noah
row.detailed_description: Join Noah and his friends in a playful point and click adventure game of Hide and Seek! The children's game where somethings are never found again. What starts as a joyful game with Noah, quickly spirals into a suspenseful mystery when Noah vanishes without a trace. As officers and family search for him, they soon discover that Noah's disappearance is just the beginning. A series of bizarre and unsettling events unfold as more people go missing. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you'll uncover hidden secrets and eerie clues that reveal a darker side to this seemingly innocent children's game. What is this game? Can you win the game before it’s too late? You wont be able to hide forever... Suspenseful Gameplay: Engage in a game of hide and seek that evolves into a gripping mystery. Eerie Mystery: Experience a captivating storyline filled with suspense and unexpected twists. Family-Friendly Start: Begin with the light-hearted fun of finding Noah and his friends. Challenging Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles and uncover hidden clues to unravel the dark secrets of this twisted game. Atmospheric Environments: Explore beautifully crafted yet increasingly ominous settings that draw you deeper into the mystery. Play the game where children's games are not as they seem and every step, every clue brings you closer to hiding from it or seeking out Noah and the others...

row.detailed_description: ‌《Fortress 2 BLUE（疯狂坦克）》是一款经典的休闲游戏，再现了坦克大战的经典，为玩家带来了全新的对战体验。玩家可以进行单人或多人战斗，根据自己的游戏风格（如擅长防守或输出）选择适合的坦克，通过控制自己的坦克击败敌方坦克来获取游戏的关键节点，团队合作和策略是取胜关键。
row.short_description: 《Fortress 2 BLUE（疯狂坦克）》是一款多人在线休闲竞技游戏。玩家以回合制方式操控各种造型独特的坦克，通过精确计算发射角度、力度和选择不同功能的炮弹，在多样的地形场景中与对手展开激烈对战。可组队配合，发挥不同坦克的特性，策略性十足，充满竞技快感。

row.name: Monkey Tag Arena
row.detailed_description: Monkey Tag Arena - is a fun and adventurous online multiplayer game. The game is very simple and at the same time very interesting. There are 3 game modes: Tag Mode: There are 2 roles, you can play as a hunter or as a runner. If you are a hunter you have to catch all the other runners. If you are a runner, you have to survive without being caught, if you are caught, you become a hunter. The game has 8 great arenas: Aquapark, Spaceship, Magic Forest, Mayhem Castle, Antique Ruins, Pirate Bay, Temple Wilds and Crystal Mine. Each arena has fun challenges and secret hideaways. Monkey Run Mode : The first monkey to reach the finish line is the winner. Open World Mode: This mode allows you to explore all maps and interact with other players. When you create a room, you can share the room name with your friends so they can connect with you and play together. Or you can create a party and join a game with your entire party. You can customise your monkey's skin, texture and outfit. There are lots of clothes and textures to choose from, so don't hesitate to create your own original monkey. Download the game now and start your adventure today!
row.short_description: Hide and run from the hunters, or catch them if you are a hunter. The game has many arenas and 3 modes: - Monkey run mode.- Tag mode.- Open world.

row.name: Ink Inside - First Page
row.detailed_description: Ink Inside: First Page is the fun prologue to the hand drawn action RPG with the heart of a Saturday Morning Cartoon! Created by some of the minds behind Steven Universe: Unleash the Light , Ink Inside lets you play as Stick, an unfinished doodle trapped in a box of notebooks beneath a slowly leaking ceiling. As the water seeps into the notebooks, it warps the drawings inside and turns once friendly doodles into mindless, soggy monsters. You can fight back against the invading “Sog” by hitting them in the face with dodgeball “CORES!” Hold and aim your attack before letting go at just the right time to trigger unique weapon “perks” - then get in close and knock the wet out of them with a melee combo. Use more unique cores and combo attacks in action-packed dodgeball-meets-beat-em-up style combat that will see you dodging patterns of projectiles, using specials, and mastering a unique form of action RPG combat! Get even more buff by collecting new gear, unlocking stronger abilities, and filling your COOL MOVES bar to BREAK THE RULES and deal extra damage by smashing through the invisible wall protecting your enemies. Explore sprawling, gorgeously illustrated worlds, from the Fuzzball Forest to the Cloud Factory to meet and recruit a colorful team of characters to help you on your journey. From the dependable Detective Fuzz to Traff, the Princess of Cursing, who hits like a truck and talks like a truck driver, there’s plenty of characters to meet and loot to discover! Work together with a friend in local CO-OP to save your allies and battle back the waves of wetness corrupting the world! Experience the first few hours of INK INSIDE in this standalone instalment for FREE! And once your journey is going, you can easily transfer your save to the full game to finish your quest! Bear in mind that you'll need a controller in order to play in local multiplayer!
row.short_description: INK INSIDE is a beat-em-up meets dodgeball action RPG featuring the voices of Brian David Gilbert (YouTube, Dropout) and Deneen Melody! (Evangelion, Romantic Killer). Experience the exciting and hilarious prologue with a friend when you play this NEW kind of Saturday morning cartoon together!

row.name: Descenso
row.detailed_description: Descenso is a charming platformer that, while basic and short, delivers an entertaining and rewarding experience. In this adventure, you'll take on the role of a robot, accompanied by your trusty drone assistant, as you explore a mysterious world filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter unique characters and challenges that will test your skills. Though the game is brief in length, every moment is crafted to provide a complete and satisfying experience. Descenso blends classic platforming elements with a simple yet effective narrative that will keep you intrigued until the very end. As this is my first video game, I've poured a lot of effort and passion into its development, and I hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. Descenso is perfect for those seeking a quick but captivating adventure, where every corner hides a new surprise. Embark on this short yet thrilling journey and uncover the secrets that lie within this enigmatic world!
row.short_description: A very short adventure in which you will explore a futuristic world and a handsome deck.

row.name: Restaurant Owner: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner —a Prologue version of the full game, offering a taste of the immersive simulation experience. In this introductory chapter, you'll learn the basics of managing your own restaurant by creating unique burger recipes, unlocking new ingredients, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Key Features: Serve customers, increase your Restaurant Level, and unlock new ingredients to create unique recipes. Create your own recipes, add them to your menu, and set prices. Be creative and use all the ingredients to fulfill your customers' needs and ensure they leave your restaurant happy. Manage the day-to-day operations of your restaurant. Take orders, serve a diverse menu, and ensure that your customers leave satisfied. Are you ready to turn your restaurant dreams into reality? Restaurant Owner: Prologue offers a rich and rewarding gameplay experience for simulation enthusiasts and aspiring restaurateurs, with more to come in the full version. * Note: This is a Prologue version of Restaurant Owner and is still in active development. As such, all images, information, and features described on this store page are subject to change as the game continues to evolve.
row.short_description: Step into the world of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner: Prologue, where you create unique recipes, manage your restaurant, and satisfy customers. Unlock ingredients, design your menu, and start your journey toward becoming a top Restaurant Manager. Your culinary adventure begins here!

row.name: CREAMARE - The Game
row.detailed_description: As part of the CREAMARE project, we're thrilled to unveil 'Creamare: The Game,' a one-of-a-kind serious game that brings Mediterranean underwater archaeological sites to life in stunning 3D. Our seas are the planet's most precious “museums,” preserving a wealth of cultural treasures like shipwrecks and submerged sites. Yet, they face grave threats from human negligence and growing maritime pollution. In CREAMARE: The Game, players take on the role of divers to explore 9 real underwater cultural sites in the Mediterranean Sea. They must defeat a monster from the future by solving ecological challenges and puzzles related to the history of these sites. This first-person adventure game focuses on immersive exploration and engaging puzzle-solving within an interactive narrative. Get ready for an unforgettable journey, coming soon to PCs! Join us in this adventure to raise awareness about the importance of preserving our underwater cultural heritage and ocean health, all while enjoying a thrilling and educational experience. Let's inspire a passion for protecting these invaluable treasures!
row.short_description: In CREAMARE: The Game, players take on the role of divers to explore 9 real underwater cultural sites in the Mediterranean Sea. They must defeat a monster from the future by solving ecological challenges and puzzles related to the history of these sites.

XP improves your level which improves your chances of receiving greater rewards. Features Drops occur every 3 hours. Battle's open every 10 minutes. Levels 1-25, 1 earns basic rewards. 25 has greatest chance of high tier rewards! Sound notifications to let you know when a battle is ready or a new disk has been collected! Achievements! AutoClickers! Trade Disks on the Steam Community Market! Collected disks can be equipped in game as skins! Submit your designs via the Steam Workshop, for the community to vote, approved submissions will be added to the game! Disks received in DropDisk are a Steam Community Market good with value determined by the community.
