row.name: RealmScape
row.detailed_description: Prepare yourself for RealmScape , an immersive escape room adventure like no other. Dive into a world where every room is a puzzle, every clue a key, and every discovery leads you closer to unraveling the mysteries that span across time and space. Traverse from ancient Roman ruins to futuristic spaceships, each brimming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. A Puzzle Adventure Across Time and Space In RealmScape , you'll need to use your wits and keen observation skills to solve cryptic clues, uncover hidden pathways, and unlock the secrets of each unique environment. Collect the Hidden Cubes But that’s not all—each map holds five mysterious cubes, carefully hidden and waiting to be collected. Only by finding all five cubes can you fully unlock the secrets of each realm. Nostalgia with a Modern Twist This game offers more than just puzzles. RealmScape is a nostalgic nod to classic point-and-click games, wrapped in a fresh, modern package. Expect the unexpected as surprises and twists are lurking around every corner. The captivating soundtrack, innovative mechanics, and atmospheric environments combine to create a truly unique indie experience, meticulously crafted by a solo developer with a passion for storytelling and gameplay. Constantly Evolving Gameplay But the journey doesn’t end here. New challenges, phases, and surprises are continuously being added, ensuring that every playthrough offers something new and exciting. Are you ready for an unforgettable journey through time and space, where the past and future collide? Embark on Your Quest Download RealmScape now and embark on a quest to escape the ordinary, unlock hidden secrets, and collect the cubes that hold the key to the ultimate mystery!
row.short_description: RealmScape: Escape room adventure blending ancient mysteries with futuristic puzzles. Solve cryptic clues, race against time, and uncover hidden secrets in this nostalgic point-and-click indie game.

row.name: Blob
row.detailed_description: Can you unlock the secrets of the periodic table and become the ultimate blob chemist? Collect elemental blobs, watch them drop elements from their periodic table rows, and combine them to create powerful compounds that generate Atoms—your clicks per second! With each element you collect and compound you create, you'll get closer to uncovering noble gases and completing your ultimate collection. Will you master the art of chemistry and dominate both the periodic table and the clicker world? Collecting & Periodic Table Discover the Elements: Explore the periodic table by collecting Blobs that represent real chemical elements. Blob Drops: Claim one Blob per hour for each row where you own at least one Blob . Collect elements from the periodic table and use them to expand your collection and power your discoveries! Complete Rows: Unlock all the elements in a row to reveal its noble gas and gain access to the next row of the periodic table. Combine and Experiment: Use the elements you’ve collected to craft compounds , just like a real chemist! Each compound you create not only unlocks new possibilities but also fuels your Atoms (clicks per second) —and that’s where the clicker fun begins! Educational Fun: Learn about the elements and their compounds while having a blob-tastic time. Collect, combine, and explore the world of chemistry like never before! Clicker Fun Atoms = Clicks : Compounds generate 'Atoms'—your clicks per second. The more compounds you create, the faster you earn clicks! Level Up Your Compounds : Use your clicks to upgrade your compounds, boosting your Atom output and accelerating progress. Idle Progression : Whether you’re actively clicking or letting your Blobs do the work, Blob keeps the chemistry flowing. Prepare to be blobbed in this element-filled adventure where science meets fun, and everything blobs with chemistry!
row.short_description: Embark on a chemistry-packed adventure! Collect elements, combine them into compounds, and generate Atoms (clicks per second). Use Atoms to level up compounds, unlocking noble gases and new rows as you build the ultimate periodic table collection!

row.name: Rift of the NecroDancer Level Editor
row.detailed_description: Use your own music to create unique Rhythm Rift stages! Drag and drop monsters, vibe chains and traps while previewing your music and gameplay live in the Rifted level editor. Publish your creation directly to Steam Workshop to share with the Rift of the NecroDancer community! Features: All monsters, traps, food and level design ingredients from Rift of the NecroDancer at your fingertips. Drag and drop, copy paste sections and automatically replace notes with ease. Supports up to 48 subdivisions of each beat. Includes support for Rhythm Rift tracks with varying BPM. Pick a character to bop along to your jams! Create your own album art and background videos to truly make it yours! Please note: This level editor only supports the creation of Rhythm Rift tracks, and not mini games or boss battles.
row.short_description: Use your own music to create unique Rhythm Rift stages! Drag and drop monsters, vibe chains and traps while previewing your music and gameplay live in the Rifted level editor.

row.name: Just War Trains
row.detailed_description: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The game is set on tracks winding through various landscapes, and players must strategically maneuver their trains while aiming to take down their opponent's train. There are four different trains with different types of abilities. The primary objective is to outmaneuver and outgun the opposing train, using a combination of skillful driving and precise shooting. The game is available for free, offering a thrilling experience where only the most skilled conductor will emerge victorious. The game is free to play, making it accessible to a wide audience. With its unique combination of train simulation and tactical shooting, War Trains offers a fresh take on the online shooter genre. Each match is a high-stakes duel where only the most skilled and strategic players will come out on top, turning every encounter into a thrilling battle for supremacy on the rails. Are you in a fight with a former opponent? Was somebody being toxic and calling you bad? 1v1 them in War Trains and settle the debate. War Trains takes skill, only the best come out on top every time.
row.short_description: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The objective is to outgun the opposing train with precise shooting. You can play with up to 24 people in WAR TRAINS!

row.name: Touch Type Tale - Strategic Typing Playtest
GHUNTER
row.detailed_description: Become Ghunter , a gnome chef that will create dishes by cooking creatures... ALIVE!! Use your various cooking based weapons to cook your prey alive and brutally finish them off with your multi-purpose melee weapon! Ghunter has the responsability to save the King by providing dishes to his servants and other characters to heal him. FEATURES Unlike other games, GHUNTER fuses the process of hunting and cooking in one. Use your multiple culinary-inspired equipment to create different delicious dishes! The game provides with an interesting and intricate narrative driven by charismatic characters with a dynamic narrative system where your dialogue choices matter. Unveil the mysteries of Gernik by finding lore inside the adventure. By finding different items in the adventure and completing customer orders, you will have the ability to upgrade Ghunter's equipment. GHUNTER's tavern is equipped with a order board where he will be able to pick up dishes to the player's choosing. Once completed, you will submit it to gain satisfaction of said customer. Despite looking so colourful and pretty, the world of Gernik is more unsettling than it meets the eye. Both the narrative and the cooking have a dark side. Unveil the secrets of the world. Discover portals, landmarks, statues, chests and much more! Check all your progress and unlocks in the adventure book. Here you can see the world map, lore entries, creature descriptions, recipes and more. More about this game Game developped as a final project of the Art, Design and Programming masters of the U-tad university of Madrid, Spain. This project mixed all 3 of those departments with the help of other masters such as concept art, 3D modelers, animators and rigging.
row.short_description: Become Ghunter, a cook gnome that will create dishes by cooking creatures... ALIVE!! Use your various cooking based weapons to cook your prey alive and brutally finish them off with your multi-purpose melee weapon! Save the Kingdom by submitting your delicious dishes!
row.notes: The game offers a gory combat when finishing off a creature.

row.name: Winter Games Collection
row.detailed_description: Get ready for endless winter fun with a fantastic collection of arcade-inspired games!   Dive into a frosty world packed with snow-filled challenges and chilly adventures designed to bring warmth and excitement to your cold winter days. From snowball battles to icy races, there’s something for everyone to enjoy solo or with family and friends.   Take on the leaderboard to see who can claim the highest score by challenging your friends in the multiplayer mode — up to 8 players can join by simply passing around one controller. With a delightful mix of arcade-inspired games like Tetrice , Polar Cross , Frostbreaker , and Winter Match 3 , this collection offers countless hours of fun.   WINTER WONDERLAND BY TRAIN – Hop on a magical train ride that takes you through snowy landscapes, stopping at every station for a new game.   WINTER-THEMED GAME MODES – From high-speed bobsled relays to precision snowball throws, each game captures the festive spirit of the winter season.   ADORABLE CHARACTERS – Choose from 8 unique, winter-loving characters to add personality to every game.   MULTIPLAYER FUN FOR ALL – Play alone or with up to 8 players by passing a single controller — challenge your friends and set the highest scores!   Games Included: Bobsleigh Relay Chilly Slices Snowball Blast Tetrice Arctic Circle Skater Frostbreaker Snowdrift Racers Winterpong And many more!
row.short_description: Get ready for endless winter fun with a fantastic collection of arcade-inspired games!

START WASHING! Easy and intuitive mechanics -Jump to the action straight away-  Wash cars with various colored soaps.. Feast for the eyes! Collect cards and welcome new customers! From small sedans to large SUVs and even trucks, wash a wide range of cars and earn money for each one you clean. Trust or Trouble? Some customers might seem harmless... but don’t be fooled, each one could be hiding something. Think twice before handing over the keys: Trust can lead to profit, or to trouble. row.name: Terror On The Bayou
row.detailed_description: Terror on the Bayou is a 3rd person (1st-person in VR), exploration horror game where the player must navigate their canoe through a tangled swamp full of hazards and traps, stalked by a mysterious apex predator. Alone and afraid, the players will question if they are merely prey, or if the thing after them enjoys the torture of its victims. Whether they wish to rise to the challenge or row away in fear, they have no choice. They must take up the mantle of lighthouse-keeper and ensure the warning beacon continues to sway those away from the terrors they face. Gameplay features: Players navigate using movement controls that mimic the paddling of a real canoe! As your character gets used to it, so do you! But be careful- the water is anything but still, and mistakes can be deadly. Manage your health and stamina wisely. Make your way through a painterly, immersive landscape filled with unsettling occurrences, dangerous terrain that can be hard to navigate or slow you down, and the threat of becoming lost. Peer behind you to scan for threats, and use your compass to navigate to the lighthouse. Lore bottles are scattered throughout the 3 levels, which a particularly daring player may collect in their journal to uncover the stories of those that have lived here. Headphones are recommended for a more immersive soundscape, but not required. VR mode is available in the settings menu! Accessibility features: Audiovisual accessibility features include multiple contextual audio sliders, closed captions. No cue is delivered through sound or color alone. Cognitive and motor accessibility features include custom key-binds for keyboard and controller, adjustable controller rumble, adjustable monster difficulty, and a toggleable UI bar that tracks the monster's aggression. The menu is always available and pauses gameplay. Content warnings: Mentions/depictions of violence and death, visible blood and gore, and mentions/depictions of suicide . Made by University of Utah's Entertainment Arts and Engineering students, Class of 2024
row.short_description: Terror on the Bayou is a 3rd person, exploration horror game where you must navigate your canoe through a hostile bog, alone and afraid. Will you take up the mantle of lighthouse keeper to keep the bayou safe, or will you become prey along the way?
row.notes: Mentions/depictions of violence and death, visible blood and gore, and mentions/depictions of suicide.

row.short_description: 《洪荒西行录》是以暗黑西游为题材的动作角色扮演游戏。猴哥挥棒斗神魔，逆命战洪荒。爽快的游戏体验带你探寻暗黑神话的真相！

row.name: I Am Legion: Stand Survivors Playtest
Cats of the Song Dynasty
row.detailed_description: **Search for adorable cats in the fantastical world imagined by a painter from the Southern Song Dynasty over 800 years ago!** The game is set against the backdrop of Zhao Boju's 'Xianshan Louge Tu' from the Southern Song Dynasty, featuring 100 meticulously illustrated cats that create interesting interactions with the ancient scenes and characters. Zhao Boju's 'Xianshan Louge Tu' from the Southern Song Dynasty is a remarkable masterpiece. It is a hanging scroll, painted on silk, measuring 159.9×84.2 cm, and is currently housed in the National Palace Museum in Taipei. This painting not only showcases Zhao Boju's superb artistic skill and unique style but also contains profound cultural and literary significance, revealing a fantastical, fairy-tale-like world. ----- Game Features ----- - Relax and enjoy ancient art while playing - Over a hundred uniquely styled 'cats' - Comfortable and relaxing ancient music - Adorable cat sound effects - 100 meticulously crafted achievement icons ----- Game Operation Tips ----- - Click on the cover logo to view the high-definition original 'Xianshan Louge Tu' - The ESC key can hide or show buttons in the game - Click the hint button to quickly locate a cat in the scene; can be used once every 60 seconds ------------------------**
row.short_description: Search for adorable cats in the fantastical world imagined by a painter from the Southern Song Dynasty over 800 years ago!

row.name: Mind Weaver
row.detailed_description: You wake up as a mage, trapped deep within a goblin-infested dungeon. Fortunately, your trusty butterfly companion manages to set you free. Now, it's up to your imagination and your ability to control minds to find your way out! Get ready for a classic 2D puzzle platformer adventure with a twist—Mind Weaver lets you shift control between different characters. But there’s a catch: you can only manipulate the minds of creatures you can see, so make your decisions wisely. Each level presents its own unique challenges, from puzzle-solving and tricky parkour to dodging aggressive goblins. Along the way, you’ll encounter the quirky merchant who’ll do just about anything for a juicy PAPAYA. This is a solo project, so while there's no game-saving feature just yet (sorry!), I’m eager to see if others find the game as fun and intriguing as I do. If you are game dev and desire to contribute, please do! The code is open source (you can find it on github).
row.short_description: Mind Weaver is a 2D puzzle platformer built around line-of-sight control. Crack the puzzles, outsmart the goblins, ace some parkour, and don't forget... PAPAYA!

row.name: Project Shoreline
row.detailed_description: Explore a corrupted beach. Play as a Muri, a fish-mouse creature, and platform your way atop the pillar, run in the grass with pixies, venture to the beach, explore the cave, make your way high atop the mountain, and finally reach the cliff outlook by the beach in your explorations of Shoreline. Cleanse the world of corruption. Use your trusty watergun to bring back the beach's beauty. Utilize your watergun in different ways to get rid of corruption, by using the wide spray or the pressure aim. Aiming can be used to clean, push, or break things while the wide spray is excellent for efficiently cleaning your close surroundings. Make sure also to give the cute little pixie creatures a wash as well, it makes them very happy! Restore the colorful beach's beauty! As you clean the world you will see the color return to the once very grey beach in a highly satisfying way. When you have cleared the pillar, the shell, or the pond, its whole surrounding area is restored and a lily pad will emerge to help create your path to the cliff outlook. Now, get to work fellow Muri! Also, did we mention there are cute critters? *̥ ˚✧
row.short_description: Step into the tiny metaphorical shoes of a Muri, entrusted with the important task of exploring, cleaning, and restoring a corrupted and decaying beach, one sparkling satisfying patch at a time, in this cute cozy mini-adventure - Project Shoreline!

row.name: The Chess
row.detailed_description: THE CHESS Themed Chess: Relaxing Minimalistic Strategy Game Themed Chess offers a relaxing and minimalist approach to the classic chess game. With multiple gameplay options, beautiful themed boards, and a variety of chess pieces, it's perfect for casual players and strategy lovers alike. Whether you prefer to play against AI or challenge other players, this game offers endless enjoyment with many customization options. Key Features: ♔ Free to Play – Start playing now, no cost involved! ♕ Relaxing Minimalistic Style – A calm and peaceful design for an immersive chess experience. ♖ Multiple Chess Boards & Piece Sets – Enjoy a variety of beautiful, themed sets and boards with even more coming soon via DLCs. ♗ AI with 3 Difficulty Levels – Challenge yourself with varying AI difficulties, suitable for both beginners and advanced players. ♘ Play Against Other Players – Compete in multiplayer mode with friends or players worldwide. ♙ 3D Gameplay & Clear 2D Mini Board – Switch between a dynamic 3D view or a simplified 2D board for a more focused experience. ♙ Chess History & Rules – Learn the game’s history and rules in the integrated section for both new players and chess enthusiasts. ♙ RPG DLC & More – Enjoy exciting DLC content, including RPG-themed chess sets and more on the way! Themed Chess is perfect for chess lovers who appreciate a relaxing, customizable experience with lots of options to explore. Download the base game for FREE today and immerse yourself in a calm, strategic world of chess! CALL TO ACTION: ⭐ Add Themed Chess to your Wishlist now to stay updated on future DLCs and releases! 👍 Follow the game for news and updates! 💬 Leave a Comments  and share your thoughts to help us improve!
row.short_description: The ChessThemed Chess offers a relaxing, minimalist chess experience with multiple boards, piece sets, AI opponents, and multiplayer. Play in 3D or 2D, learn the game’s history, and explore RPG-themed DLC. Free to Play – Download now and enjoy endless strategy!

row.name: The Viewer's Game
row.detailed_description: All the features added to this game are suggestions and comments made in the comment section of Flizz's YouTube channel, in this game, you play as Bob, each run you get to choose a class for Bob, and based on that you can unlock Common and Unique Subclasses that give Bob unique abilities to help him beat all his enemies! Be ready for a bunch of enemies and broken (But hopefully fun) Mechanics!
row.short_description: Defeat HUGE waves of enemies as Bob, The Viewer's Game is a very satisfying but hectic game where you can Shoot, Burn, and smash into hundreds of enemies and bosses! Each run you get to choose a Class for Bob and discover what each subclass and unlockable weapon does!

row.name: Bits at Work
row.detailed_description: Bits at Work is a small office management game set in the world of Bit ESC. Create, manage and expand your office, make sure your bits are happy, and keep the line going up and up and up. CREATE YOUR DREAM WORKPLACE Layout your office however you like. Build, expand and keep adding new facilities for your employees. MANAGE YOUR BITS Employees are the lifeblood of a company. Manage your team and make sure they're happy RAKE IN THE PROFITS The line must keep going up and up and up.
row.short_description: Build the perfect workplace in this tiny office management sim and keep the lines going up and up and up!

row.name: 四叶草咖啡厅
row.detailed_description: 白天这里是宁静的咖啡厅，只有稀稀拉拉的客人与店里养的一直肥猫，但到了夜晚，这里就变成了热闹非凡的小酒馆，虽然有点阴间，毕竟客人没一个正常人，全是妖魔鬼怪。 在现代的这个社会，一些传统妖怪适应了现在的社会环境，既然他们都聚集在这里了，不妨问问他们都是怎么做的吧！ 当然 ，白天的客人虽然稀少，但每个人都有着属于自己的故事，通过和他们聊天来感受一下阳间的气息吧！ 故事的主线就是在这个地方与客人们聊天，所以可以说是没有主线（确信），相对应的有着海量的支线，所以支线就是主线！ 因为不太会画画，所以从cg到立绘还有行走图可能都比较粗糙和丑陋，地图也很小，不过里面的东西我还是尽量做的丰富一点。 因为不太会程序，所以游戏本身机制简单，基本上只用点点点就行了，不过还是有些地方可以互动的。 因为是弱智，所以剧情上可能让您感到难受或者不解，我表示非常抱歉，但是也没办法了，我尽力了，实在不爽就骂我吧。 希望大家还是抱着一个休闲和快乐的心态来看这个小故事，同时也希望您能从我的游戏中收获快乐，如果玩的开心请给我一个好评吧，我会开心一整天的，给我差评的话我也只有躲在墙角画圈圈了。 本游戏主旨绿色健康阳光积极向上充满正能量，无不良导向。
row.short_description: 本游戏主旨绿色健康阳光积极向上充满正能量，无不良导向。

row.name: Narrow Woods Hotel
row.detailed_description: A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The bad feelings started to seep in as soon as you passed the front desk. The hallways are unnaturally dark and you swear they grow more narrow with each step you take. The hotel creaks as if its corridors contorted ever so slowly, trying to crush you in its innards before you get the chance to notice. In this 'found-footage' horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel. Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out. But be careful, as the dreaded feeling of being alone might actually be a comforting thought. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- How to play: General: -Use the mouse to interact with the environment and navigate through the hotel -'Left click' to interact/move (used for various things) -'TAB' to open inventory -Hold left mouse button to skip cutscenes In inventory: -Hover over items for description -'Left click' item to take out of inventory With item held: -'Left click' to use on objects -'Right click' to put held item back into inventor --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The game takes about 40-60 minutes to beat on the first playthrough. WARNING: Contains stylized depictions of blood/violence --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Known issues / troubleshooting: If windows defender blocks the game from running, click 'more info' and select 'run anyway'. This happens because the game is from an 'unknown publisher'. If you're using Wave Link, and the game crashes after the splash screen (probably caused by the rerouting of the audio) go to your Windows sound settings, set your default output to 'Wave Link System' and then assign the game's output to 'Wave Link System' aswell. If you can't change the audio back to 'system audio', rename the narrowwoodshotel.exe to anything you like, then start the game again. For problems with other audio rerouting programs, a similar solution might apply.
row.short_description: A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre! In this 'found-footage' horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel. Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out.
row.notes: Contains retro-stylized scenes of corpses and violence against supernatural entities.

row.name: Cursed Loop
row.detailed_description: After a night filled with nightmares, you find yourself in an unfamiliar mansion. All you know is that you must escape... But this place is no ordinary building; it’s a labyrinth filled with dark forces that are constantly trying to catch you. In every corner, in every room, dark memories from your past come to life, and every death pulls you back into the same nightmare. The only way out of these dark rooms is to unravel the mystery of the ghost that haunts you and avoid the deadly traps. But remember, every mistake will send you back to the beginning, and each attempt at escape will become even more difficult. Deep within the mansion, you must use all your courage and wits to uncover the truth and break the endless cycle. This game offers a dark psychological survival horror experience, where you will walk the fine line between reality and dream, plunging into the depths of fear with an atmosphere that keeps you on edge at every moment. Masterfully created with the latest technology, be ready to confront your fears in this immersive world. The Critical Importance of Traps In this mansion, every step you take can turn into a trap. Filled with hidden mechanisms, invisible wires, and unexpected dangers, this labyrinth is designed to send you back to the beginning with even the slightest mistake. Each trap is meticulously crafted to stop you and diminish your chances of escaping this horrific cycle. Therefore, you must think twice before taking each step and carefully inspect every corner; survival depends on your ability to outsmart these deadly traps. The Sense of Discovery As you progress through this dark mansion, each new room and corridor holds the thrill of uncovering the unknown. Every corner, every door could lead you to a vital clue or a dangerous trap. This journey of discovery is both intriguing and unsettling, allowing you to deeply feel the tension between fear and curiosity with each step. Gather your courage and keep exploring this place filled with dark secrets, as there are mysteries waiting to be unveiled. Dark Atmosphere and Tension This mansion is enveloped in a suffocating dark atmosphere. With almost no light, the feeling that something is lurking in the shadows constantly builds up. The sounds and moving shadows heighten the tension, making your heart race. In such an environment, predicting what awaits you becomes challenging, and every step is accompanied by an increasing sense of dread. To survive in this terrifying place, sharp senses and calmness are essential.
row.short_description: Trapped in a nightmare, every death pulls you back into the same dark cycle. Test your spirit and courage as you escape the depths of a sinister mansion.
row.notes: Disturbing sounds, horror elements, and tension in the dark atmosphere

row.name: Plants Huddled Together
row.detailed_description: **Game Features** - 12 exquisite plant illustration levels - Adjustable puzzle difficulty - Immersive puzzle experience - Relaxing background music **Game Controls** - Left mouse button: Hold to move the puzzle piece - Right mouse button: Click to rotate the puzzle piece - R key: Rotate the held puzzle piece - Q key: Toggle the game UI - In settings: Toggle the grid lines for the level background - In settings: Toggle the hint function ---
row.short_description: An interesting irregular puzzle game featuring beautiful plant illustrations. Come and relax with this game!

row.name: Tale Smiths
row.detailed_description: Discover the rich cultural heritage of Northern Europe in Tale Smiths , a narrative-driven adventure that blends immersive storytelling with literary tourism. Step into tales shaped by the traditions, poetry, music, and folklore of Finland, Sweden, Norway, Ireland, and the Faroe Islands. Every story is crafted in collaboration with local experts, ensuring an authentic connection to each region’s culture. Explore beautifully recreated 3D environments built with photogrammetry and drone imaging, meet lifelike characters brought to life with motion capture, and interact with the world through innovative camera-based motion controls. Whether wandering through legendary landscapes, listening to traditional songs, or uncovering hidden literary gems, Tale Smiths offers an engaging journey where culture and technology meet. Key Features Cultural Storytelling : Play through interactive stories inspired by local literature and folklore. Authentic Heritage : Experience poetry, songs, music, and traditions seamlessly woven into gameplay. Realistic Worlds : Explore detailed 3D environments based on authentic landscapes. Immersive Technology : Control characters with your movements using camera-based motion tracking. Literary Tourism Reimagined : Travel across five regions through the power of stories. Tale Smiths is both a game and a cultural journey — an interactive story collection that invites players to experience the living literature of Northern Europe.
row.short_description: Tale Smiths invites players to explore the literature, folklore, and traditions of Northern Europe. Journey through authentic 3D worlds, meet lifelike characters, and engage with stories using camera-based motion controls.

row.name: We are Blob
row.detailed_description: Welcome to We are Blob , a point-and-click game that follows a game developing blobfish as they try to complete making a game in a week, while balancing their personal life. As Blob you will work on tasks for your new job, go on dates, see your mom, and hang out with your friends. All of this while maintaining your health, stress, and hunger. Features: -Cute and Colorful 2D Art -Quirky and Full Narrative -Cozy and Head Bopping Music Quote: 'All work and no play makes Blob a dead Blob' - Final Boss, 2024
row.short_description: Hello! Hey! Yeah, you! The one behind the computer! Welcome to We are Blob, a chill and cozy point-and-click game that follows our main hero...BLOB! Help Blob navigate their new job as a game developer while trying not to get fired. You only have ONE week to finish this game so...no pressure!

row.name: Pocket Garden
row.detailed_description: Pocket Garden is a super cute little indie game where you can build the coziest gardens and have the best time ever! No worries about resources, fighting, or health.  BUILD WHAT YOU WANT, HOW YOU WANT, AND WHEN YOU WANT  Get ready to build your dream sweet garden! You'll have dozens of prepared elements, decorations, fences, and accessories to choose from. Let your imagination run wild as you create a garden oasis!  DON'T WORRY ABOUT RESOURCES  You don't have to worry about currency or resources. In Pocket Garden, the economy is all about your creativity. So, unleash it and build the cutest little garden you can think of!  SIT BACK, RELAX AND UNWIND!  We didn't want to create another competitive game. We just want to give you a tool to create something cool! The rest is up to you, dear player!  Kacper & Marcin  ~ Developers of Pocket Garden
row.short_description: Pocket Garden is a super cute little indie game where you can build the coziest gardens and have the best time ever! No worries about resources, fighting, or health. Just sit back, relax, and enjoy!

row.name: Guns, Blocks, and Steel
row.detailed_description: Guns, Blocks, and Steel is a FPS game with a completely dynamic environment . Build defenses , or, more importantly, destroy your enemy's defenses . Mold the terrain to your advantage with the Rocket Launcher . Resources Mine iron to refine and produce steel , which can be used to build vehicles and ammo . Ammo is limited , so be careful not to waste it. Some more advanced weapons of war may require gold , which is a more contentious resource than iron. Instead of boringly digging out each ore block one by one , like some other games, you must blow it up with dynamite . Or just throw the dynamite at the enemy. Whatever you want. Play as you want Your playstyle is your choice . You can stay behind at your base, manage your team's resources and construct weapons of war. Or you can try to gather resources and bring them back to your base. Or you can assault your enemy's base. Or you can do all three . There are no classes to railroad you into a certain role. Fun over competition Most multiplayer games nowadays try to get you addicted by making the game hyper-competitive , which fosters a toxic community. This is not what Guns, Blocks, and Steel does. The game aims to put fun over competition. Winning or losing doesn't matter as long as you had a good time . Your win/loss ratio is not tracked, there is no history of past games played, there are no rankings, and you cannot see the kills and deaths of other players. Game modes Warfare - Deplete your enemy's personnel and eliminate them all to win. Capture The Flag - Capture your enemy's flag and bring it back to your base to win. 100 Kills - First team to 100 kills wins. Assault - Co-op game mode where your goal is to defeat all enemies at their base. Invasion - Co-op game mode where you must defend your base from attacking enemies. Space Race - The first team to build a rocket wins. Weapons Shovel - Very short range Pistol - Short range Assault rifle - Medium range Rocket launcher - Long range Sniper rifle - Really long range Dynamite - Mostly used for mining, but can also be a weapon Vehicles ATV - Useful for getting around fast Humvee - Troop transport Tank - It's tanky Attack Helicopter - Get to the choppa Maps Procedurally generated maps Handcrafted maps Small 256x256 maps Large 512x512 maps Day/night cycle Buildings Blast furnace - Used to refine iron into steel Factory - Used to build ammo and vehicles Barracks - Generates personnel for your team as long as it's not destroyed Loudspeaker - Give orders to bots
row.short_description: A tactical multiplayer FPS created by a solo developer as a passion project. Featuring a fully destructible, block-based environment. Gather resources to produce weapons, ammo, and vehicles. Play multiplayer PVP/co-op or singleplayer with bots.
row.notes: Contains cartoony blood and gore.

row.name: Harmagedon
row.detailed_description: As a representative of the gods, the player embarks on a journey to reclaim the power by fighting against beings that run wild with the power of the gods. A soul-like game where you defeat enemies using parrying, rolling, and guarding. You can play the Harmagedon game tutorial part, which consists of one monster and one boss. [Upcoming features and content] Additional regular monsters and boss monsters Various types of armor Level-up system Weapons other than swords and shields (magic, greatswords, bows, etc.)
row.short_description: The player, as God's agent, takes the power of God and embarks on a journey to reclaim his power against beings who run wild at will.

row.name: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me
row.detailed_description: The Game VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is a spine-chilling, atmospheric horror game that takes players on a disturbing journey over the course of five harrowing days. Set in a remote house where the lines between reality and nightmare blur, this game plunges you into a world of eerie visuals and psychological terror. You play as a lone protagonist who returns home to what should be a peaceful, solitary life. But as the days progress, strange and unexplainable events begin to unfold. It starts subtly—a bizarre TV broadcast showing something it shouldn’t, dreams that feel too real, and objects in your home that move on their own. Each night brings a new nightmare, each day a deeper descent into madness. On the first night, a seemingly innocent episode of a TV show turns into something horrifying , sparking a chain of increasingly disturbing events. As the days go by, your sense of reality unravels. The protagonist’s dreams become darker, haunted by visions of ominous forests, unsettling mazes, and cryptic symbols. His waking life isn’t safe either—he encounters strange noises, glimpses of a creature lurking in the shadows, and even a haunting memory from his childhood that he thought was long buried. Aesthetic The game’s VHS-inspired aesthetic enhances the sense of disorientation, with visuals that flicker and distort as the protagonist’s mental state deteriorates. As you piece together the mystery. Features VHS Style Chat with Npc's Dark Atmosphere In Short VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is more than just a game it’s an experience that will linger in your mind long after you’ve finished playing. Can you survive the nightmare, or will you succumb to the madness?
row.short_description: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is a short horror game where reality blurs with nightmares over five eerie days. Experience strange events, unsettling dreams, and unravel a chilling mystery in a remote house. Can you survive the madness, or will the nightmare consume you?

row.name: Zenith Realms
row.detailed_description: Zenith Realms is a 3D top-down cozy adventure puzzle game where Ninami embarks on an emotional journey across the fractured realms of a splintering planet. Can you help Ninami and find the way home before time runs out? DISCOVER A SPLITTING WORLD In a world that is undergoing a planetary mitosis after duplicating everything on its surface, a war had struck between the two sides and led to the death of all but one: Ninami Travel the tranquil yet divided landscapes of the Zenith Realms on a quest to get Ninami back home. FACE CHALLENGES Overcome adversaries by chasing the mischievous Raven who stole the gem that powers Ninami's Home portal, and learn about their shared troubled past.  UNRAVEL MYSTERIES By solving intriguing environmental puzzles, you learn more about the planetary split and explore three beautiful levels full of pre-war history, friendly creatures, and a dark secret past.
row.short_description: Guide Ninami on a heartfelt journey through the realms of a fractured planet. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the truth of a shattering past with a mysterious raven.

row.name: Doll Catching Simulator
row.detailed_description: This is a 2D cute-style claw machine simulator, bringing you a comfortable claw machine experience. In this claw machine world, there are as many as 41 dolls with different styles and charming cuteness. Moreover, each doll is equipped with its own dedicated claw machine, allowing you to fully experience the exclusive fun of grasping. It is worth mentioning that each doll has been carefully set with 5 quality levels. The higher the quality of the doll, the lower the probability of grasping it, which undoubtedly adds more challenges and thrills to the game. In terms of control, I have simulated the changes in the strength and speed of the real claws, requiring you to consider the angle and timing when operating, just like thinking carefully in front of a real claw machine. And those cute dolls, every detail of them has been carefully crafted, as if they were truly alive. Even more interestingly, there is a cute younger sister in the game to help you hold the dolls. This considerate setting greatly enhances the immersion of the game. It seems that you are not playing alone but have a close partner sharing the happy moments of catching dolls with you. In addition, the game also provides a display cabinet. Here, you can proudly display the dolls you caught with great effort, admire their cute looks, and relive the tension and joy during the grasping. We sincerely expect you to step into this wonderful game world, enjoy the pleasure of playing heartily, and leave your beautiful memories of catching dolls!
row.short_description: In the busy life, do you long to experience the fun of catching dolls but are limited by time and space? Now, the doll catching simulator brings you a brand-new entertainment experience!

row.name: HexenHold
row.detailed_description: HexenHold is a combination of a tower defense and a 2D platformer where you play as a newly summoned minion of an “evil” necromancer that begrudgingly needs some help in fending off an invading force of skeletons and ghosts. Frantically run up and down dungeons to strategically place towers bought with the gems dropped by defeated enemies. If there aren’t enough towers to get the job done, pick up and throw the enemies to get yourself involved in the action! Prove your loyalty and defend your necromancer boss like your life depends on it! You may even get a promotion after all is said and done. 4 unique towers to defend with. Throwable enemies to bash against walls. 3 original dungeons to defend. Optional Endless mode for those wanting to test their strategic prowess. A Necromancer that won't shut up (unless you want them to). This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Protect your Boss, a necromancer, from waves of incoming enemies in the deepest of dungeons. Buy Towers. Upgrade your abilities. Throw your enemies. Do whatever you can to keep the ritual going!

row.name: Drive Thru Miami Prologue
row.detailed_description: Main Game About the Game Drive Thru Prologue is a drive thru experience game. Its prologue version of drive thru game which represents main concepts of drive thru game. Game Concept: A simulation of running and expanding a drive-thru shop where players take orders, prepare various beverages and foods, manage supplies, and serve customers efficiently. Gameplay Elements: 1. Order Taking: - Receive and input customer orders for both beverages and foods. 2. Preparation: - Choose the correct cup size and shape for beverages. - Prepare food items as requested. 3. Customization: - Customize your shop's brand name. 4. Payment System: - Process payments using cash, credit cards, or mobile payments. - Input amounts, provide correct change, and complete transactions accurately. 5. Supply Management: - Monitor inventory and restock supplies to keep the shop well-stocked. 6. Growth and Expansion: - Improve and expand the shop by upgrading equipment, adding new menu items, and opening new locations. - Invest profits wisely to enhance the shop's reputation and attract more customers. Objective: Efficiently manage and grow the drive-thru, accurately fulfill orders, maintain adequate supplies, and build a positive reputation for your shop. This game offers a dynamic and realistic experience of operating and expanding a drive-thru, managing a wide range of beverages and foods, handling diverse payment transactions, and ensuring a steady supply of goods.
row.short_description: A simulation of running and expanding a drive-thru shop where players take orders, prepare various beverages and foods, manage supplies, and serve customers efficiently.

row.name: グレゴリーホラーショー ソウルオブローゼス Playtest
The Dangerous Back-to-School Season
row.detailed_description: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season In this RPG, you’ll guide the protagonist, who has just received a university acceptance letter, through a series of cybersecurity challenges. On their journey to enroll, they’ll face threats like phishing attacks, ransomware, password breaches, and cyberbullying. By making the right dialogue choices and completing various mini-games, you will help the protagonist recognize and overcome these threats, ensuring a safe and successful university enrollment. Key Features: Pixel art style inspired by the real world Unique focus on cybersecurity Multiple outcomes unlocked through dialogue and choices Levels themed around common cybersecurity threats, including phishing, ransomware, password attacks, and cyberbullying Mini-games blending puzzle-solving and strategy This game is perfect for teens and adults interested in cybersecurity and is a great way to raise awareness about online threats.
row.short_description: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season is a pixel RPG where players guide the protagonist through cybersecurity threats . Using dialogue choices and mini-games, players must help the protagonist make the right decisions to ensure a safe enrollment.

row.name: 时空三分之三 Tritime Space Playtest
Infinity Nikki
row.detailed_description: In this game, Nikki and Momo embark on a new adventure, traveling across the fantastic nations of Miraland, each with its own unique culture and environment. Players will encounter many characters and whimsical creatures while collecting stunning outfits of various styles. Some of these outfits possess magical abilities essential for progressing through the story. Bright and fantasy-filled open world The world of Infinity Nikki offers a refreshing escape from traditional apocalyptic landscapes. It's bright, whimsical, and filled with magical creatures. Wander through this wonderful land and explore the beauty and charm around every corner. Exceptional clothing design and dress-up experience Express your style with an extensive collection of beautifully designed outfits, some of which even grant unique abilities. From floating and purifying to gliding and shrinking, these outfits unlock exciting new ways to explore the world and overcome challenges. Each outfit enriches your journey, letting you mix and match for the perfect look. Platforming with endless fun In this vast, fantastic world, master skills like floating, running, and plunging to freely explore the land and tackle intricately designed puzzles and challenges. The joy of 3D platforming is seamlessly integrated into the game's open-world exploration. Each scene is vibrant and charming—from soaring paper cranes, speeding wine cellar carts, mysterious ghost trains—so many hidden secrets await discovery! Cozy sim activities and casual fun Relax with activities like fishing, bug catching, or grooming animals. Everything Nikki collects on her journey helps craft new outfits. Whether you're in a meadow or by a river, there's a great chance that you'll encounter enchanting creatures that bring a sense of peace and immersion. Diverse puzzles and mini-games Infinity Nikki is filled with activities that challenge both wit and skill. Traverse scenic paths, enjoy a hot air balloon ride, complete platforming puzzles, or even play a hopscotch mini-game. These elements add variety and depth, ensuring every moment remains fresh and engaging. Thank you for your interest in Infinity Nikki. We look forward to meeting you in Miraland!
row.short_description: Embark on a cozy open-world adventure filled with vast landscape, mystical puzzles and unexpected platforming challenges. Dress up not just for style, but to unravel hidden mysteries, interact with a vibrant environment, and experience the freedom to explore at your own pace.
row.reviews: “Always something new and either cute or bizarrely dark to discover” 9/10 – IGN “A true step forward for open-world gacha games” 4/5 – Eurogamer “The ultimate dress up game, and it’s only going to get bigger from here” 90/100 – GamingTrend

row.name: Sarpedon
row.detailed_description: You have arrived at Sarpedon, a surreal island at the edge of the known world. Armed only with a bag, a sword, and your wits, you must continue your task as given: REACH THE ISLAND SLAY THE BEAST RETURN WITH HER HEAD While the island may be cloaked in an isolating fog, you certainly aren't alone. The colorful cast of characters scattered around the island anticipate your arrival, some more anxiously than others. What will they be to you, friend or foe? What will you be to them? Explore the island, discover its inhabitants, and craft your story in Sarpedon, a solo dev's love letter to his favorite myth. Featuring A hand-crafted, open-world island environment to explore Unique interactions with 5+ mythical characters Over 400+ lines of handwritten dialogue Replayable mini-games Discussion of grief, remorse, and the ways in which we cope KNOWN (RARE) ISSUE FOR OLD MACHINES: If you open the game and hear sounds, but only see a black screen, that's an issue with the MSAA settings on your computer, and not fixable on my end. I apologize for the inconvenience. If you want to play, follow the instructions outlined in THIS GITHUB THREAD: to turn your 'Antialiasing - Mode' setting in the NVidia control panel from 'Override any application setting' to 'Application controlled'.
row.short_description: Explore an island at the edge of the world, converse with Greek Gods and Goddesses, and confront monstrosity in this modern reimagining of a classic myth.
row.notes: SENSITIVE CONTENT WARNING This game contains... - Non-gory depiction of decapitation - Allusions to suicide by drowning - Allusions to accidental death by drowning - Pixelated historical artwork which may include nudity

row.name: Bureau of Contacts: Mansion
row.detailed_description: View full game page About the Game 'Bureau of Contacts: Mansion' is a limited free version of the 'Bureau of Contacts' full game, in which you can try the game loop of a full-fledged game based on one of its locations - an old mansion haunted by a ghost. As an agent of the Bureau, you will have to: RESEARCH Use the basic toolkit to search for clues and identify the mansion's ghost. COLLECT DOSSIERS Interact with the ghost in voice or by chat to obtain its personal data necessary for the exorcism ritual. EXORCISE Follow the instructions in the Journal and correctly perform the exorcism procedure to fully complete your mission. SURVIVE Observe and use the features of the ghosts to stay alive as long as possible and have time to do as much as possible for your Bureau. GO TO THE NEXT LEVEL Think you're ready to go to the next level? 'Bureau of Contacts' - more locations, tools and ghosts, co-op mode, and generative AI built into enemies that makes the game even more realistic and unpredictable.
row.short_description: Explore an old mansion full of paranormal dangers alone. Find clues, identify ghosts, collect their dossiers and exorcise them.
row.notes: This is a horror game. It contains elements of fear, tension, fantasy violence and horror.

row.name: PLEASE SAY HI
row.detailed_description: You wake up, get dressed, shower, down your morning cup of coffee in two scalding gulps, and button on your coat. With that, you are off to catch the bus to work at your monotonous job. You arrive and sit at your desk, hammering away at your keyboard in hour after hour of forced solitude. It is nearly the end of the year, and you can't help but think to yourself that there must be more to life than this. 'It's a bit of a 'walking simulator' but it's a quick little game that is really better described as an 'experience' than a game, and deals with some pretty heavy subject matter for how simplistic it is.'
row.short_description: a short but incredibly touching experience.

row.name: Sime Is Back 3D Old School
row.detailed_description: Sime Is Back 3D Old School is a retro-inspired action-platformer set against the picturesque backdrop of the Adriatic coast. Step into the worn-out boots of Sime, an old fisherman with a heart of gold, but one surprising flaw: he doesn't know how to swim! Sime's simple life takes a turn for the worse when the greedy villagers, who only pretended to care about him, imprison his beloved cats after he decides to stop giving them free fish. Now, Sime must embark on a daring adventure to rescue his feline friends and take back what's his! Armed with nothing but his fish, Sime turns the tables on his captors in the most hilarious way possible. Using fish as his melee weapon, he slaps enemies out of his way, smashes through obstacles, and clears paths as he navigates the treacherous landscape. Along the way, you'll guide Sime through a variety of challenging platforms, avoid tricky traps, and outsmart the cunning villagers who stand between him and his beloved cats. Key Features -Old-School Charm: Experience the nostalgia of classic platformers with modern 3D visuals, bringing the best of both worlds together. -Fish-Slapping Combat: Wield Sime's signature weapon—a fish!—to slap enemies and break through obstacles with satisfying, old-school brawling action. -Classic Platforming: Jump, dodge, and weave through a colorful 3D world filled with quirky obstacles and hidden secrets. -Rescue Mission: Save Sime's cats from the clutches of the greedy villagers, each cat more adorable and eager to reunite with their owner. -Whimsical Storyline: Enjoy a heartwarming yet comedic narrative about friendship, betrayal, and the lengths one man will go to for his cats.
row.short_description: Sime Is Back 3D Old School is a retro-inspired action-platformer set on the Adriatic coast. Play as Sime, an old fisherman with a heart of gold but no swimming skills, as he uses a fish to hilariously battle through obstacles, rescue his cats, and outwit greedy villagers.

row.name: BECOME THE DEVIL
row.detailed_description: Become the Devil is a horror game that features combat, escape, stealth, and bomb planting systems. The game also incorporates deep life philosophies within its storyline. Synopsis Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a large resort. Along the way, locals warn them not to get involved with the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, the area has been plagued by numerous strange events, with many people mysteriously disappearing. The locals suspect that something sinister must be happening at the resort, but no one dares to investigate. As a result, the town is nearly deserted, becoming almost like a ghost town. Key Features Combat, bomb planting, escaping, and stealth systems VHS film aesthetic Receive texts from NPCs Player voice activity
row.short_description: Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a resort. Along the way, locals warn them to stay away from the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, strange incidents have frequently occurred. The locals suspect something terrifying must be lurking in the resort
row.notes: The game features some mild gore and occasional strong language, making up about 20% of the overall experience. The primary focus of the game is on storytelling, evasion, and stealth.

row.name: Prince Rystiya's Starship
row.detailed_description: Prince Rystiya's Starship is a simple 2D space shooter. It's a student project made by a student from SMU Guildhall. The rebels claimed that they fought for freedom and democracy, yet they built a totalitarian regime instead. As a heroic imperial fighter pilot, you will eliminate waves of rebel scum and hunt down their leader. Your ship is highly advanced. It has multiple weapons, and its shield can endure extreme damage. However, you must keep a close eye on your energy bar. Your shield, weapons, and engines all consume energy. Without energy, you would be extremely vulnerable.  > 10 waves of enemies. > Manage the energy supply on your fighter. > 3 intense boss fights. > Free to play. Ship control: -Press WASD to move (costs a small amount of energy). (Move the left joystick on the controller) -Press/hold J to fire the shotgun. It's short-range and inaccurate but has a very low energy cost. (Press the X button on the controller) -Press/hold K to fire the default gun, the most versatile and useful weapon. (Hold the A button or press the left joystick on the controller) -Press/hold L to fire overcharge. It's long-range and accurate, but it has a long reload time and high energy cost. (Press the B button on the controller) -Press I to fire anti-matter missiles (one use per life). Use A and D to control the missile, and press I again to detonate. (Press the Y button on the controller) -Press Q to toggle the shield (it takes energy to maintain the shield and absorb damage with it). (Press the top-left button or left trigger on the controller) -Press E to toggle turbo boost (greater thrust, greater energy consumption). (Press the start button on the Xbox controller) -Press Space to repair (very energy inefficient). (Press the top-right button or right trigger on the controller) -Press Tab to toggle minimap, aim-assistance, and pause state text. Game control: -Press U to spawn one more asteroid. -Press P to pause/unpause. -Hold T to enter slow mode. -Press O to run a single frame then pause. -Press F8 to reset the game. -Press +/- to cheat (increase/decrease remaining lives). -Press enter to cheat (clear all enemies on the map). -Press ESC to return to the main menu or quit. (Press the start button on the Xbox controller) -Press the space to enter the game from the main menu. (Press the back button on the Xbox controller)
row.short_description: The rebels claimed that they fought for freedom and democracy, yet they built a totalitarian regime instead. As a heroic imperial fighter pilot, you will eliminate waves of rebel scum and hunt down their leader.

row.name: Anime Clicker
row.detailed_description: About the Game Anime Clicker is a Cookie clicker Idle Game, in which you click Anime girls! Get a random anime girl every 3 hours and grow your collection! Features: Anime Girls Pretty backgrounds Items to grow your collection 3 hour drop pool chances*: 58% Normal 34% Common 8% Rare 0.005% Ultra Rare 0.001% Legendary * Subject to change
row.short_description: Anime Clicker is a Cookie clicker Idle Game, in which you click Anime girls! Get a random anime girl item every 3 hours and grow your collection!

row.name: "Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift" Pre-Alpha
row.detailed_description: Story In 2040, reality as we know it undergoes profound changes. In a world where parallel dimensions have become part of everyday life, you are a brave explorer tasked with uncovering the mysteries of these enigmatic worlds. Working for a global research laboratory founded in the 1990s, your mission is to collect and decipher mysterious recordings on tapes scattered across various parallel worlds. Each tape not only brings monetary rewards but also a deeper understanding of the hidden layers of existence. To successfully complete your missions, you must also use special devices to measure the parameters of different worlds — temperature, radiation levels, air quality, and electromagnetic fields (EMF). These indicators will help you better understand which parallel world you have encountered and how safe it is for your stay. But be cautious — further immersion into these alternate realities may lead to unforeseen events that could change the course of your mission and the fate of humanity. Gameplay Elements Collecting Tapes: While exploring parallel worlds, you will find tapes containing encrypted data, holding crucial information about each dimension. Your task is to decode these recordings and extract valuable knowledge. Using Devices: You are equipped with tools to measure temperature, radiation, air purity, and EMF. Each of these parameters provides insight into how habitable or dangerous the current world is and helps in identifying its nature. Managing Needs: To survive, you must monitor your character’s basic needs: hunger, thirst, health, and time. To maintain your well-being, you can purchase food, water, and other resources using the money you earn. Analyzing Parallel Worlds: Your success in the game depends on how accurately you can determine which world you are dealing with based on data from the devices. Correct identifications earn you rewards, while mistakes can lead to resource loss. Dangers of Alternate Realities: Some worlds can be extremely hazardous, and staying in them without proper preparation can have severe consequences for your character. You must always be ready to avoid fatal errors.
row.short_description: Is an immersive adventure that challenges you to explore unknown dimensions, solve intricate puzzles, and make choices that impact the unfolding mystery. Dive into the unknown, uncover hidden secrets, and prepare for an experience that could change everything you thought you knew.
row.notes: This game contains adult content that may not be suitable for all players. Please review the description below to better understand what to expect: Violence and Gore: The game includes scenes of violence that may feature bloodshed, physical injuries, and killings. There are also frightening and psychologically intense scenes that may induce anxiety and discomfort. Substance Use: The game depicts scenes involving alcohol and drug use. Additionally, there are moments related to the misuse of medical substances. Language: The game features moderate coarse language and occasional profanity, which may not be suitable for sensitive players. We recommend carefully reviewing this content description before deciding to purchase the game.

row.name: Avakin Life
row.detailed_description: Start a life without limits in Avakin Life now!  Discover unlimited ways to be you. Enter a virtual world of endless opportunities, a wardrobe packed with the latest fashion, your dream home in every location imaginable, and new adventures, parties and events happening every day!    This is YOUR life as you want to live it. A world where self-expression is boundless. A virtual universe connecting people from everywhere around the world.     Features   Create an avatar as unique as YOU   Decide how to represent yourself. A reflection of reality or your wildest dreams?  Customise your look with thousands of hairstyles, make-up, and facial features.  Express your personality with animations. Walk like a zombie or strut like a model - you decide.    Define your style Stay ahead of trends with weekly fashion drops.  Whatever your aesthetic, whatever the occasion, create a look that suits you with 30k+ fashion items. Make a statement with head-turning accessories from cute hats to beautiful wings.  Transform your ideas into wearable designs with our Fashion AI Design Tool.     Build your dream home From tropical islands to city penthouses, the home of your dreams is waiting to be discovered. Scandi chic or vamp lair? Decorate to your tastes with themed furniture collections.  Create a home for your pet whether it’s a cute corgi or fierce dragon?  Host parties with all your friends or create the perfect night in. Your place, your rules!    Meet new friends & Join the community   Whether you’d rather go on a cottagecore picnic or spend Saturday night at the rock club, hang out and chat with new friends in hundreds of amazing locations.   Find your virtual family and make lasting friendships in our welcoming community. Participate together in weekly events and collect unique rewards.  Attend parties, live music, and club events every night.  Create videos and photos and share your creativity with other Avakins.    Begin your adventure Explore with no limits. Travel to outer space, road trip across the USA or relax in the Amazon rainforest. Live your roleplay life in epic locations with endless costume and animation options.  Get involved in gripping stories. Join the community to unpack mysteries and complete quests for unique rewards.  Unlimited ways to be you! This is Avakin Life. Who will you be today?
row.short_description: Avakin Life is an endless social world waiting for you. Live your dream life, from unique and customizable avatars to stylish fashion outfits and personalized dream homes. Hang out with friends, join parties, and embark on adventures in a world where you are in control of everything.

row.name: Prince Rystiya's Starfleet
row.detailed_description: Prince Rystiya's Starfleet is a free 2D space RTS. It's a student project made by a student from SMU Guildhall. Commander, the Lizardfolk Empire is pushing forward, and our new Lizardfolk followers are under threat. The Rystaurian Church shall not abandon its believers, no matter their past or status. However, our Lizardfolk followers are outnumbered and outgunned, and no other militaries can provide help. You are our only hope, commander. --Prince Rystiya's Starfleet has 4 game modes, including a galactic conquest mode (inspired by classics like Total Wars and Star Wars: Empire at War) and a skirmish mode (inspired by classics like Command and Conquer and Homeworld). If you just want a quick match, then challenge levels and custom mode are made for you. --There are more than 15 units, each having unique strengths and weaknesses. This game is optimized to support 1000+ units fighting on the screen at the same time. --The game's combat system is inspired by real-world naval combat. There's no armor type. Instead, each unit has an armor value. Low-damage projectiles will struggle to overcome the target's armor, while most high-damage projectiles can be intercepted by rapid-fire weapons.
row.short_description: Conquer the entire galaxy or fight quick custom battles in this free space RTS!

row.name: Fairealm
row.detailed_description: Explore the Forbidden Lands, a remote area of the Fairealm that no Fairie dares to go. Follow the protagonists, a band of Tumpirates that unexpectedly crashed their flying pirate ship while trying to escape royal authorities. Enjoy a story rich in lore and content! Immerse yourself in an old-school RPG Game with a turn-based battle system! 5+ hours of classic fun if you explore every corner of the land seeking treasure! Key Features Engaging Story Character Name Change Upgradable Spells Accelerated Leveling Unique Weapons, Armors, and Items that pertain to the story.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in an engaging story that is rich in content and escape into Fairealm, a turn-based RPG game with 5+ hours of gameplay powered by RPG Maker MZ. Follow relatable characters as they use a variety of learned spells to defeat monsters and explore the Forbidden Lands!

row.name: VolleySmash
row.detailed_description: VolleySmash is a fast-paced 3D volleyball game that delivers intense and fun matches for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a looking for casual gaming or competitive, playing alone or with friends. VolleySmash was designed with two main goals in mind, simple and fun! Features -Fast-paced 3D volleyball action -Single-player / Local multiplayer for up to 6 players -Easy-to-learn controls -Focus on strategy and teamwork VolleySmash was developed by a solo developer under 4 months
row.short_description: Fast-paced 3D volleyball game, perfect for casual gamers, competitive players, and volleyball fans

row.name: Frontier: Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Play Frontier for Free Today! Frontier is a classic battle royale where you can play solo or with friends, fill your game with bots, and choose between Classic Royale or the respawn-friendly Respawn Royale mode. No matter which one you pick, the goal is simple—be the last one alive! Loot a variety of weapons, stay inside the zone, and fight your way to victory. Matches last 6-9 minutes , with continuous lobbies so you can keep playing with minimal wait. You can also use the in-game text chat to talk with friends or other players. Earn XP by getting kills and placing highly to level up and unlock new heroes . Heroes don't grant any competitive advantage—they are simply cosmetic and cool to have! Reach level 50 to unlock this season’s ultimate hero!  With challenging bots, cartoony graphics, and competitive gameplay , Frontier is perfect for casual games or even tournaments, which are hosted by the Frontier Discord community. Play today—100% free!
row.short_description: Frontier is a classic battle royale game where you fight to be the last one alive. Play with friends, randoms, or bots as you explore a stylized map, loot up weapons, and rack up eliminations. Unlock skins as you level up—no microtransactions, just pure gameplay!

row.name: Fomon
row.detailed_description: A very minimalistic TCG auto-battler featuring creatures called Fomons. Grow your collection: Find a new Fomon every hours. NOT DURING DEMO PLAY   Find the perfect specimen: Each Fomon comes with a Tier and unique attributes. Choose a Fomon from your collection and let it fight for you. Compete with others climbing the Leaderboards. Forge duplicate Fomon into stronger Tiers. Note: Some mentioned features are still roadmap material.
row.short_description: A very minimalistic TCG card battler featuring creatures called Fomons. Grow your collection and discover a new unique Fomon every hour NOT DURING DEMO PLAY! Each Fomon comes with a tier and has its own attributes. Compete with others climbing the leaderboard.

row.name: Arcade Reflex
row.detailed_description: Arcade Reflex takes the essence of classic arcade games and gives it a modern twist. You control a paddle, navigating through fast-paced levels where the gameplay keeps evolving. It starts off simple, but the challenges quickly ramp up, so you’ll need sharp reflexes. The minimalist design nods to retro games, but there’s more depth here than meets the eye. Perfect for quick sessions, Arcade Reflex offers a fresh take on the arcade formula. Ready to see how far you can climb on the leaderboards?
row.short_description: Arcade Reflex blends classic arcade feel and modern twists. Control a paddle through fast-paced, evolving levels that start simple but quickly ramp up, testing your reflexes. With minimalist retro-inspired design and surprising depth, it's perfect for quick sessions. Ready to climb the leaderboards?

row.name: Super Orbital Mega Drift II
row.detailed_description: The classic shoot 'em up franchise expands ! Fight your way through 5 levels of deadly ships and bosses to get your revenge on the Empire. Colorful pixel art and catchy soundtrack, easy controls but hard game overall, SOMD2 makes use of all of the tropes of the arcade genre. The game features 4 achievements, an in game leaderboard that displays the 5 best speedrunners worldwide, and 3 characters to best suit your skill level. As a one person team, I'd love your feedback here on Steam or on the Discord. Come say hi !
row.short_description: Defeat the Empire a second time in this short electro-jazz space shooter. Beat up bosses and upgrade your ship as you go deeper into the belly of the beast.

row.name: Toriki: The Castaway Island
row.detailed_description: This application is a digital companion for the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game where players try to survive on a deserted island by exploring various locations, obtaining resources, discovering new species and crafting new items. You need the board game to be able to use this app. The game is a digital hybrid mixing physical components with the app. The players move their meeples around the map and scan QR codes printed on cards to perform actions. The app provides narration and describes the results of the players’ actions, as well as playing background sounds. The game is played as a single continuous adventure that takes about 6–8 hours to complete, though you can pause and save it at any time.
row.short_description: A companion app necessary for playing the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game of adventure, exploration and survival mixing an app with physical components.

row.name: Piworld
row.detailed_description: --- What should you expect from this game . All you have at the beginning is nothing . That becomes the main goal of surviving in Piworld, which is to get everything. Spending time in this game, a person can be fully confident that the time spent will not be in vain. Even without looking at a complete map update, the character's progress will be preserved. This is what makes the game unique. The most expensive, the most valuable, the most - the most - presumably the coolest thing you can boast in this game - yourself! Yes, to improve your character, in this game is allocated a whole story. Upgrade absolutely every skill from weapon damage to sowing crops. Alchemy, sorcery, and other mystical elements will be added to the game as the ‘story’ develops. Have you seen a multiplayer survival game anywhere, and even in pixel style? We haven't either. So, inspired by some similar games (yes, we know we are similar to a few of them), we have created a new story where we invite absolutely everyone to try a new style of survival in a 2D world. Forgotten territories, powerful bosses, battles with players, clans, houses, equipment upgrades, wings - all this and more will be waiting for you in the game. Give us just a little bit of time and we will surprise you. We read absolutely every feedback and listen to it. The balance of weapons, armor, territories, mobs - all of this happens at the development stage! We spend a lot of time on this so that in the future, 1 skeleton can destroy half of the clan. Ha ha ha. Guilds and groups. This system is familiar to you from other co-operative and multiplayer games, because it is not always very interesting to play alone. You can add a friend directly in the game, and being on the same server, you can easily see where your friend is. Cooking food has never been so interesting! Frying a piece of meat, it will give maximum characteristics only in the first 10 minutes after cooking. So what, cooled meat is also edible, but not as tasty. Offerings to statues and 12 ghosts. This will be available inside the game. Improve your home, modernize your buildings, upgrade the interior of your habitat, and get the most out of this game. Home defense is also present!
row.short_description: Piworld is a unique multiplayer game where everyone can find something to do to suit their desires. Try out different roles: from a simple fisherman to an adventurer. Explore the world alone or with friends, fight evil, develop your skills, and create your own story.

row.name: Dichotomy
row.detailed_description: Achtung: Dieses Spiel ist aktuell nur auf Deutsch verfügbar! Attention: This game is currently only available in German! Geschichte Frankreich im Jahr 2234. Die Human Rescue Organisation festigt ihren Einfluss im Land täglich. Die meisten Menschen haben sich längst mit der totalen Überwachung und den Computerchips in ihren Köpfen abgefunden. Sie genießen die Bequemlichkeiten, die daraus resultieren können. Doch das bedeutet auch, dass es Ausnahmen geben muss. Die Glühwürmchen sind Terroristen in den Augen der H.R.O. und der Regierung. Sie sabotieren den Konzern täglich aufs Neue, hacken ihre Server, leaken geheime Dokumente und haben sich geschworen, nicht aufzuhören, bis die H.R.O. vollständig zerstört ist. Victorique ist eines dieser Glühwürmchen. Seit sie sich erinnern kann, kämpft sie gegen die Wahnvorstellungen und Stimmen, die ihr Gehirn ihr als Realität aufdrängt. Dadurch zieht sie sich immer weiter zurück und lebt zunehmend als Außenseiterin. Trotz allem arbeitet sie gemeinsam mit ihrer besten Freundin Zoé an der Verwirklichung ihres größten Plans. Wird es ihnen möglich sein, die gesamte Bevölkerung zu retten und die H.R.O. aus den Köpfen der Menschen zu verbannen? Eine interaktive Geschichte über ein 13-jähriges französisches Mädchen, das in den Fesseln ihrer eigenen Welt gefangen ist und verzweifelt nach einem Ausweg sucht. Merkmale eine Visual Novel trifft auf ein Adventure je nach Entdeckerdrang bis zu vier Stunden Spielzeit ein ausführliches Kompendium mit Lore des Forgotten Symphony Universums eine intensive, düstere Atmosphäre, unterstützt von einem abwechslungsreichen Soundtrack
row.short_description: Im Jahr 2234 kämpfen die 13-jährige Victorique und ihre beste Freundin Zoé im überwachten Frankreich gegen die Human Rescue Organisation. Trotz ihrer durch Schizophrenie verzerrten Wahrnehmung verfolgen die beiden Hackerinnen entschlossen ihren Plan, die Menschheit zu befreien.
row.notes: This game features depictions of psychosis and addresses the topic of schizophrenia. It includes violence against animals and humans, as well as scenes with characters in underwear. Therefore, it may not be suitable for all players.

row.name: Find My MOM
row.detailed_description: Wade still needs his MAMA. Find your MOM by overcoming the obstacles, the narrator, and the traps that stand in your way. The player moves forward, covered in objects scavenged from the streets — a wobbly basketball, a rusty barrel, even a burning box.  There’s only one goal: to find and reunite with the missing mother. Find My Mom is the life story of a man who has lost his mother amid a powerless, stagnant life. Does wearing a barrel on your head seem like a stupid idea? thank the developer. The narrator usually mocks you... but sometimes, he might actually help. Listen carefully to what he says. The path forward is painful. A calm BGM might be the only thing soothing your heart. Try rolling forward with a barrel over your head, or jumping high with a basketball instead. Whatever it takes—keep moving. There is a quit button. Just remember one thing: WADE still needs his mom. If the game feels too difficult, please contact your professor instead of the developer. This game is a student project — the difficulty is the result of the professor’s orders.

row.detailed_description: Coreless is a third-person, single-player action roguelike that brings a fresh twist to meta-progression through its flexible talent and power systems. Choose from a wide variety of avatars, enhance them with talent points, and equip them with distinctive addons. Each adventure promises unique challenges and experiences. Highly Customizable Avatars Shape your playstyle using a rich combination of talents, addons, and in-session powers. Whether you envision a spellcaster striking from afar, a melee warrior dealing stuns and damage over time, or an assassin summoning minions to create distractions, the choice is entirely yours. Unlock new avatars, powers, and addons to forge a truly distinctive build! Tick-Based Addon System As you progress, surviving tougher encounters earns you Ticks—your performance currency. These Ticks unlock addon drops and Affix Milestones that enhance those addons. Addons are central to your build: passive addons may grant powers at session start, plague enemies periodically, or provide shields or extra lives. Event-based addons activate based on the socket they're placed in—some let you double-dash to collect nearby buffs, others trigger effects during Overdrive abilities. The more Ticks you gather in a session, the higher your chances of powerful drops. Simply put: the longer you survive, the better the rewards. Diverse and Challenging Encounters Each run is packed with upgrade options, diverse foes, and hidden unlockables. Optimize your growth during every encounter before the Heat Meter hits 100%, triggering a boss battle. Defeating these unique enemies rewards you with gear to power future runs. Unlock new difficulty levels, environments, and enemy types for escalating challenge and reward. Continuous Progression Even in defeat, progress continues. Earn permanent upgrades such as talent points, addons and resources. Each step forward opens up new strategic possibilities for future attempts.
