row.name: Piece Yourself Up
row.detailed_description: Your large spoon acts as a sword. It has a large area of attack, can deflect projectiles and costs a fraction of your spoon reserves. The maximum number of spoons you can hold is 12 (referencing spoon theory - more below), and every attack costs, so plan your moves carefully to make it count! Your little spoons act as projectiles. They are precise and cost a full spoon from your reserves but deal immense damage. Your robot body is unstable, and your parts will fall off, whether it be from attacks or the passage of time. Use the parts of your fallen enemies to replace your missing limbs and survive the day. Piece Yourself Up was made in response to the inKUbator Game Jam 2024 theme 'Everything Falls Apart', interpreting it through the lens of those with mental and physical health conditions. The player is represented by a robot, which is our interpretation of the feeling of dissociation. Their body is unreliable and needs constant upkeep, a sentiment many people can relate to. Simple daily tasks such as writing essays, checking emails and cooking can become obstacles that must be fought to successfully complete the day. Spoons are used as weapons to represent energy levels, which is a nod to Christine Miserandino’s famous 'Spoon Theory'. The theory proposes if you were given 12 spoons at the start of the day and each task you wanted to complete in the day cost a spoon, how would you spend your day? It highlights the invisible struggle of these conditions - energy. Energy is limited, and energy management becomes a crucial skill that can get overwhelming. This is the experience of many people with chronic mental and physical conditions. For more information, please visit Christine's original heartfelt post 'The Spoon Theory' on her blog. Piece Yourself Up was made by three first year students and a third year student at University, and although it may change in the future, there are no current plans for any major changes to the game as we are putting more time into our other, more complex, projects. We hope you enjoy our game and we can't wait for our future endeavors.
row.short_description: Slash and shoot enemies with spoons and use their parts to piece your broken body up! Survive in this 2D pixel-art top-down dungeon crawler game based on chronic mental and physical conditions.

row.detailed_description: HOOP DREAMING Slip on those high tops and hit the courts with the first basketball game in the award-winning Backyard Sports Franchise, Backyard Basketball ‘01, now enhanced to run on Steam.  The Backyard athletes are teaming up with the kid version of hoops legend Lisa Leslie in Backyard Basketball ‘01! Customize your uniform, pick your fab five, and get ready for four quarters of hoops! Play single games or a whole season. Track stats in Season play and create custom players to watch their skills improve over time! HOOPS FOR EVERYONE Ball like it’s 2001! 30 Iconic Kid Athletes 9 Unique Basketball Courts Comical Power-ups Hilarious Bloopers Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Barry Dejay THE GOAT Backyard Basketball featured arguably the most iconic video game athlete of the 90s or any era - Pablo Sanchez. Play with the legend himself or choose your favorites and relive what made Backyard Basketball 2001 an award-winning classic.  Game Modes include: Pick-up Game: Instant play! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately. Season Play: Pick your team name, uniform colors, and players to compete in the Backyard Basketball League. Manage the team through a basketball season for your chance to win the Championship! We’re talking about practice! Hone those basketball skills while getting a feel for every court in practice mode! Then, it’s game time! Play a Pick-up Game or a Full Season with your favorite players. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries. Backyard Basketball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, is stacked with Steam achievements to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.
row.short_description: Return to the blacktop with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Basketball 2001 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Dribble, shoot, and take that ball to the hoop!

row.name: Everything Ends In 0
row.detailed_description: Special thanks to Violet. Without her sacrifice, this game would not be here. Everything Ends In 0 is a game about the end of the world, but you are not a hero destined to save it. In fact, it can't be saved at all - from the moment you start playing, The World is already doomed. No twist, no fine print, no loopholes, no technicalities. Everything. Will. Die. All you can do is wait for it to be over. And hey! while you're at it, why not strike up a friendly conversation? I hear you're quite similar to a couple of those girls, and quite intriguing to a couple others. Besides, it's not like the awkward moments will really matter in just a little bit. So listen to them for a while, to pass the time! Or don't. Again, it really does not matter. You are going to die. CONTROLS: [Z] select [X] 'return' [ARROWS] lose yourself [MOUSE] admire your new forever home [W] move forward [Z] gather

Elyrium Madness: Magic is your most powerful weapon, and potentially your undoing. Every ability used brings you closer to the brink, the power of Elyrium slowly driving your units mad. There's a potential method to this madness, though - the further you push to the edge, the more powerful your abilities become. Passing the Baton: Field your four best and brightest units in each battle, but plan for attrition. Casualties can be swiftly replaced mid-battle with reserve units from your Tower - don’t accept defeat! Automatons: Not all of your units are flesh and blood. Your home base’s Factory can manufacture powerful Elyrium-fueled automatons with unique abilities and strengths. Expertise System: Keep your troops alive and they’ll reward you in kind. row.name: War Lands
row.detailed_description: War Lands is about being a strategist, fighting adversaries and taking over the world one territory at a time. Paint the map your color in this fast-paced battle of wits and territory. Key Features: Dynamic Map Generation: Every game starts on a freshly generated map, ensuring no two battles are ever the same! Strategic Expansion: Grow your territory, but beware – expand too quickly, and you'll leave yourself vulnerable. Resource Management: Balance your units carefully. Every piece of land needs protection, but spread yourself too thin, and the AI will exploit your weaknesses. Adaptive AI Opponents: Face off against computer players that analyze your strategy and actively seek out your vulnerabilities. Fast-Paced Gameplay: Think quickly and act decisively. In War Lands, hesitation can cost you everything. Gameplay: In War Lands, you're thrust into a world of constant conflict and opportunity: Start with a small territory and work to expand your influence across the map. Manage your resources wisely, deciding when to claim new lands and when to reinforce your borders. Deploy units strategically to defend your territory and prepare for offensive maneuvers. Analyze your opponents' strategies and adapt your own tactics to counter their moves. React swiftly to the ever-changing battlefield, where a single misstep can turn the tide of war. Perfect For: Strategy game enthusiasts looking for a fresh challenge Players who enjoy games that blend thoughtful planning with quick decision-making Fans of procedurally generated content that ensures high replayability Those who love outsmarting AI opponents in a battle of wits and tactics Dive into the world of War Lands and prove your strategic prowess. Can you expand your empire while fending off relentless AI opponents? Every game is a new test of skill, speed, and strategy!
row.short_description: War Lands is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle for global domination on dynamically generated maps. Expand your territory, manage resources, and outsmart adaptive AI opponents in a constant struggle for supremacy. Think quickly, act decisively, and paint the world in your colors.

row.name: Jellitito
row.detailed_description: What comes to mind when you see jelly? Want to tap it? Then Jellitito is just for you! This fun clicker game lets you pick your favorite jelly look and dive into a meditative squishing experience. With appealing graphics, calming music, and captivating jelly jiggles with every click, what could be better for unwinding after a long day? Play, relax, and collect a unique jelly collection! Jellitito is a simple anti-stress clicker. You don't need to do anything but click on the jelly, enjoying the process. During the game, you have an opportunity to get skins for the jelly or table, which will be notified by the Steam notification service. By clicking on the “inventory” button, you can replace the standard colors with those skins that you like more from the available ones. And if you want something new, you can always exchange skins with friends or use the opportunity provided by Steam! In the game, you may: Click on the jelly. Contemplate the jelly without clicking on it. Collect drops as in-game items, such as jelly and table skins. Swap jelly and table skins. Exchange skins with other players. Utilize other Steam features related to skins! Currently, there are over 50 table skins and 30 jelly skins of varying rarity in the game! To be able to get a skin drop inside the game, you need to launch it and wait for one minute. You can receive a new skin every 4 hours! Chance of getting a skin depending on the rarity. Chance of drop out and the number of positions will change over time. Items in the game now have these rarities:: Common. Rare. Unique. Legendary. Mythic. Epic. Q: Will there be achievements in the game? A: Yes, there will be! We plan to add not only achievements but also other features: a leaderboard, competitions, a community workshop, new skins, and much more! Q: Is it a scam? A: No, it's a simple anti-stress clicker game. There is no scam involved, as the game is completely free for players. The drop of skins is determined solely by luck. We utilize Steam features, which is not a scam (player-to-player exchange and the Steam trading platform). We do not encourage or advise players against taking risky actions. Q: Is the game going to close soon? А: For those worried that the game might shut down: no need to worry, everything is under control! 😊 The game is hosted on Steam servers, so as long as the platform is running, the game will be available. We trust Steam, and we’re sure you do too. 😉 Q: What can I do with skins? A: Everything that the game and Steam allow! You can collect them, showcase your collections in the game community, share them with friends, sell them on the Steam marketplace, and more.
row.short_description: Get ready for some sweet fun with our antistress Jellitito game! Just clicking to collect amazing skins and exchange them with other players. Build your collection of rare skins! It's simple, addictive, and endlessly enjoyable! Start clicking today!

row.name: Ultimate Chopsticks
row.detailed_description: Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. It is played the world over. Players extend hands to towards each other with one finger out and take it in turns to tap each others hands. The tapped hand extends more fingers equal to the fingers on the hand that tapped it. A hand full of fingers is 'knocked out'. There are many variants of rules, many of which are captured here, including splitting fingers between hands, different number of hands and different number of fingers per hand. Play against an AI or another human or try and complete a set of challenges.
row.short_description: Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. Players take it in turns to tap each others hands to knock each other out and win.

row.name: Dusty
row.detailed_description: For years archaeologist Dusty has traveled the world discovering ruins, sharing his findings. One day, on one of his explorations, he finds a mysterious notebook. It contains a forgotten language, a location and list of dates written in his handwriting, but he doesn't remember ever writing them down. Following his instinct, he picked up his cane ready to unravel the mystery. Inspired by the Canary Shepherd's Leap , explore a world hidden in sand and stone, by jumping between canyons and landslides. Interact and see fauna and flora among beautiful landscapes . Understanding the past will take you into the depths of the planet. An intricate light technology covers the remnants of this lost civilization. Among its ruins solve its mechanisms and decipher its language in a system of various puzzles. Use your cane and observe the wildlife to solve it. Each step will lead you to the great discoveries. Always guided by your notebook, write down every discovery. Each new clue and each new relic has its own story. How did they live? Who did it? What did they think? What does it have to do with you? Follow your instinct and solve the past. This game is an university project by students at U-tad. The masters involved are design, art, programming, concept, modelling, animation, rigging and production from U-tad and the master's degree in musical creation and production from Loyola University.
row.short_description: Dusty is a third-person puzzle game focused on explore beautiful environments. Join archaeologist Dusty on his search for a mysterious civilization. Explore equipped with your extensible cane and notebook to resolve the past, the ways of the civilization and his technology of light.

While Bask sucks at swimming he knows a thing or two about platforming around. Magic?! No, Potions! Throw them to solve puzzles and interact with the world! Scan all sorts of things as you run around, you might find out about a new Potion or some cool frog facts! maybe even a secret society unbeknownst to the general public awaiting for their time to break free and revolutionize Alecost!
row.short_description: Once human, now frog. Begin this unexpected journey into the land of the unknown in-search of a cure for your froggy state. Explore the world around you while helping others in need as you find new ingredients and potions to help you on your path.

row.name: MatchOOlu
row.detailed_description: MatchOOlu is a card matching game based on the age old game of using your memory to find and remove matching cards. There have been many versions of this type of game over the years, but rarely do these games offer more than a basic experience. MatchOOlu aims to surpass all previous entries into this genre by providing more tables, layouts, decks, and modes that have ever been available. Each deck, mode, and layout is designed to challenge your memory and dexterity in different ways. Are you better at memorizing shapes, colors, numbers, or letters? Perhaps it is easy to remember the position of a card in a grid, but what about a layout that is more complex? These are questions that you can explore in MatchOOlu as you test yourself and learn more about how your short-term memory works. You may also learn or discover new methods to memorize things that you can apply to other aspects of your life. MatchOOlu is not just a memory game though. The sight match mode will test your speed in recognizing and selecting card matches with all cards face up. This mode rewards sharp eyes as well as fast, accurate fingers and is a great way to show-off your skill with a mouse. Features 4 Different Match Modes: Blind, Sight, Study, Combo. 4 Different Match Counts: 2 card, 3 card, 4 card, variable card. Several Decks: 6 unlockable decks, each with 54 cards. Additional decks available for purchase. Several Tables: 15 different table materials to play on. Lots of Card Layouts: 25 different card layouts ranging from 12 to 54 cards. Additional layouts are available for purchase. About Monetization In order to reach as many players as possible, MatchOOlu is free to play game. That said, the free experience is substantial with the following content unlocked via the completion of in-game achievements: All game modes 6 decks 25 layouts 15 tables Additional layouts and decks will be purchasable as DLC. MatchOOlu contains no 3rd party advertisements, or paid consumables.
row.short_description: A card matching game like no other. Test your memory. Test your dexterity. Explore your mind.

row.name: Chior Chapter 1: Hall Of Pillars
row.detailed_description: When you lose your most valuable senses, a combination of the rest has to do. Feel, scream, smell, and manage. The game uses a variety of senses to aid the player throughout their journey. Feel: You feel around your surroundings in order to gather information from your current location. Smell: smell the surrounding environment in order to get a good indication of what kind of challenges may lay ahead. Scream: Scream out loud in order to deter your foes as well as draw attention from other NPCs. Step: Forwards, Backwards, Left, Right. Watch out for those who can see you, for there are plenty. There are several enemies who will take you into even deeper darkness. These enemies have unique ways of posing threats, whether by harming you directly, damaging one of your senses, or moving around. Make sure to learn how to deal with them in order to make sure you don't give them satisfaction. Solve puzzles and do anything and everything in your power in order to escape from this hellscape. Feel and hear to get clues and solve intriguing and challenging puzzles. Use all that is within your inventory to harm anything that tries to get in your way, and make sure you don't bump your head into walls when walking. Interact with dwellers in an unseen place. They have many stories and secrets to tell. There are many characters throughout the journey who can help you learn more about your surroundings and help you with your troubles. In an unknown place, having the ability to communicate properly with the locals is mandatory.
row.short_description: You had a pretty rough fall. Trying to regain your composure you try to look around before realizing you can't see anything. Hope that your other senses will serve you better.

row.name: 绯红编年史 ~ Chronicle of Scarlet ~ Playtest
GunStar's Gambit
row.detailed_description: The capacity of GunStar's Gambit to provide players an sensation of constant, incremental progress and forward momentum even while they're idle is what makes it so captivating. These games can be left running in the background while a player attends to other chores. They can return at a later time to gather their resources and use them to purchase further improvements. The reward centers of the brain are triggered by this 'idle' gameplay loop, which results in an unquenchable urge to click. Wealth seekers and explorers alike have been enthralled with the tantalizing and exhilarating idea of finding hidden wealth every three hours. Fairy tales and legends are made on the very notion of finding priceless relics, priceless gems, or even lost fortunes on a regular, almost clockwork-like schedule. But, the alluring prospect of discovering such a cache of unexpected riches almost constantly could prove to be the experience of a lifetime for anyone brave enough to accept the task. Features (Clicker) (Multiplier every 100 Clicks) (Drops are currently in progress)
row.short_description: 'Really it's just a Clicker Game.' But.. The thrilling prospect of discovering hidden gold every three hours has captivated both adventurers and wealth seekers. GunStar's Gambit to provide players and sensation of constant and incremental progress.

row.name: Gekko Episode of Yurihime

A school romantic comedy visual novel that depicts an exciting love pattern with five heroines. This is the third installment in the Gekko series, and it tells the story of “Yurihime,” the protagonist's older sister and teacher. ■ Story Time is modern. High school student 'Yuto' who attends 'Seioh High School' Unfortunately, he gets caught up in an automata runaway incident, but after a short break, the third-generation automata 'Nova' saves his life. The hideout was taken to 'Nova' as it was, and 'Yuto' was assigned a serious task. ―――― Become a lover with 5 school idols to defeat 'Mugen Tukuyomi'. 'Yuto' is his buddy 'Nova', He started the operation to become a heroine and a lover with the operation staff 'Kageyama'. This time the target is. Sometimes the protagonist's sister, sometimes a teacher at the Holy Imperial Academy, sometimes a bartender, And in reality, she is “Yurihime”, the operator of ...... “Swordbreaker Benihomura”. This is an episode of a sister and brother that no one knows, which is connected to the secret of the birth of the main character, Yuto. ■ Features ・ Unique and cute characters ・ A story of laughter, tears, and excitement ・School battle romantic comedy in which students fight each other with swords ・ Visual novel that can be enjoyed casually without choice ・ Play time 4-5 hours ・ Only mouse operation is supported

row.name: Penelope Syndrome Preview
row.detailed_description: Deep in a heavily industrialized city, you find yourself trapped with numerous hostile cryptid monsters. Your only means of defense is a heavy wrench; the last thing from your life before all the chaos began. Fix and repair damaged systems that would allow you to progress and fight for your life until you can escape. Not everyone can be the hero... In this Standalone preview build of Penelope Syndrome you will get a small taste of what the full installment will have to offer. Including: Scavenging In the sewer systems and back alleys of IF City, you'll find scraps of useful material scattered in the far corners. Can you find enough to get by? Resource Management You will often find yourself in situations forcing difficult choices. Spend or save? The true question. Real Time Combat If you have the resources to fight, excellent. But knowing when to fight and when to run is a vital, if tricky, skill to master. Enemies will always be hunting you down, and you won't always be ready to face them. Randomizer System Every time you start a level, the items are procedurally placed. Meaning what you found may not be where you last found them on previous runs, or even there at all. This includes the monsters you face... Brought to you by Sakura and Crit
row.short_description: You are not a hero. You are just an everyday average mechanic. You can fight, but without having the resources to repair damaged systems, you will die trapped with them.

row.name: Gridlink
row.detailed_description: Gridlink is a fun, minimalist puzzle game. While the rules of the game are simple and easy to understand, the game offers enough complexity to keep you entertained for a few minutes or a few hours. The aim of the game is to draw a continuous line starting from the smallest number on the grid, to the next number in an ascending order and ending the line on the largest number on the grid. Each part of the line can be drawn separately, as long as it still respects the rules and at the end everything connects up to a single line. The puzzle is solved when all the numbers are connected, each cell in the grid has been passed and the line does not cross itself. If you make a mistake at any point in the game, you always have the option of unlimited UNDOs or clearing the board entirely. The pre-generated levels not to your liking? No problem! Use the custom level generator and setup the game grid with the size and difficulty of your choosing. FEATURES 150 pre-generated levels ranging from easy (6x6 grid) to difficult (20x20 grid) A custom level generator allowing you to choose any difficulty you want Minimalist design Relaxing background music Unlimited UNDO options if you make a mistake Dark Mode
row.short_description: Gridlink is a fun, minimalist puzzle game with a simple premise - connect the numbers on a square grid with a single, continuous line that traverses all squares and does not cross itself.

row.name: Frontline Inferno
row.detailed_description: Step into the boots of a soldier from the Axis, Soviet, or Allied forces and engage in thrilling, rapid-fire battles across colorful, stylized battlegrounds. Frontline Inferno is an action-packed FPS arena shooter that combines the historical setting of World War II with an arcade twist, delivering frantic gunfights, instant respawns, and total freedom in how you gear up. Non-stop, fast-paced combat – The action never slows down. Sprint, shoot, and respawn as quickly as you fall, keeping the gameplay constantly intense and dynamic. Whether you're flanking or charging head-on, there’s no time to breathe. Vertical, multi-layered maps – Battle across uniquely designed arenas inspired by real WWII locations. From bombed-out cities to underground bunkers, each map offers vertical gameplay and dynamic layouts that keep players on their toes. Master the environment to gain the upper hand! Vibrant low-poly visuals – Forget gritty realism – Frontline Inferno delivers the war in bright, bold, and colorful low-poly graphics that bring a playful and approachable vibe to the intensity of the action. It’s World War II like you’ve never seen it before. Customizable characters – Stand out from the crowd with a variety of customization options. From helmets and uniforms to accessories, personalize your soldier's look and hit the battlefield in style. Experience frantic multiplayer deathmatches where you choose your side in a battle between Axis, Soviets, and Allies. Join the fight in team-based skirmishes across small, intense maps designed for high-octane combat. No complex strategies – just raw, arcade action. Frontline Inferno is perfect for players who crave fast-paced, skill-based shooters with a nostalgic arcade feel. Ideal for both casual gamers looking to jump into quick, action-packed sessions and FPS veterans who love chaotic, no-holds-barred gameplay.
row.short_description: Step into fast-paced WWII combat with Frontline Inferno! Choose your side and engage in chaotic, arcade-style battles with dynamic respawns, customizable loadouts, and vibrant low-poly visuals. Join the fight and dominate the battlefield!

row.name: 酒馆战争
row.detailed_description: 快来加入我们，一起开黑吧！ About the Game 我们将卡牌游戏和即时战略游戏结合在一起，打造出最好的自走棋游戏。从五个不同的种族中选择你的卡牌组合，以战胜你的对手。 在准备阶段培育的军团部署到战场上，展现千军万马的壮观对决，实时战斗中伴随着逼真的物理效果。 策略契合你的游戏风格 有五个种族可供选择，每一个种族都提供独特而惊人的游戏体验。选择你主要种族的所有卡牌。在你的竞技过程中，你可以通过组合升级系统增强卡牌，为胜利开辟新路径。 体验每次都独一无二的游戏过程 每一次游戏体验都是独特的。 使用超过80张军团卡牌,49种不同的神器,12位英雄指挥官,来构建你的自定义卡组。 与5个不同种族互动，每个种族提供截然不同的部落玩法。 每个种族提供各种独特的游戏组合。 享受多种游戏模式：PVE关卡模式、PVP排位模式 不可否认，这款游戏是一款融合怪，融合了酒馆战棋、RTS和小丑牌，借鉴它们的优点来创新卡牌游戏。希望它能给你带来一种全新的卡牌对战游戏体验，我们的尝试可能存在一些不足之处。然而，我们承诺会根据玩家的反馈不断改进和发展。我们非常感谢您的讨论、交流和建议。谢谢！ 各版本说明 * Steam 试玩版： 免费下载 注意：4个正式版指挥官尚未解锁 * Steam 正式版： 国区售价42元 首发优惠：25%折扣 解锁正式版指挥官 赠送500水晶（价值50元） * 手游版： 通过QQ群下载 注意：4个正式版指挥官尚未解锁 * 关于游戏内购 为了给大家带来这款全新的多人在线游戏，我们的团队投入了大量时间和精力。由于游戏依赖服务器的支持，运营成本较高，因此我们采用赛季制模式。 * 每月更新： 为了保证丰富的游戏体验，我们每个月都会更新新的内容。 * DLC和内购： 游戏的DLC内容通过内购提供，以支持持续的内容更新。 用户体验说明 由于游戏是PvP多人在线模式，需要大量玩家在线以保证最佳体验。我们在设计UI界面和交互时，融入了一些手游风格，以便手机和PC玩家能无缝互动。我们理解这可能导致部分Steam用户的不适应，但这是为了提升整个玩家社区的互动体验。 海外玩家网络稳定性说明 海外玩家注意： 由于我们的游戏服务器位于中国大陆，海外玩家可能会遇到网络不稳定和卡顿的情况。对此，我们深表歉意，并感谢您的理解。 未来随着我们经济基础的增强，我们将积极考虑开通国际服，以改善海外玩家的网络体验。
row.short_description: 经典军团自走棋来了，这是一款多人PVP策略游戏，融入了类Rogue和自走棋元素。玩家需要为自动战斗的军团搭配合适的英雄指挥官,神器和法术，最终击败所有玩家夺得冠军

row.name: REVEREX: DX
row.detailed_description: REVEREX: DX is the expansion and Steam release of the award-winning game, REVEREX. The scientists at the Zlyodomov Biomedical Manufacture Concern (ZBMC) think they’ve created a device which can pull people out of comas: the REVEREX. As their top technicians, its up to you and a friend to operate the machine through it’s maiden voyage, ensuring the stability of your patient’s mind and body through the entire ordeal. Navigate stages rife with unusual geometry, shifting gravity, and strange visuals. Complete challenging maintenance tasks to make traversal easier. Get out again before the dream world, or your patient, are destabilized for good. Run, Jump, and Parkour your way through the dream world. Work with your Vitalist to stay buffed and complete the operation. Execute stunts, skips and gravity defying tricks to reach the end before your patient is destabilized. Master minigames to keep your Navigator & patient stable. Clear debuffs as fast as you can to keep the simulation going. Give the Navigator powerful buffs to allow skips and access to hard-to-reach spots. Please note that REVEREX: DX contains flashing lights, bright colors and other visuals that may cause adverse effects to individuals with photosensitivity issues including Epilepsy. Exercise caution before playing if you have a history of photosensitivity.
row.short_description: REVEREX: DX is a 2-player asymmetric experience that blends platforming action and microgames on a visually stunning trip through the mind. Don the roles of Lab Technicians operating an experimental Coma Treatment device, explore the deepest reaches of the subconscious and rescue your patient!

row.name: PUMPKIN PANIC
row.detailed_description: Enjoy life on your small farm You have a lot of work to do. Plant, water, and harvest. This cozy and peaceful farm nestled in the heart of the forest has much to offer. Relax with some fishing Need a break? Fishing is just what you need! It's also a great way to earn some extra money. Beware of the darkness Perhaps things weren’t as pleasant as they seemed, it's become a bit eerie. Will you manage to survive? It won't be easy.
row.short_description: COME TO THIS COZY FARM! Plant crops, take care of the plants, go fishing, or whatever you prefer, but have a good time! But be carefull, they say that strange things are happening in the area...

row.name: Blood Rising
row.detailed_description: This is a game about a vempire to against the adventurers. 1. You can use your skills to kill enemies and convert them to your servants to help fight, which is the only way for you to produce combat units. 2. Servants killing enemies will evolve into higher-level units, and the small dot in the middle of the card represents the number of enemies that need to be killed for evolution. 3. Killing enemies has a chance to drop items into the item compartment in the bottom right corner, items can assist in combat. 4. Killing enemies will drop souls, and you can upgrade skills on the talent interface after the battle is over with these souls. 5. When the player's health becomes zero, the battle fails. 6. There will be a total of three heroes and a large number of adventurers coming to attack. Defeating all enemies will lead to victory.
row.short_description: This is a roguelike game with card battles as its core. Players need to play as a vampire ancestor to resist the attacks of a large number of adventurers and defeat three great heroes to achieve ultimate victory.

row.name: Unholy Village Free Version
row.detailed_description: Buy Original Version Buy Now Original Version of Unholy Village About the Game Unholy Village Free 1-Hour Version | This game provides access to 1 hour of free gameplay in Unholy Village. UNHOLY VILLAGE is a single-player thriller and survival game. The village you visit for your sister's funeral has actually been taken over by a demon, and you must try to break its curse. Once a peaceful village, it faced a mysterious curse. The village began to live in fear because of the infected entities that suddenly appeared. Over time, the village became an uninhabitable and cursed place. Try to save your friends After the car accident, you must search for your friends' traces in the abandoned village and find them before they die. Realistic graphics, immersive cinematics, and rich story Unholy Village; with realistic graphics, cinematics, and rich storytelling, will enhance your gameplay experience and bring you tension, fear, and excitement. Try to survive Hide, seek refuge, and most importantly, survive from infected creatures, the demon, and psychotic humans in an abandoned and cursed village! Collect weapon ammunition, bandages, and medical supplies from abandoned houses in the village. Warning Contains blood, weapons, and frightening graphics.
row.short_description: Joseph and his two friends set out for their village to attend his sister's funeral. However, they strangely have an accident on the way. After the accident, Joseph's friends go missing. While trying to find his friends in an abandoned town, Joseph encounters strange events.
row.notes: Contains blood, weapons, and frightening graphics.

row.name: 王牌星舰
row.detailed_description: In the year 271 A.E., a blood-red rift appeared in the solar system, and a hideously ugly gigantic creature came through, accompanied by countless fleets of insectoids. Humans had no time to figure out the cause of this disaster and were forced to initiate the 'Continuation' plan. With the help of several ship captains carrying 'Fire Seeds,' they piloted starships and performed an emergency jump through a wormhole to an unknown 'Noah Universe,' thus opening a new chapter of exploring new universes and rebuilding their homes... Game features: Automatic idle exploration, discovering unknown planets Place your ships on autopilot to explore unknown planets, and you can still earn rewards even when you're away from the game. There's also a cool Earth holographic mode for fast exploration. Assemble elite fleets, combining powerful skills You can recruit dozens of powerful captains, and by deploying specific captains, you can trigger multi-layer skill chain effects; properly planning your fleet will make your exploration of the universe easier! Perform cosmic duties, defending human homes Complete various cosmic duties such as faction wars, repelling insectoids, resource collection and plunder, and mineral secret realms to obtain abundant resources and defend against insectoid invasions. Open starport expeditions, experiencing more gameplay Test your fleet's strength through various gameplay such as tournament halls, and undergo characteristic trials; there are also random unknown wormholes waiting for commanders to explore!
row.short_description: 《王牌星舰》是一款以宇宙科幻为题材的挂机类战舰手游，游戏包含卡牌、放置、SLG、Roguelike等多元玩法。在诺亚宇宙，玩家扮演的指挥官可以通过巡航、任务、虫洞、活动等获取强力的星舰、装备、僚机等，以此来逐渐增强舰队的实力；也可以结识朋友，加入阵营，参与星系的资源掠夺；还有更多精彩副本，派遣，挑战等PVE/PVP玩法等待指挥官们的探索体验！

row.name: GGWG: Goose Game Without Goose
row.detailed_description: Roll-and-Move race boardgame where you become a intrepid hero on a quest to free the kingdom from an evil enemy. You will control your adventurer's moves and actions thrugh a gloomy abandoned castle, up to the last room. Monsters and traps will try to stop you from reaching your goal and other valiant paladins will race you to the glory. So, roll the dice. Your quest awaits! Advance in the castle, reach the last tile and be the first player to defeat the final boss! Strategically use 4, 6 and 8 sided dice to survive turn after turn! Face skeletons, ghosts and the legendary Black Knight! Get magical treasures like the Sacred Sword or the Lucky Amulet! Use shortcuts to advance faster through the castle! ...and above all, don't trust mirrors! FEATURES Strategically enanched Goose Game rules Single player mode vs AI Local multiplayer up to 3 players 15+ playable characters Unlockable Achievements Holiday special gimmicks Realistic dice rolls Multiple languages In-game tutorial 20 minutes avarage playtime
row.short_description: A fantasy boardgame where you play an intrepid hero on a mission to free the kingdom from evil. Guide your adventurer through a dark abandoned castle filled with monsters, traps, and rival other paladins racing for glory. So, roll the dice. Your quest awaits!

row.name: Keyboard Soldier
row.detailed_description: Survive the Undead Onslaught with the Power of Words! In this thrilling action-survival game, you find yourself in a forest under siege by relentless zombies. But these aren't just any zombies—they are fueled by words. To fend off the undead, you'll need to type the words displayed above their heads. Each correct letter sends a bullet flying, and completing the word takes down the enemy. The words vary in difficulty, becoming more challenging as you progress through the stages. Level Up and Equip Powerful Items: As you eliminate enemies, you'll gain experience and level up. With each level, choose from a selection of common, rare, or legendary items to enhance your survival chances. Strategize your loadout with powerful items that can dramatically impact the outcome of the game, helping you survive longer against increasingly difficult waves of zombies. Master the Art of Survival: Explore three unique maps, each with its own difficulty curve, as you fight to survive wave after wave of undead. Face off against four different types of enemies: Normal Zombies: Regular words that keep you on your toes. Confusing Zombies: Their words shuffle every second, making them tricky to defeat. Rubbish Zombies: A chaotic mix of random letters and numbers. Small Zombies: These enemies have a single-letter word but are very fast. Harness Special Words and Combos: Use special word types to gain advantages in battle: Purple Words: Instantly kill three visible enemies. Blue Words: Freeze all visible enemies in their tracks. Gold Words: Achieve double gold amount. Build up your combo bar by typing accurately, multiplying your score as you chain together correct words. Be careful—one mistake can reset your combo and cost you valuable points. Certain rare and legendary items interact with the combo bar, adding even more strategic depth to the gameplay. Visit the Shop for Strategic Upgrades: Earn gold by defeating zombies and use it in the shop to fortify your defenses. Purchase barricades to block enemy advances, mines to decimate groups of zombies, mud to slow them down, and torches to light up the night. Careful management of your resources can make the difference between life and death, especially when darkness falls and the zombies become even more dangerous. Climb the Leaderboards: Test your typing skills and survival instincts as you aim to last as long as possible. Your performance will be ranked on global leaderboards based on your score and typing accuracy. Will you rise to the top and prove your mastery of words and survival? Key Features: Unique Typing-Based Combat: Use your typing skills to fend off hordes of zombies. Strategic Leveling System: Choose from a variety of items to customize your playstyle. Dynamic Shop System: Purchase and deploy defensive items to increase your chances of survival. Diverse Enemy Types: Each with unique challenges to overcome. Special Word Types: Gain powerful effects by typing the right words. Combo System: Enhance your score with accurate typing and strategic play. Challenging Maps: Three maps with distinct difficulty levels. Global Leaderboards: Compete against other players and show off your skills. Can you survive the zombie apocalypse using only your wits and your words? The undead are waiting...
row.short_description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fend off hordes of zombies by typing words, level up to unlock powerful items, and strategize to survive as long as possible in an ever-challenging environment.
row.notes: Keyboard Soldier contains minimal depictions of violence, focused on the combat against zombie enemies. Players will use firearms and explosives to eliminate these undead foes, which may result in mild blood effects and occasional explosions. The representation of violence is kept minimal and is stylized to fit the action-survival theme, with no excessive gore or graphic details. The game does not include any sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or depictions of self-harm.

row.name: ArsGoetia
row.detailed_description: In ArsGoetia, you plunge into a world shrouded in darkness, where you must rescue kidnapped children from a hopeless and desperate situation. You must overcome rapidly moving traps and deadly obstacles, putting everything on the line to ensure the children’s safety. This perilous journey will push your reflexes and problem-solving skills to their limits. Each level is designed with new challenges and maze-like structures, filled with unforeseen threats and traps. As you rescue the children one by one, you must find a way to escape the forces of darkness. You will experience a desperate journey that goes beyond simply overcoming obstacles to saving the children. Moreover, as you save the children, you will encounter dialogues filled with their gratitude and fear. This game is not a series of easy choices. You must gather wisdom and courage to make difficult decisions, and if you fail, you will have to start over from the beginning. But do not be discouraged. Each failure teaches you a new lesson, helping you move one step closer. Show your courage by rescuing all the children from the dark castle and leading them to safety.
row.short_description: In ArsGoetia, a thrilling platformer, you must navigate through treacherous traps and perilous landscapes to rescue kidnapped children and escape a dark, mysterious realm. Can you overcome the dangers and save them all?

row.name: PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender
row.detailed_description: The game is in development and not completed yet, feel free to report to us all bugs and errors! Welcome to ' PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender ' – the game where humor meets heroism, and your courage is as big as your $COQ! Dive beak-first into a world where the stakes are high, and the adversaries are plenty. It's not just a game; it's a battle cry for all rooster warriors ready to defend their coop with honor, wit, and a bit of COQy attitude. In this feathery adventure, you’ll embark on a journey through 30 egg-citing levels, each with its unique challenges and adversaries. From the sneaky 'Fox Frenzy' to the explosive 'Tank Terminator' showdown, your mission is to peck, cluck, and crow your way to victory. Show those pesky pigs in 'Pig Panic' who’s boss, scatter 'Haystack Havoc' across the fields, and don't let the 'Coyote Clash' catch you off guard! As 'The Coop Defender,' your arsenal will be as diverse as the enemies you face. With every level, from 'Corn Convoy Crush' to the daring 'General's Last Stand,' your skills will be tested. Will you rise as the feathered hero the coop needs? Or will you end up as just another chicken crossing the road? But wait, there's more than just your beak and bravery. 'PlayCOQ' is evolving! What starts as a single-player journey to glory will soon expand into a multiplayer battleground where you can show the world how big your $COQ is. Compete against friends or foes in real-time battles to see whose COQ reigns supreme. And for the visionary poultry enthusiasts, 'PlayCOQ' is not just a game; it’s an entrance into the web3 universe. Soon, you'll be able to earn, trade, and show off your $COQ in ways you never imagined. The future is bright, and it’s filled with feathers! 'PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender' is not just about the battles; it’s about the laughs, the strategy, and the sheer joy of showing the world the size of your courage. With hilarious puns, egg-ceptional challenges, and a community of players ready to ruffle some feathers, this game is set to become your new favorite. So, are you ready to flap your wings, sharpen your beak, and defend the coop with every feather you've got? Now, download 'PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender' and let the world hear your battle cluck. It’s time to play, laugh, and let your COQ fight the good fight. Join the flock today and become the hero the coop deserves!
row.short_description: Prove your COQ's might in epic battles to save the coop from numerous foes! The Game is still in development!
row.notes: Our game features cartoonish, low-poly violence where the player, as a rooster, uses guns and explosives to defeat humanoid animals (foxes, wolves, etc.). There are red blood splashes when characters are shot. The game also includes suggestive humor, with the title 'PlayCOQ' being a playful reference. The visual style uses a yolk-and-eggwhite design for the lettering, which might insinuate adult themes without any explicit sexual content.

row.name: 4fools1
row.detailed_description: This game is divided into story mode and level mode Story mode: You will play the role of an Imperial Assault Soldier, 4th Generation Dirty Blade, Person, fighting and achieving meritorious service from your hometown's Guard to joining the Imperial Army. Due to its exceptional combat capabilities, you became the captain of the Empire's secret special unit, Hidden Shadow, specifically responsible for clearing out those who are 'unfavorable' to the Empire. As retirement approaches, your biggest wish is to start a leisurely life with a pension. However, a task near your retirement breaks your original life trajectory, and according to your choices, you will embark on a new journey in life. Level mode: At present, there are 20 levels in the design. You will choose an initial character template and engage in a life or death space military competition with various enemies. All Try your best to survive! Game Features Each character has exclusive special abilities, such as the protagonist's decelerate greatly: Music and characters that match different scenes and storylines, as well as store sign girls with limited patience Difficulty and control adjustment, players can adjust the difficulty according to their needs in the settings interface: 135 items+33 weapons, randomly sold in the store, waiting for your selection Background of the story: 1562 years before the protagonist's story began, civilization had advanced to the point where it could harness the entire solar system's resources. Yet, even with this vast array of resources, the escalating population crisis persisted, and the resulting conflicts and struggles failed to be adequately contained. Eventually, this led to a devastating world war that engulfed the entire solar system, compelling all factions to engage in this horrific conflict. Over the course of thirteen centuries, this prolonged war continually accelerated technological advancements, promoted the emergence of interstellar voyage technology. There are constantly forces leaving for various reasons, embarking on interstellar voyages in an attempt to find new habitable planets. Ultimately, the war in the solar system was brought to an end by a new imperial power, a highly centralized entity born from the conflict. This empire sacrificed flexibility for efficiency, with everything theoretically under the rule of the emperor. After the war's conclusion, the empire entered a period of recuperation lasting 80 years. However, as the war ended and education became more widespread among the populace, an increasing number of people could no longer tolerate the myriad issues that accompanied the empire's monolithic structure. Beneath the empire's serene facade, turmoil brewed. In response to various considerations, the authorities began to gradually expand outwards, aiming to alleviate internal contradictions and seek to reclaim the various forces that had previously departed, incorporating them into the empire's domain in the hope of achieving a new balance. After a long voyage and a fierce competition for habitable planets, only a small fraction of spaceships that left the Solar System survived. The remaining spaceships, upon reaching the Eternal Stellar System and achieving stability, established the Interstellar Alliance 187 years ago. The primary objectives of the Alliance are to maintain the stability of the Eternal Stellar System and foster collaboration among all forces within it. The Alliance adopts a seat system, where each force holds a certain number of seats. 182 years ago, when the Empire began its expansion, the Alliance engaged in protracted confrontations and diplomatic negotiations with it, while gradually drawing in neutral forces to enhance its capability to counter the Empire's expansion. Prior to this, people who settled on other habitable planets aboard spaceships formed various neutral forces. These neutral forces developed their unique characteristics based on the demographics and traits of their respective spaceship populations, such as the business-oriented Free Planet PeaceRealm. The competition for habitable planets during interstellar voyages had led to lingering distrust among these neutral forces when interacting with each other. It was only after the Empire began its expansion that these neutral forces gradually set aside their prejudices and began seeking cooperation. However, some martial factions were not among them, as they preferred to develop through plundering, exemplified by the Planet Sinful, which, after three centuries of development, had become a haven for outlaws. The Interstellar Heroes organization was initially founded by a group of people who held a strong sense of justice. Having witnessed the rapid decline of morality under the influence of war and long voyages, they decided to join together with like-minded individuals to uphold chivalry and righteousness, with the hope of gradually restoring social justice in the interstellar society. 984 years ago, the ancestors of the WisdomScript tribe were also a group who fled the Solar System, with their spaceship filled with scientists and scholars proficient in biology or machinery. Prior to their arrival on Planet WisdomScript, the two schools of Life and Machinery gradually evolved. For 793 years after reaching Planet WisdomScript, the two schools have always helped and supported each other, working together to research technology and create many amazing innovations, with potential conflicts and disagreements largely concealed. One day, a significant mutation occurred among a large number of life forms, causing them to lose their sanity. Simultaneously, the control logic of newly produced machinery was tampered with and sabotaged by unknown individuals, leading to the experimental subjects and machines going haywire. The uncontrolled experiments and machines inflicted severe damage on the planet, destroying and burying most of the achievements of the planet's civilization, turning it into a desolate wasteland. Even today, one can still see the wandering, irrational mutants around the planet. The survivors became interstellar refugees, forced to flee Planet WisdomScript. Additional Info: When I was developing this game, I was in a very bad state and the final product I made did not meet my expectations. Therefore, I decided to make this game free and open source the code on GitHub:
row.short_description: 4Fools1 is game combined bullet-hell with interactive-fiction. Player will play as an imperial soldier, navigating through choices to uncover different endings in the story mode. Alternatively, one can engage in direct combat with diverse enemies in level mode, striving to become the last survivor.

row.name: Odyssey: Realm of Echoes
row.detailed_description: A game that blends exploration and adventure , offering two modes. In the dynamic RPG mode , players confront powerful bosses and equip weapons and armor to build their strength. In the solo platformer mode , players navigate treacherous environments filled with obstacles to reclaim lost powers. Open-World RPG MODE - Solo and Multiplayer Explore an expansive open world filled with mysteries and challenges. Play solo, join friends, or connect to a server to team up with other players from around the globe. Journey across three diverse regions in search of answers about a long-lost fourth region . Equip weapons and armor to build your strength, improve your character's abilities and uncover secrets in a rich, interconnected world designed for cooperation and discovery. PLATFORMER MODE - Solo Only Step into the shoes of a legendary adventurer who disappeared 1,000 years ago. This solo-only mode focuses on precise platforming and reclaiming lost powers as you navigate challenging environments.
row.short_description: A game that blends exploration and adventure , offering two modes. In the dynamic RPG mode, players confront powerful bosses and equip weapons and armor to build their strength. In the solo platformer mode, players navigate treacherous environments filled with obstacles to reclaim lost powers.

row.name: Trapped
row.detailed_description: Are You Satisfied With Your Current Situation? Are You Feeling the Pressure From Life? Are You Trapped By Life? A girl accidentally came to a world full of different caves, and she and a smiley face cube were looking for a way out. You will control this little girl to pass the levels and reach new caves one after another. The appearance of the cave is determined by the girl's cognition and memory. [Key Features] Explore caves, solving puzzles and find the exit. Having conversations with your smiley face cube fellow in each cave/level. 16 levels in total 4 different caves, 4 different topics(school, family, workplace, marriage). [tips] Keep an eye on the shiny areas in each cave/level. In order to make the exit/portal appear, the completion degree has to reach 80%, which mean you have to dig at least 80% of the soils in each cave. You may have to grab the keys to unlock the locks in the cave first. You may face spiders and other dangerous items, be careful!! Be aware that some of the content may be a little scary. [Special thanks] Russian localization: prosto_ratchet Special thanks to prosto_ratchet for testing the game and helping me find bugs!
row.short_description: Don't be TRAPPED by your life.

row.name: Blocky Ball OT
row.detailed_description: Blocky Ball OT!  The long awaited sequel to Blocky Ball!  Take your game to new heights as you compete against other players in 1v1 and 2v2 matches.  On top of that, there is a multitude of mini-games to refine your skills!  Dunk on your opponents and become the blocky baller you were born to be! Why are you still scrolling?  C'mon!  Join us!  Because...
row.short_description: Blocky Ball OT! The long awaited sequel to Blocky Ball is here! Take your game to new heights as you compete against other players in 1v1 and 2v2 matches. Additionally, there are several mini-games to refine your skills! Dunk on your opponents and become the blocky baller you were born to be!

row.name: Potyguara Verse
row.detailed_description: Potyguara Verse: Explore, Discover, and Connect in a New Virtual Universe Potyguara Verse is an innovative virtual reality platform that blends entertainment, culture, and exploration in an interactive and immersive environment. Inspired by the beautiful city of Natal (RN) , the game allows you to explore iconic tourist spots, participate in cultural events, and connect with other players—all from the comfort of your home. Here, you don’t just play—you live a unique experience , immersing yourself in Potiguar culture in an interactive way. Discover digitally recreated historical and natural landmarks , participate in cultural events, and engage with a vibrant community. By using a virtual reality headset , you can venture through captivating environments, engaging minigames, and unique experiences . Key Features: 🎭 Immersive Exploration: Visit Rio Grande do Norte’s most famous landmarks and discover new scenery with every visit. 🎶 Cultural Events: Participate in artistic and cultural experiences within the virtual environment. 🗣️ Social Interaction: Meet other players, make new friends, and join multiplayer events that bring people together from around the world . 🎮 Diverse Minigames: Test your skills in interactive challenges . With Potyguara Verse , culture and entertainment are right at your fingertips , combining cutting-edge technology, interactivity, and an educational experience . No matter where you are, your adventure begins now!
row.short_description: Explore Natal in an immersive way! Discover iconic tourist spots, participate in cultural events, and connect with players from around the world in an interactive and engaging Virtual Reality experience. 🎭🌍✨

row.name: Tangram Collection
row.detailed_description: Tangram Collection reimagines the classic tangram puzzle with a modern twist. Originating from China, tangrams challenge players to fit seven geometric pieces, or tans, into a specific shape without overlap. In Tangram Collection , you'll be presented with five diverse bundles, totaling over 100 puzzles , which promise to get you through a minimalist and relaxing experience. The clean and intuitive interface sets you in a world where you solve complex problems, making it perfect for both tangram enthusiasts and casual puzzle lovers. Key Features: 5 diverse bundles of tangrams Over 100 puzzles to be solved Minimalistic design for serenity Find the evolution of Tangrams with Tangram Collection .
row.short_description: Rediscover tangrams with Tangram Collection, a modern twist on the classic puzzle, offering over 100 challenges to solve.

row.name: Changeling VR
row.detailed_description: ChangelingVR is a virtual reality first-person interactive mystery. You play as detective Aurelia Walker, a private eye gifted with the unique ability to dream-walk, allowing you to see the thoughts and memories of anyone you touch. This gift leads the Summers-Manalo family to hire you, their last resort in discovering what is wrong with their baby. As you make contact with the mother, the father, and their two kids, you must use your mystical powers, as well as your skills of deduction, to enter their minds and make your way through their manifested hopes and fears to save the young child. Currently we have a curated story mode experience that includes our 4 most developed levels. The Acts: The Detective You begin within the mind of Aurelia. Here you are introduced to player controls. After awakening in your apartment, you will make way to the Monelo-Summers home and meet people in the neighborhood. With a touch you may see their memories along the way. Angela: Mother's Fear As Angela, you float through the detritus of memory trying to capture her family before they disappear. you will use shoot out ties to both move and grasp your family. Dylan: I Got This Dylan, the father, is faced with a series of puzzles. This level has physical puzzles set in first his commute which bleeds into his home. The level is in prototype stage. Douglas: Scribbles and Dreams Dougie is trying to understand what is happening to his family through his drawings. In this level you slingshot your way through puzzle platforms in his sketchbook.
row.short_description: ChangelingVR is a virtual reality first-person interactive mystery. Enter the thoughts of each one you touch: A different memory, a different world, a different story.

row.name: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad
row.detailed_description: A story-driven action-adventure RPG, bringing the world of Westeros to life with remarkable detail and never-before seen scale. WESTEROS HOLDS MANY SECRETS. DEFEND YOUR LEGACY. ======================================================= ■ Experience Westeros like never before Explore the seven kingdoms that make up Westeros in the vast open world of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad. Discover vivid landscapes, massive cities, backwater towns, untamed wilderness, and the people that inhabit them. Roam about iconic regions and locations. Take in everything from the splendor of King’s Landing to the frigid unease of Castle Black, located at the foot of the 700 feet tall Wall that stretches along the northern border of the Kingdom of the North, protecting the realm from horrors that lurk beyond. ■ Original Journey and New Storylines that Deepen the Lore Forge your own legacy as an illegitimate child from a small noble house in the North, House Tyre. Thrust into action by the death of your brothers and the looming threat of winter, you must embark on a mission to restore your house to its former glory. Solidify your political position, navigate the complex power struggles between the noble houses of Westeros, and seek out what allies you can, all while aiding the Night’s Watch in their preparations for the final confrontation with the White Walkers and their army of the dead that awaits just beyond the Wall. ■ Dynamic and immersive visceral ARPG combat Featuring fully manual controls, dodging, parrying, and emphasizing impactful and exhilarating swordfights, the game’s combat is designed to immerse players in intense and meaningful battles, allowing them to experience the thrill of combat as if they were part of the Game of Thrones world. Combat requires careful control and strategy as players dodge and counter opponents’ attacks, analyze their patterns, chain attacks and use unique skills to create strategic, skill-driven gameplay. ■ Choose your playstyle through distinct classes Game of Thrones: Kingsroad features three distinct classes, inspired by the iconic archetypes established in the original series: Knight, Sellsword, and Assassin. Each class comes with its own unique strengths and weaknesses, combat mechanics, and skills - enhancing the depth of each combat encounter and providing players with the options they need to play the combat style they prefer. ■ Co-op content in real time Encounter dangerous beasts and creatures of myth and legend from the Game of Thrones universe, Defeat them alongside other lords in the weirwood forest to earn generous rewards and craft high-end gear.
row.short_description: A story-driven action-adventure RPG, bringing the world of Westeros to life with remarkable detail and never-before seen scale.
row.notes: Game of Thrones: Kingsroad is an action-adventure RPG where players explore Westeros, grow into heirs through battles against threats beyond the Wall and various factions, and rebuild their houses. While performing missions, players use a variety of weapons (swords, axes, daggers, longbows, crossbows) to kill enemies. The combat process and battle scenes include realistic visual and auditory depictions of violence, which may feature blood, bloodstains, and corpses.

row.name: Leapventure: Countless Biomes
row.detailed_description: Show off your skills as you leap through diverse lands filled with deadly obstacles. Start on easy difficulty to master the movement mechanics before taking on tougher challenges. You play as a wisp with the unique ability to wall-jump, which will help you dodge enemies and navigate hazards. This mobility is key to conquering the different areas. Play solo or team up in local co-op to tackle all levels together. Only one player needs to reach the checkpoint, with others being teleported to it automatically after it's reached. row.name: Avoidy Virus
row.detailed_description: Play with 4-16 players online in this co-op action game as you try to survive a viral outbreak! A pandemic has hit the world hard and Humans are stuck in lockdown. Viruses chase down the Humans who are running against time, and Humans are desperate for lockdown supplies (like toilet paper)! Will you avoid the Viruses and help to save humanity? Or will you get infected and become a Virus yourself? Find out in this quirky, intense game of tag, where you can play with your friends and survive the pandemic together! Ready to save the world? Then enter at your own risk...it's addictively sick! Win by avoiding infection until the timer runs out. React quickly to dodge Viruses and collect vaccines!] Use vaccines to cure yourself or teammates in the sick state. Collect toilet paper and coins while you avoid the Virus. Strategically use vaccines and work together to maximise your chance of survival. One or more random players start as Viruses. Chase and infect Human players by bumping into them. Coordinate with other infected players to corner Humans. Prevent Humans from curing each other to increase your numbers! Win by infecting everyone. Infected Humans enter a 15-second sick state with slowed movement. Sick players must find a vaccine or be cured by a teammate before time runs out. If not cured within 15 seconds, sick players turn into Viruses! Features Customisation: Choose your character's appearance with various Human and Virus skins (more coming soon!. Purchase skins and customization items with coins. Unlock special skins and items with toilet paper! Quick-join option to find online games fast. Cross-platform play between PC, Android, and iOS! Cool and crazy maps (more coming soon!)
row.short_description: Survive lockdown with 4-16 players in this viral co-op game of tag. Avoid the virus, grab vaccines, and save your fellow humans. But beware - get sick and you'll join the viral invasion!

row.name: Spellchanted 2D Hidden Object Puzzle Adveture Tile-Matching
row.detailed_description: A Magical World In Peril In this world, every Fairy Tale you know is brought to life. Sleeping Beauty, Rapunzel, Prince Charming, Snow White and the Seven Dwarves are all here, ruling their own Kingdoms. But right now, they are in great peril... When a promising amateur witch named Alice decided to become a student of the great enchantress Circe, she certainly didn’t expect she would end up trying to save the Fairy Tale Kingdoms. And without your help, she won't succeed! Together you must stop Circe from becoming an evil Queen and taking over the world, in order to do that, you must break her curse! An Original Puzzle Gameplay Play addicting and original levels, where you try to find pairs or triples of identical objects before the time runs out. Remember that every level offers you a new mechanic. The objects you need to find could be differently colored, broken in halves, or of different sizes. You won’t see such innovative and challenging pair finding levels anywhere else! By playing these levels, you will earn stars, that you can spend on renovating your very own Wizard Mansion! As you renovate your adobe, it will be filled with flying brooms, mutant plants, and magical artifacts. Nobody knows what waits for you in the depth of the manor, keep on playing levels and earning stars to find out! A Magical Manor To Restore Every time you finish a set of tasks in your mansion, you’ll be able to play a jigsaw puzzle and unlock a new chapter of the story. Restoring your manor is fun and all, but remember we still need to stop the evil witch Circe! Every new chapter offers you different levels with original mechanics as well as unique locations to learn about. You can visit the Deep Dark Woods, Circe’s Tower, the Kingdom Of Sleeping Beauty and so much more! And if you ever feel stuck on a level, the magical power-ups, made for you by Alice, will surely help! Use the Fireflies to high-light a pair that is tricky to find, or the Time-Freezing Powder to have some extra playing time, your possibilities are endless! And Other Spellchanted Features: Choose your wizard and dive into a fantasy tale Help Alice stop the evil witch and become a master spell crafter Become an expert in 12+ pair finding mechanics Summon magical power-ups to find pairs and stop time Earn stars and rebuild your magical manor Unlock new story parts by solving jigsaw puzzles

row.name: Dairy of the Dead
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Overview Dairy of the Dead is a short, point-and-click, narrative-driven casual adventure where the player must help out several denizens of the post-zombie apocalyptic world to feed your grumpy, undead cat! Throughout the game, you as the player will: Feel like you are traveling with a moody, zombie kitty who constantly wants your attention (but it also really hates your guts for some reason!) Be entertained by the interactions with the humans and zombies you encounter. Have fun playing simple puzzles that needs little to no directions Key Features Solve Puzzles: Help Milwaukee crack the code to the zombie outbreak, rescue Missus. Whiskus from the Divine Office Overlord Helen, help Grocery Attendant Tiffany the Zombie find her missing eye, and crack the Krypt Currency Bank vault to get Missus. Whiskus her MILK! Talk to zombies: These zombies are friendly… just a little slower and stiffer. Talk to them and learn more about the world and what society is like 7 days after the zombie apocalypse. Story Your zombie-cat, Missus Whiskus needs milk and the online delivery site is down! Play as Alex and brave the streets during the zombie-apocalypse. Meet zany characters both living and dead, solve their puzzles, and find Missus Whiskus her milk! You wouldn’t want to get on her bad side would you? World/Setting Sometime in the very near future, a virus broke out that turned half of the world’s inhabitants - animals and humans alike - into zombies. No one knows the cause or how it started… And at this point, nobody cares. After the initial panic, the living realized the undead weren’t the hostile, brain-eating hoard often portrayed in the media. The zombies retained their identity; they just often lost their train of thought, didn’t need certain bodily functions, and - as one newscaster put it - “they move at a very leisurely pace”. It was less of an apocalypse and more like the invasion of grandparents. Thus, humanity continues to march forward… Albeit more slowly and stiffly.
row.short_description: Embark on a cozy post-apocalyptic adventure! Join Alex and his snarky feline companion, Missus Whiskus, as they navigate the bizarre landscape of zombified suburbia in search of the ultimate treasure: MILK! Solve puzzles, engage in witty banter, and keep Whiskus happy in this comedy puzzle game.

row.name: Alpaca Party
row.detailed_description: VR Werewolf Game You find yourself on a mysterious island where day and night alternate, and each moment is filled with challenges. During the sunny days, players transform into clever explorers, completing various mini-tasks to accumulate favor for their respective factions. This is the time to demonstrate your strategic and cooperative skills, as each choice may influence your fate. When night falls, the game enters its intense second half. Players are assigned to different factions by a mysterious force, and each faction has its unique missions. Your tasks may be secret or public, but the key is to complete them in order to secure victory. But don't forget, danger may lurk in the darkness, so always stay alert and protect yourself! Tour Mode While waiting for other players to join the Werewolf party, why not jump into our level mode to make your wait fun and challenging! Currently, we have two fantastic maps for you to explore: the Candleland filled with ghosts and the Mushroom Kingdom with giant mushrooms. Here, you will become a brave adventurer, using your jumping skills, carrying ladders, and other ingenious means to navigate through various meticulously designed levels. At the same time, don't forget to collect those shiny coins during your adventure; they can be used to participate in lotteries, winning accessories and items, and there are also Revival Stars for you to collect. Use them to exchange for unique special accessories and furniture, making your gaming experience even more enjoyable!
row.short_description: Alpaca Party is a free VR Party game. In this game, you can enjoy thrilling Werewolf gameplay, strategize with friends. You can also explore mysterious realms through portals,Whether you love strategic puzzles or relaxed social play, Alpaca Party has something for everyone.
