row.name: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi
row.detailed_description: Synopsis Unravel the mysteries of the Ancient Ones in this top-down Dungeon Crawler RPG that features the Takodachis by Ninomae Ina'nis from hololive English, unlock new abilities from within and call upon the skills of past Takodachis to reach the Ancient Ones. Collect potent items as you traverse the Labyrinth and utilize a plethora of Elemental Affinities to defeat the many Takodachis who guard the Labyrinth. Danger looms with Abyssal Mode which causes Takodachis to be lost forever should they be defeated in battle. Controls Z : Confirm / Normal Attack X : Cancel (Hold to run) C : Grid View A : Item Menu S : Set Move D : Diagonal Walk Enter : Menu (Control bindings can be remapped in game for both keyboard and controller.) The Lexicon Found on the second to last floor of every Labyrinth is an archive of past Takodachis as well as the abilities they had once possessed. Takodachis who use the Lexicon will be able to learn a variety of Assist Skills that they would not be able to learn through leveling up. The very first floor of the Labyrinth even has a special Lexicon that grants access to any Skill that has been previously recorded, including Melee and Magic based Skills. Affinities Melee and Magic based Skills will oftentimes possess an elemental Affinity which deals double or half damage to certain kinds of enemies based on their innate weaknesses. Using a Skill that an enemy is weak to will grant an Encore that lets the user perform another action before their turn ends. Enemies are also able to receive an Encore by dealing effective elemental damage. Elemental Affinities in Submerged Mystery: Takodachi are classified as Fire, Aqua, Elec, Wind, Light, and Dark. Skills are divided into three categories, Melee, Magic, and Assist. Melee Skills require a percentage of the user's HP in order to be used and the damage is determined by the user's Strength stat as well as the enemy's Defense stat. Magic Skills require a fixed amount of the user's MP in order to be used and the damage is determined by the user's Magic stat as well as the enemy's Resistance stat. Assist Skills require a fixed amount of the user's MP in order to be used and perform a variety of effects such as raising stats, lowering the enemy's stats, recovering health, and more. Ailments Certain offensive Skills have a percent chance of inflicting an Ailment onto a Takodachi on hit, there are even Assist Skills that are guaranteed to inflict an Ailment if they are not avoided. These Ailments have many different ways of affecting combat before they wear off after a certain number of turns. Burn : Deals a fixed amount of damage across 4 turns. Poison : Deals damage that gradually increases across 4 turns. Shock : Increases the odds of taking a Critical hit. Lasts for 2 turns and wears off upon taking damage. Dizzy : Greatly lowers the accuracy of Skills and attacks. Lasts for 2 turns and wears off upon taking damage. Blind : Halves the damage dealt by offensive Skills and prevents the evasion of incoming attacks. Lasts for 3 turns. Seal : Prevents Assist Skills from being used and causes any selected Assist Skills to fail. Lasts for 3 turns. Stats Each Takodachi possesses a distinct Stat spread that becomes more pronounced with each Level Up. Consult the Status Menu to see if a particular Takodachi is a balanced, mixed attacker or if they specialize in one kind of attacking type. HP : The amount of Health Points a Takodachi has to withstand hits. MP : The amount of Magic Points a Takodachi has for Magic based Skills. Strength : Determines the amount of damage dealt by Melee attacks. Defense : Reduces the damage that would be taken from Melee attacks. Magic : Determines the amount of damage dealt by Magical attacks. Resistance : Reduces the damage that would be taken from Magical attacks. Speed : Determines the turn order for using Skills and attacks. Affects the accuracy and evasion of attacks. Luck : Increases the Critical hit chance and decreases the odds of taking Critical hits. Affects the accuracy and evasion of ailments. Filters Within the Settings Menu of the Main Menu is a distinct feature that applies a palette of 4 colors onto the game for added replay value. Select between 22 palettes that are themed around hololive English as well as 3 retro inspired palettes. Swap between the modern and classic 8-bit soundtracks for the vintage experience. Disclaimer Submerged Mystery: Takodachi is not affiliated with hololive or Cover in any way. This project was made within the hololive Derivative Works guidelines. All visual and sound effect assets were specifically made for this game. All music assets within the game were derived from content belonging to hololive and Dova-Syndrome.
row.short_description: Brave the Labyrinth and obtain lost powers to overcome great challenges in this Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler adventure.

row.name: 天道荒本纪 Chronicles of the Celestial Way
row.detailed_description: Primordial Year 1: Origin In the beginning of Hongmeng (Primal Chaos), Pangu was born. Absorbing the most potent primordial energy (Yuanqi), his divine power was boundless. Yet, he sacrificed himself, transforming his body into all creation (Yanhua Wanwu), establishing the Human Realm (Renjie) as the greatest natural world. Millionth Year of Hongmeng: The First Ancient Gods Emerge After a million years, the primordial energy surged again, giving birth to the first generation of Ancient Gods (Gushen). Among them, the most powerful were few: Fuxi, Nuwa, Donghuang Taiyi, and Tianmo (the Celestial Demon). Two Millionth Year of Hongmeng: The Second Ancient Gods Emerge In the final surge of primordial energy, the second generation of Ancient Gods was born. Possessing less Hongmeng Qi, they were weaker, like Kua Fu, Xingtian, and Huang Niao. They could only depend on the powerful first-generation gods. 2.2 Millionth Year of Hongmeng: Conflict After eons, changes stirred within the hearts of the gods, especially Tianmo. He grew stronger by devouring space itself, becoming a public enemy. The gods battled Tianmo in the Outer Cosmos (Yuwai Xingkong). The war was brutal; many gods perished (giving rise to realms like the Demon Realm (Yaojie) and Ghost Realm (Guijie)). However, Tianmo's power exceeded their imagination. In the end, the gods could only combine their strength to seal him within the Outer Cosmos. Year 1 of the Primordial Era: The Reckoning Begins The gods settled in the Human Realm, forming various tribes. Thus began the true reckoning of years – the Primordial Era (Honghuang Li). Year 100 of the Primordial Era: War Persists Peace did not last. The Jiuli Tribe, followers of Tianmo, fiercely occupied their territory. The great tribes engaged in open and secret struggles, especially the five tribes of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. True peace eluded the Human Realm. Year 1000 of the Primordial Era: The Millennium Disaster Merely a thousand years passed before Tianmo's seal weakened. Seizing the opportunity, Tianmo leaked vast amounts of demonic energy (Moqi) through the cracks into the mortal world. The first Chiyou of the Jiuli tribe absorbed much of this energy, his power (Xiuwei) multiplying immensely. Under Chiyou's command, the Jiuli became invincible and unstoppable (Gongwubuke, Shirupozhu). Reluctantly, the Five Great Tribes formed an alliance to resist the mighty Chiyou, but they could merely hold back the invasion, resulting in a stalemate. Year 1506 of the Primordial Era: Nuwa Creates Humans To counter Chiyou, Nuwa, leader of the Earth Tribe, proposed the 'Plan of the Five Virtues Body' (Wude Zhi Ti). Using the unifying power of the Five Elements (Wuxing Heyi), she would mold humans from clay (Nietu Zaoren). However, Chiyou would not allow this plan to succeed and launched another war against the Five Great Tribes.
row.short_description: Action RPG: Battle, level up, enhance gear & challenge foes, dungeons, and players. Based on Chinese myths, ancient tribes warred. Five tribes unite against the mighty Chiyou. Nuwa plans to create humans using Wuxing power, but Chiyou attacks. Your adventure starts now!

row.detailed_description: Run on walls, catch up with opponents and deal with them like a real ninja: using katanas, kunai, hammers, and anything that comes to hand — even a frying pan. Did you fail and get dealt with? Immediately return to the game and punish the offender, no boring waiting! Remain the only one among 12 contenders for the title of the best ninja. Team up with a friend and lead your small ninja clan to victory. Cover your friend's back and become the best ninjas together! row.name: Zombie Murder 3
row.detailed_description: Zombie Murder is back! Take control of a powerful steel mech and smash crowds of zombies to pieces with driving heavy metal! Zombie Murder 3 is a new part of the Top Down Shooter game with a bunch of levels, bosses and upgrades. The game is back after many years and this time it goes 3D! The upgrade option has reached a new level: now you have as many as 25 skills that can be developed to enhance the robot's abilities. As well as permanent skills: Dash and Red Barrier, which allow you to dodge enemy attacks or completely absorb enemy shots, converting them into health and energy. Four difficulty levels: from the simplest, which everyone should be able to handle, to the insanely difficult one, where you will have to masterfully control the mech and wisely use all the resources of your robot. - 3D Top Down Shooter! Take control of a steel Mech and destroy zombies! - 25 skills to upgrade. - 4 difficulty levels. - Various monsters and bosses! - Dynamic gameplay to the fiery Heavy Metal!

row.name: STAaRS
row.detailed_description: Step into the Unknown Welcome to STAaRS, a unique investigative simulation where you take on the role of a volunteer tasked with uncovering unknown activities. In STAaRS, you will navigate a 24-hour test where strange events appear randomly in a virtual house. Investigate and Report When an activity is detected, you'll enter the virtual house through a portal to investigate. Your mission is to observe, categorize, and report these activities, which are divided into four key areas: Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality. Test Your Skills This simulation challenges your observational abilities and decision-making under pressure, preparing you for real-world scenarios. Key Features 22 unique mysterious activities to investigate and uncover. Dynamic 24-hour test with random event occurrences (each test up to 25-30 real-time minutes). Interactive portal-based investigation system. Detailed categorization and reporting mechanics. Immersive environment designed to test your skills. STAaRS offers a challenging and immersive experience where every decision matters. Are you ready to face the unknown?
row.short_description: In STAaRS, you play as a volunteer investigating unknown activities in a simulated environment. During a 24-hour test, events appear randomly, and you enter the virtual house via a portal to investigate. Observe, categorize, and report events based on Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality.

If only lifting your brush didn't fill your fingertips with agony. It Paints Me is a short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain, and love. It features: 3.9k words 3 endings hand drawn artwork original music partial voice acting Art, music, story, programming & sound design by ENDYSIS. Casting by Phebe Fabacher Voice Mixing by Mark Mullens Cast Sam - Callum Sanders Marie - Shellah Sam's Mother - Maria Corcobado Sam's Father- Ethan Grant
row.short_description: Take the role of a painter struggling to finish his masterpiece in this short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain and love.

row.name: Satisfactory Modeler
row.detailed_description: Model your Satisfactory builds. Set up your machines however you like, adding optional limits to the number of any of those machines and the tool will calculate how the parts will flow and how many of each machine type are getting used. This does advanced calculations that no other Satisfactory planning tool can do, including figuring out how splitters and mergers will split and merge and even priority splitting. This also supports outposts which allow you to logically group buildings together in sub-sections, allowing unlimited amount of canvas space to work.
row.short_description: Model your Satisfactory builds. Set up your machines however you like, adding optional limits to the number of any of those machines and the tool will calculate how the parts will flow and how many of each machine type are getting used.

row.name: Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation
row.detailed_description: 'Magic exists all around; your whole body and mind can be a conduit.' Alice and Sophie have been in a long distance relationship since they graduated from the Ira Royal Academy for talented magic users. Sophie has stayed on campus as a researcher, while Alice ventured to the world outside of academia. Finally, Sophie gets some time off, and the couple reunites for an onsen vacation! However, things are not how they seem at the hot spring hotel... several mysterious events appear to target the Alice and Sophie. Is the hotel haunted, or is there a powerful magical enemy afoot? *Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation* occurs after the events of *Death Becomes You*. It is not required to have read *Death Becomes You* or *A Summer with the Shiba Inu* by our developer friends, but there are some references to the two games that readers may appreciate. Features Kinetic visual novel (no choices) ~8,000 word story Original sprite art, and 2 CGs (cutscenes) Extras gallery Exclusive developer Q&A Steam achievements Original game jam version launch option
row.short_description: Alice and Sophie finally have the time to go on an onsen retreat. However, their trip gets inturrupted by mysterious magic. The last straw: 'MY FOOD!!!' Will the couple be able to find the culprit and finally enjoy their vacation?

row.name: Dollhouse
row.detailed_description: Dollhouse is an extreme asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience that will make you shriek in fright. Scramble around in the dark as one of nine victims locked inside a house of horror. In the Dollhouse there is a fine line between predator and prey. Will you cower in the shadows, or hunt the weak? Only three people can escape the Dollhouse, so only the best can survive. Or play as one of three relentless killers and hunt your victims. Every game is a unique, terrifyingly deathmatch. Will you survive? NO, you will DIE!!! One for All: Dollhouse is a chaotic free-for-all deathmatch, a relentless struggle where no one is truly safe. Your objective: escape the labyrinthine Dollhouse. But only three players will taste freedom. Will you cower and hide or run from those that wish you harm? Or will you embrace the predator within, scavenge for weapons and ruthlessly cull the herd, ensuring your own survival at the expense of others? Do whatever it takes to claw your way to freedom, for only the most ruthless will survive. Back from the Dead: Every game someone will play as a spooky killer, out for blood. And when the first two victims die, they are transformed into hunters, their sole purpose to stalk and eliminate the remaining victims. However, the third player to fall will return as the cop, tasked with protecting the survivors from the relentless onslaught of the hunters. The balance of power shifts with every death, adding another layer of tension to the already chaotic struggle. Darkness is you Ally: The Dollhouse is shrouded in oppressive darkness, your only source of light is your handy torch. But wielding this light comes at a heavy price. Your torch is a double-edged sword, others stalk the darkness and the light will betray your position to lurking villains. Search diligently in the darkness for random weapons and items that spawn throughout the house each game. These are your only tools, your only means of survival and escape in this deadly game of cat and mouse. Play your way: Dollhouse has six premiere game modes. There is the classic asymmetrical horror experience, a gun game in the dark, close-quarters deathmatch!! Infected onslaught, the special imposters among us game mode and last but not least BATTLEROYALE!!!
row.short_description: Dollhouse is an extreme asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience. Scramble around in the dark as one of nine terrified victims locked inside a labyrinth of terror. Will you cower in the shadows, or hunt the weak? Only the most best will survive.
row.notes: Game is set in horror house with murderous children and adults trying to kill each other.

Game Features You can experience unique word puzzle gameplay. You can experience classical Chinese art and soundtracks.

Get a random new cutie every 3 hours — or even sooner if you tap fast and use the right strategy. Some cuties are ultra-rare. Some are… legendary. 💘 Build your dream collection Each cutie has her own personality, dialogue, and now — a full story you can unlock as you bond. Meet tsunderes, yanderes, dommy mommies, goth gfs, bunnygirls, weirdos, hackers, artists, witches, dreamwalkers, disaster lesbians, and more. New cuties and features are added with every update. Whether you’re a casual collector or a long-term simp strategist, there’s always someone new to fall for. 🥚 Crafting, Clicking, Candies & More Not just luck — you can now collect shards and craft Eggs to hatch your favorite cuties. Tap to build affection, reduce cooldowns, and earn higher-tier drops. The deeper your account level, the better your chances at scoring rares. And yes — candies are still here. But they’ve been… rebalanced. 🍬 📖 Storylines & Secrets Each cutie now has a full storyline you can unlock right in their gallery. Learn their pasts, obsessions, heartbreaks, philosophies, and maybe… what they think about you . 😳 Some are funny. Some are spicy. Some are deeply unwell. You’ll love them all. 🌸 Runs on a potato Clicker Cuties runs on just about anything. Minimize it, let it idle in the background, or go full speedclicker — it won’t complain. ~ I can’t wait to meet you, anon ~
row.short_description: 💗 Idler Clicker + Dating Sim 💗 Meet virtual cuties, care for them, and get to know their stories!
row.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content

row.name: Short Memories
row.detailed_description: Short memories is a very short game about two women discussing on a bench. This game is about normalizing being and becoming old . You'll navigate trough different minigames, led by a dialogue, that will show you different aspects of elderliness. Being or becoming old and all that it implies, is a very normal part of your life. Short Memories tries to not talk about what we are scared of during this stage in life (sickness, death or other difficulties). But just showing two people that are living it having a normal conversation. The game is playable only with your mouse and you'll have to finish 3 minigames to reach the end of it. All of those minigames are difficult in their own way, and they try to translate what difficulties older people can encounter. All that translated to clunky game mechanics. You'll also follow a short conversation between our 2 ladies on their favourite bench, talking about what life was, what it is and what it will be. Hope you enjoy Short memories , it was made with love ! ✨✨✨
row.short_description: A short story about life shared through the conversation of two women sitting on a bench.

row.name: Crystal Cave
row.detailed_description: Crystal Cave is a labor of love from three passionate developers, designed to immerse you in a magical world that will linger in your heart long after you’ve finished playing. Darkness has fallen over a once-prosperous kingdom, defeating its only protector — Princess Ailina. It’s up to you to step in and rescue the princess from her dark chains. To do so, you must overcome trials to obtain the magical flower Nilúria, which holds the key to saving Ailina and the entire kingdom. What Awaits You: Stunning Graphics: Explore the enchanting Forest of Dreams, where a green-clad wizard reveals your quest. In the Sunset Meadow, where the sun never sets, meet two more wizards and face their trials. First, you’ll guide the flow of water through darkness and light. Then, you’ll strategically place crates in their hidden shadows. Your journey culminates in the breathtaking Cave of the Moon Falls, where you can fill your flask with magical water before returning to the Forest of Dreams to complete your quest. Engaging Dialogues: Uncover the deep secrets behind the kingdom’s power struggles. Perhaps the princess isn’t who she appears to be. Along the way, the World Bees will impart three important lessons. Challenging Mini-Games: Experience simple yet satisfying mechanics like dragging objects and directing water flow. Hints are available to guide you, including shadows for crate placement and a full-fledged hint system in the water channeling mini-game. A Short but Sweet Adventure: While the journey includes several mini-games, it’s designed to be completed in a concise and fulfilling playthrough. .
row.short_description: Can you focus and conquer the trials set by the three wizards? Don’t waste a moment—dive into this unforgettable adventure now!

row.name: A Shade Darker Than Gray
row.detailed_description: Short. casual, dark comady story game based in a fictional gray world. You go to school and make your way through the day while trying to survive. You may be bullied, insulted, bruised, and cut but at least your alive right? It's like a visual novel but with walking to make you feel more alone! This game only has one available language, which is English. Come down the rabbit hole of depression, exploring a boring color scape as you try to make sense of the world in one day. This game uses primarily four to five colors to give off that extra sense of dread. Where better to go than school! Missing the bus here is no big deal you can walk. But remember it's just a game! About 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings, 8 collectibles, and some mini games. Side content such as small event. and funny quotes. Over 100+ different quotes to find throughout. Unfortunatly there is no controller support as of this version.
row.short_description: Short dark comady, casual story game about 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings and 8 collectibles, and 3 different mini games. Over 100+ funny quotes to find throughout and loads of side events to interact with.
row.notes: Some blood, some references to suicide, and a few swears.

row.name: Anima
row.detailed_description: CONTROLS A controller is required to play this game. STORY Groupe Titan LLC was a mining mega-corporation in the 22nd century. Following the collapse of the environment, humanity is lost... when two maintenance robots are awakened by a mysterious entity. They start looking to see if they can understand what happened... and how to save life on Earth. GAMEPLAY Play Anima by switching between two characters: Min.I, a perky maintenance robot that can run and jump over obstacles and bounce up some walls, and Andro.ID, a bigger and slower robot capable of using the Anima energy and magnetism to move objects around her. They must cooperate to solve puzzling platforming sequences that stand as they repair their broken world. Lift magnetic elements from the surroundings, construct and deconstruct objects with the Anima energy, bounce off the walls, and make your way through the gigantic station! Featuring 2 playable characters. A story mode and bonus levels of pure platforming pleasure! Paths that must be altered to allow the characters to pass through. A post-apocalyptic sci-fi environment that tells a story of regret and hope. Running, jumping and bouncing your way through the path you puzzled out. PRODUCTION  Anima is a student project produced in 15 weeks by the 2023-2024 cohort of the Campus ADN, a public video game college in Montreal, under supervision of industry professionals.
row.short_description: Anima is a puzzle-platformer in mysterious technological surroundings. Use your controller to move and deconstruct obstacles in an abandoned mining station through two of its robots, Min.I and Andro.ID. Make a path to your goals, run, jump and bounce to discover what became of your creators!

row.name: Pick Me Pick Me
row.detailed_description: Get ready to charm, sabotage, and survive the most ridiculous speed dating showdown ever.  Will you win love - or get left in the dust? What Players Are Saying: 'I had to bite my tongue to not laugh when I saw your character turn around with that clown nose!' - Realsleepy, Discord member Compete against friends in chaotic AI speed dating! Flirt, sabotage, and outwit rivals to win bizarre characters' hearts. Fast, funny, and full of surprises-who scores the perfect date? Compete directly against your friends in fast-paced speed dating battles! Use your wit and strategic sabotage cards to out-charm your rival and win the affection of bizarre, unforgettable AI characters. It’s a hilarious test of friendship and flirting skills! Love is war. Flirt accordingly. Want to practice your game or just enjoy some digital romance? Chat one-on-one with over 20 unique AI characters-from smooth talkers and adorable weirdos to fantasy creatures with very human problems. Build relationships at your own pace without interference. Not a fan of the official cast? Design your own bizarre dating prospects! Upload custom models, set personalities, and challenge friends with your creations. Share your wildest characters with the community and keep the chaos fresh. 🎮 Key Features   Dynamic AI conversations: Experience unique, real-time interactions every playthrough powered by a Large language model 20+ dateable characters: Meet distinct personalities with unique quirks and stories Cross-platform play and save: Challenge friends anywhere on PC and mobile. Strategic skill cards: Buff yourself or sabotage your rival's romantic moves for hilarious outcomes. Multilingual matchmaking: Play with friends around the world, supporting English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, and Portuguese. User-Generated Content: Create and share your own characters via Workshop for endless dating possibilities Global leaderboards: See how you rank in the chaotic speed dating scene. Players speaking different languages can play together! Since Pick Me Pick Me is available in multiple languages, you can face off against your friend even if you don't speak the same language. Argue in the language you’re most comfortable with and challenge your opponent, no matter what they speak! 'Pick Me Pick Me' is a perfect party game for players who enjoy competitive, yet lighthearted, gaming experiences with a unique AI twist.   💸 Free Trial + In-Game Currency Unlocks Start playing for free - everyone gets trial rounds to experience the chaos! Full access requires purchasing in-game currency (which covers AI token costs) to unlock unlimited dating battles, custom characters, deeper relationship building, and premium storylines. Whether you're in it for love, laughs, or total romantic victory, Pick Me Pick Me delivers an unforgettable mix of chaos, charm, and comedy. With endlessly unique AI interactions, custom content, and competitive flair, it’s the ultimate showdown of heart and wit. So suit up, swipe in, and may the most ridiculous dater win! 💰 What are the Different Currencies in-game? CASH 💸 Cash is the currency used after your date tickets have run out, or if you want to talk with characters in Solo Chat. PVP Battle:  50 Cash =1 Date Ticket Solo Chat: 5 Cash =1 Message  COINS 🪙 Coins are the currency used to unlock characters and purchase clothes, hair, and accessories in the store. How do you earn coins? (WIN) PvP Game = 1000 Coins (LOSE) PvP Game = 500 Coins Solo Chat - when you receive a reply from a character = 50 Coins Character Affinity Milestone Rewards DATE TICKETS 🎟️ Date Tickets are used for PvP Battle 1 Date Ticket = 1 PvP game * If the room setting 'It's on me' is selected, then the host will consume 2 tickets instead *After you run out of date tickets, you will automatically use any available Cash instead. MONTHLY PASS & VIP STATUS 🔓 A Monthly Pass is a special package available in the store for $9.99. row.name: 9 Years of Dreaming
row.detailed_description: 9 Years of Dreaming is an action-adventure game that takes you deep into the subconscious of Jacob, a man who has been in a coma for nine years following a devastating car accident. While his body remains in the hospital, Jacob's mind is trapped in a surreal dreamscape where he meets Lumby, an enigmatic character who seeks to guide him towards awakening. Within this dream, Jacob must journey through five unique worlds, each representing a different aspect of his psyche. These worlds are guarded by powerful bosses that Jacob must confront and defeat if he hopes to escape his prolonged slumber and return to reality. Throughout the game, Jacob unlocks three distinct abilities that aid him in his quest, offering new ways to overcome challenges. Mastering these abilities is key to progressing through each world and ultimately piecing together the path to his awakening. Along the way, Jacob will encounter a variety of NPCs—each with their own stories, struggles, and conflicts. These characters add depth to the world, revealing fragments of lore and engaging Jacob in arguments. The enemies that Jacob faces are manifestations of his inner fears and doubts, though they are unaware of the role they play in his dream. Instead, they exist as obstacles that Jacob must overcome, representing the internal battles he must face to regain consciousness. Will Jacob manage to wake up and escape the labyrinth of his own mind? Or will he remain lost in the dream forever? 9 Years of Dreaming is a poignant exploration of the human spirit, resilience, and the power of the subconscious.
row.short_description: 9 Years of Dreaming is an action-adventure game where you explore the subconscious of Jacob, who has been in a coma for nine years after a car accident. Trapped in a surreal dreamscape, Jacob meets Lumby, a mysterious guide who helps him on his journey to wake up.

row.name: Dungeon CEO Demo
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Dungeon CEO's chaotic world, where Victorian-era charm meets strategic mayhem. As the newly appointed CEO of Dungeon Company, you are forced into a world where gods, adventurers, and strange entities lurk beyond the dungeon's walls. What is your mission? Keep your monster workforce alive, manage resources effectively, and earn as much gold as possible—all while striking a delicate balance between profit and danger. Every decision in this roguelike strategy card game matters. Hire the best personnel, build a powerful deck, and be ready for tough turn-based fights. Each card in your deck can change the tide of battle by commanding and boosting your forces, allowing you to outwit and overpower your opponents. Defeat enemies to earn cash, grow your dungeon empire, and bring the Dungeon Company to the pinnacle of grandeur. Will you take your firm to new heights, or will you fall to the turmoil that lurks below? **Note : This game is a free demo. The dev team needs support and feedback to continue development.
row.short_description: Take on the role of a Victorian-era Dungeon CEO. Manage resources, recruit monsters, and customize your deck to dominate turn-based fights. Outwit your opponents, acquire coins, and lead the Dungeon Company to victory in a world teeming with adventures and gods.

row.name: 次元探索簿
row.detailed_description: Game Name: Adventure Book in Dimension Game type: Long-term update operational RPG TAG: Fantasy / Drama / RPG / General Orientation / Japanese Style / Drama / Gacha Development / Turn-based Combat / Dubbing / Headless girl/ Shower / Free / Novel Adaptation Game Production Engine: RPGmakerVX ACE (RMVA) Game window: 640*480 Parent project: Dimensional Journey Version Info: V2.21  (only available on PC) The latest version was released: November 8, 2024 'Adventure Book in Dimension' is a long-term operational turn-based RPG game affiliated with the project 'Dimensional Journey', adapted from the novel 'Wonderful Dimensional Journey' (the original author served as a copywriter and operation planner in the game). In the game, as a new member of the 'Tribal Clan', a team of human magicians, you received a magic book called 'Adventure Book in Dimension' as a gift from a mysterious senior. It is said that through this magic book, you can immerse yourself in the main adventure story of the 'tribal clan', and the story of the dimensional journey is unfolded in the form of an RPG. The audience of the game is average-oriented, with a cute Japanese anime style and combat dubbing, and the headless horseman mother as a characteristic setting, while incorporating 'drenching culture' related stalks. The game is a long-term operation with regular updates and events, and is completely free without any paid content. Players can not only experience the story, but also participate in high-difficulty challenge gameplay. Use the keyboard throughout the game, ↑↓←→ keys to move the character/cursor, spacebar/Z key to confirm, X key to return/open the backpack, F6 to zoom in on the screen, and hold shift to sprint. 【 Main story 】 From 'Adventure Book in Dimension', the player first enters the main story. In the game, players take on the role of a new member of the Tribe Family, a team of human wizards. In order to understand the adventure story of the founding of the tribal clan, you borrow a magic book called 'Adventure Book in Dimension' from a mysterious elder. It is said that through this book, the adventure story of the Dimensional journey will be presented in the form of an RPG game. In this way, your journey of discovery begins, and explore the adventure that is different from the original. The main story of the dimensional exploration book is adapted from the enemy olive's novel 'Wonderful Dimensional Journey', planning 800,000 words of fiction and a huge world view and plot to provide material for the main story of the game. In addition, the main story of the dimensional journey is currently divided into four parts, respectively: The first Dimensional Magical World (Seasons 1-6), the Second Otherworld (seasons 7-11), the third Neverland (seasons 12-14), and the fourth Dream Feather (seasons 15-18). The latest project schedule is the 15th season 'Past Life Aria', the current version of the Dimensional Exploration book (version 2.1) has been updated to the second season 8. 【 Character Acquisition 】 The first time you enter the main story, you can get the main character trio R DDW (Sage/doctor), R Potato (Break Army/Archer), R Star Pig (Sage/Caster), and other characters can be obtained by drawing cards. At the beginning of the main line card pool, there are only five permanent SSR characters: SSR Lingxin Elizabeth (brave/warrior), SSR Su Jiu (Sage/knight), SSR Di Yan (Sage/Caster), SSR Nikhe (Sage/Leader), SSR Baki Andian (Sage/Caster), and resident SR Cat God (sage/priest). As the player progresses through the main story, more and more main limited SR/SSR characters will be added to the card pool for the player to draw. In addition, in addition to the main line card pool, the game card system also has weapon card pool, special card pool, Lord card pool, current main line UP card pool, current weapon card pool, etc. In addition, players are free to choose their favorite card theme, each card theme has its own card background and BGM. [Three Phases and character classes] Three phases (the brave, the broken army, the Sage) are three dimensions used to measure the character in the dimensional universe, and each phase can improve the various attributes of the magician in different proportions. The highest of the three phases of the character is called the 'main phase', where red represents the brave, green represents the broken army, and blue represents the sage. Classes are used to describe the main battle position of the character, and there are twelve classes in the game: Warrior: A character with both survivability and output. Caster: A character whose primary ability is to inflict magic damage. Knight: A character whose main ability is to reduce the damage taken by teammates. Priest: A character whose primary ability is to restore their energy/special effects. Leader: A role whose main ability is to provide us with gains. Archer: A character whose main ability is high unit output. Doctor: A role in which healing is our primary competence. Wizard: A character whose primary ability is to use items or inflict negative effects on enemies. Summoner: A character whose primary ability is to summon summoners with combat abilities. Priest: A character whose primary ability is to inflict special boosts on us other than damage. Agent: A character whose primary ability is a special skill mechanic. Medicine Man: A character whose primary ability is to use items to fight. Through the combination of the main three phases and occupation, each role has a combination of the main three phases and occupation, for example, the main three phases of Lingyu Elizabeth is the sage and the occupation is the priest. 【 Delicate Japanese painting style 】 We have a relatively fixed team of artists. The planners and producers regularly invite artists to contribute new art resources such as character drawing, skin drawing and material ICONS to the game. Every one of our character sketches, skin sketches, illustrations, and some of the most important game ICONS are commissioned by a designer or producer. 【 Role Dubbing 】 Starting with version 1.4, the Dimensional Exploration Book includes combat voice acting for all resident SSR characters, mainline Limited SSR characters, Special SER characters, Lord SP characters, and some Paradise Limited SSR characters (Headless girls). The voice acting of other characters is also in progress, and the follow-up will be implemented one after another. The voice acting of the game is performed by the voice acting team of the Dimensional Journey Project, and each character voice acting has been reviewed and adjusted by the project manager and the project's two voice acting directors. Note: If your voice condition is good, Mandarin level reached second level A and above, we also welcome you to audition, paid/unpaid dubbing we have. 【 Skin system 】 There is a skin system in the game, and character skins can be redeemed through in-game 'skin fragments'. After replacing the skin, the avatar will appear as a skin, and the skin sketch will be displayed when it is the character's turn to act during combat. The skin quality is divided into four levels: 'Fine', 'Epic', 'Supreme' and 'Heavenly Artisan', among which, when wearing the skin of supreme quality and above, some characters will be replaced with the voice of the skin special version. When you wear the highest quality 'Artisan' skin, you will also receive an exclusive 'draw card theme' for that skin. Note: There is a cumulative spending limit skin in the game, such skin refers to the cumulative consumption of 'project points (obtained by participating in the planner's activities, no money channels, exploration book is a non-profit game) to earn the skin, not gold. In addition, we will introduce some version limited skins based on the version content (which will be copied). 【 Paradise of Headless knight mother 】 There are also a number of unique character types: Headless girls (dullahan), and in the event world, you can also enter the gathering area of headless girls - aerial paradise, for a special aerial paradise line plot. Players can also obtain these characters in the corresponding park limited card pool. In addition, in the version of the activity, you can also see the headless girl figure. 【 Equipment and Character Development System 】 In the Dimensional Exploration Book, you can develop the characters and equipment you gain to become stronger. Role upgrade: As the level of the role increases, the basic attributes of the role will be greatly improved. You can use Experience balls to assign character experiences. Weapon systems: Weapons can be purchased in stores, copies dropped, and cards drawn. The weapon is divided into three parts: base three phase panel, stat bonus and weapon skill. Weapons advanced: The weapons of the dimensional exploration book can improve their attributes by advancing, the real quality skin can be advanced to the highest level I, and the best quality skin can be advanced to the highest level II. Weapon progression requires the consumption of the weapon's corresponding series of credentials and stone (obtained by challenging the 'Sky Ladder'). Magic Marks System: Magic Marks can greatly improve the character's attributes, and each character can assemble four magic marks. Mark upgrade: Level 123 marks can be dropped directly through the store or copy, level 4 and above need to use the level 3 mark or the corresponding mark crystal to upgrade. The material consumed by the magic Mark upgrade can be obtained by challenging the 'Sky Ladder' in high difficulty. Character traceability: After the player passes the 60th floor of the Sky ladder, the character can be traced to reach level 100 (full level), and the traceability system will increase the skill effect of the character. Magic Card System: Version 2.0 is a new system that opens when the player passes through the 90th level of the Sky Ladder, similar to the Onmyoji soul system, which provides the character with basic attributes while collecting the magic card set to gain additional effects. 【 Version activity 】 The Dimensional Discovery Book regularly releases version events, each ending after two major versions of the actual installation. In the version activity. From the campaign story, campaign map, character interaction, campaign combat and other gameplay, the campaign tokens earned during the campaign can also be used to redeem items in the campaign store that can significantly increase the strength of the character. In addition, the limited skin, activity card pool and so on are opened with the version activity. 【 Sky Ladder 】 The Sky Ladder is a difficult challenge of the Dimensional exploration book, and every major version will update 15 layers, with a BOSS for every 5 layers. By challenging the ladder, the player can obtain a large amount of ladder crumbs (for weapon advancement and magic mark upgrades), and improve their strength. The current version of the ladder has 165 floors at the top. 【 Other gameplay 】 The rest of the Dimensional Exploration book is in the Time Station (Active world). 【 Race 】 The Discovery book will launch a racing competition every six months (during winter and summer vacations). The racing competition is divided into junior, intermediate and advanced fields. Players participating in the racing competition need to use their own archives to beat the BOSS specially prepared by the producer for the racing competition. 【 Version Update 】 The Dimensional Exploration Book version 2.1 is now available, and details of the updates are available in the game.

row.detailed_description: Due to the limited capacity of the production team, this game does not have an English mode, please understand. Chinese users can switch to the 'Chinese Simplified' mode to view the introduction. 《鲤氏奇人异闻录》（以下统称“本作”）是《明日方舟》（以下统称“原作”）的同人游戏。 本作以原作角色“老鲤”为主角（本作中名为“鲤”），玩家将以“鲤”的视角展开一系列解谜探案故事。 本作为同人作品，同人倾向为：老鲤中心，无CP，剧情向，一般向。 tips：本作剧情相对独立，即便您对《明日方舟》没有了解，也可以将本作当作一款普通的文字解谜游戏游玩！ 本作主要故事发生在炎国龙门，故事时间在原作主线序章（1097年）约二十年前，世界观及背景设定尽量贴近原作，但在原作基础上进行了一定的 必要延展 ，如有错漏，敬请谅解。 本作登场人物中，鲤（老鲤）、老董（董阿伯）、林（鼠王林舸瑞）、魏彦吾、蔡老板（菜贩老蔡）为原作角色，由于故事发生在二十年前，本作对他们进行了少量重新演绎，OOC之处，敬请谅解； 其余人物均为本作原创角色 。 除“源石”及“源石技艺”相关设定外，本作所涉及的基础科学原理均与现实相符。 本作完全免费 ，无任何商业性质，不包含任何收费项目。 本作为悬疑解谜游戏，剧情涉及凶杀案件，包含少量血腥画面及血腥暴力相关的文字描写，推荐16岁以上玩家游玩，建议18岁以下玩家谨慎游玩。 本作所描写、展示的内容（包括且不限于所有画面及文字）均属艺术设计需要，不代表创作者认同、允许或鼓励作品中所提及的任何行为及立场。 本作属于虚构作品，作品内所有人名、组织、地点、事件等均属虚构，如有雷同，纯属巧合。 二十年前 年轻的老鲤初至龙门 被卷入一起凶案 案情复杂奇诡 引来龙门黑白两道重要人物关注 为尽早脱困 本无意招惹是非的鲤 决定主动追查真凶 找到真相 这一遭 究竟是 天命难违 亦或 人定胜天 且看他 回首处 但思善恶 笑语 无问吉凶 在本游戏中，玩家将 扮演年轻时的老鲤 ，作为一名侦探，调查发生在龙门的数起案件。 游戏基本形式为阅读故事（类似《明日方舟》剧情部分）。 初入龙门，就从结识新朋友开始吧！ （游戏开始界面。达成任意结局后，可开启鉴赏模式。） （剧情界面。可点击对话框右侧的按钮进行多项操作，具体操作方法可参考以下“操作方式”说明。） 剧情推进至一定阶段时，随着“案件”发生，将出现“调查”“问询”“分析”等特殊环节。 【调查】： 点击特殊场景中的可调查物品，收集线索。 【问询】： 与案件相关角色对话，收集线索。 【分析】： 根据收集到的线索解答一系列问题，分析真相。 （在剧情推进过程中，可随时查看已经收集到的线索。） 在剧情推进过程中，还会出现不同的 “分支选项” 。 根据案情分析正确与否、以及对分支选项的选择情况，目前共规划 8种可达成结局 。 （序章开始界面。敬请期待鲤的探案故事！(*^▽^*) // ） 鼠标左键or空格键or回车键：确认/进行对话 鼠标右键：返回/隐藏对话框 鼠标滚轮向上：浏览历史记录 鼠标滚轮向下：进行对话 对话框右上角按钮功能： 单击“自”按钮：自动对话/自动运行游戏；单击画面任意位置可解除自动运行 单击“速”按钮：快速跳过对话；单击画面任意位置可解除快速跳过 单击“储”按钮：进入存储界面，可进行存档 单击“取”按钮：进入读档界面，可进行读档 单击“证”按钮（白色按钮）：进入线索界面，查看目前已获得的线索 单击“设”按钮：进入系统设置界面，可调整显示模式、音量、跳过对话条件等内容；可退回开始界面或关闭游戏 单击右下角“眼睛”按钮：隐藏对话框 单击右下角“箭头”按钮：浏览历史记录 制作/发行：顽童计划 主催/制作人：茶叶 本游戏使用THE NVL Maker制作 程序：茶叶 编剧 · 撰稿：茶叶 参与撰稿 · 第一章：林景 人物立绘美术：白叶 线索图标美术：白叶 CG · 剧情插画：白叶 CG · 剧情插画/GUEST：猫切希尔郡 调查环节美术：未雨喵喵 场景美术 · 绘制部分：未雨喵喵 场景美术 · 照片改绘部分：风灵 场景美术 · 照片转制部分：茶叶 照片来源：实地拍摄（茶叶）、pxhere（符合网站使用规约） UI美术：茶叶 音乐 · 授权曲库：麋鹿 音效来源于以下网站 · 均符合使用规约： 小森平的免费下载音效 ザ·マッチメイカァズ 爱给网 其他杂务：茶叶 ============================ 2024 年 10 月

row.name: Parkour Chief: Chapter Secret Agent
row.detailed_description: In the distant future, a hyper-advanced CPU has been developed by the government. The CyberQuark Corporation has stolen this powerful technology to create a fleet of destructive AI robots. As a secret agent, your mission is to retrieve the stolen CPU and prevent CyberQuark from unleashing their deadly creations. row.name: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity
row.detailed_description: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity (OMUI) is a first-person narrative horror game about humankind’s suicidal instincts, interweaving grand geopolitical destruction with personal tragedy. It unfolds as a world-ending nightmare: a playful childhood afternoon quickly descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the sudden death of my Uncle Ramin. Players should expect a deeply personal and tragic experience designed to place you in the shoes and eyes of a child in my own family as the Islamic revolution came and went, followed by the Iran-Iraq War, scattering us in a hundred different directions and uprooting thousands of people from their ancestral land. Except, in this reality, the nuclear apocalypse comes in its place - and who but Ramin can stop it? You will take on his impossible quest to save his family as the nightmarish reality collides with hallucinations of his real life. What features should one expect?  Explore a 1970s style Tehran apartment in a first-person perspective.  Play with toys, examine photographs, and struggle to understand the relationships of an Iranian family. Watch the Shah on TV, try to flip the channels, and piece together the dynamic political situation of Iran from the arguments of the adults.  Listen to the Shah's final speech to the Iranian people. Run for your life and seek shelter. Control Ramin as a pilot in his battle against nuclear demons and repressed memories.  Confront Ramin in his final moments.  Immerse yourself in the primeval destruction of Iran.  Find your family in the spirit world and prepare for your journey to the Upper Realm. Coming to peace with what happened was a long and arduous process. Making this game helped me immensely, but sometimes what was meant to be a way to let go grows into a means to hold on. It is with gratitude to the spirits and to history that I present the complete first edition of Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity in time for the tenth anniversary of a world without Ramin. It's true that the past is the past, but that doesn't mean we can't change how we feel about it. For the world to heal, we too must mend.  Let us end the war with reality together.
row.short_description: OMUI is a first-person narrative horror game set in an alternate reality 1970s Iran. A playful childhood afternoon in Tehran descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the suicide of my Uncle Ramin.
row.notes: This game depicts the collapse of a regime, the bombing of a civilian area in a city in first-person, some visually and emotionally intense scenes, a character who commits suicide, and a surreal nuclear explosion. It can understandably make someone uncomfortable.

row.name: Nettle
row.detailed_description: This game is an indie, passion-project single-player survival RTS game designed to put the player's species on a foreign and hostile land, and let the player lead them from humble beginnings to an eventual complete exploitation of an unknown world. You will have to find said planet to populate. Though, you should be wary of the space anomalies occupying specific planets and solar systems. After descending to a planet's surface, your objective becomes to find a way to brave this new world, teeming with alien life. Gather resources like wood, stone and food. Eventually, you might even find a way to refine them into something more precious? Explore different biomes, lead expeditions into ruins or even wilder parts of the planet! Build, develop and expand your colony to prosper. Are you ready to lead your species to new frontiers?
row.short_description: A single-player survival RTS game about exploring the vast cosmos, the many planets inhabiting it and their countless secrets. You'll need to explore, gather resources and research new technologies in order to survive, thrive, and eventually build a colony on a bizarre, foreign world.

row.name: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree Playtest
全网公敌：诡村
row.detailed_description: 游戏简介 玩家扮演的主角在沉眠中醒来，面前是一台拥有灵异调查能力的神秘“电脑”。与749研究所的资深调查员陈晞携手，玩家将深入调查一起令人震惊的灵异事件。 事件涉及到一个名叫刘健的男子，他在参加户外活动后行为异常，家中发生怪事。通过在网络上的深入搜索，玩家在向阳登山协会的论坛中发现了刘健与其他两位驴友在枯河子山的不寻常经历。 随着调查的逐步深入，玩家将揭开1985年白河村大火背后的秘密，以及与之相关的一系列超自然现象，最终发现一个令人不寒而栗的真相…… 玩法特色  影游结合：游戏采用真人拍摄视频，打造沉浸式体验。  多维互动：通过观看视频、锚定灵异锚点、网络搜索、论坛互动，搜集事件线索。  情景还原：利用749研究所的老式电脑，还原事件发生时的情景。  解谜拼图：深入剧情理解，拖拽组合词条，解开谜题，获取关键线索。  信息串联：利用网络搜索，串联碎片信息，逐步揭开事件的全貌。
row.short_description: 本作是与《全网公敌》联动的全新故事，通过一台“旧电脑”进行互联网搜索解密的剧情互动游戏。你作为一名特殊调查员，需要负责解开隐藏在“登山客意外失踪”背后的超自然事件。随着调查深入，始作俑者也渐渐浮出水面，“祂”，似乎又与四十多年前消失在大火中的白河村，有着千丝万缕的联系。

row.name: ALFRED IS A BAD GUY
row.detailed_description: ALFRED is a BAD GUY is a board game for 4 to 8 players in which you have to team up to defeat the Boss of the board in a dice duel. But beware: some players won't have the same objective as others. Secret roles are assigned at the start of the game, dividing players into 2 teams. The good guys, whose aim is to defeat the Boss, and the bad guys, whose aim is to keep the Boss alive and eliminate the good guys. To achieve your goals, you'll need to roll dice to scour the board for items, bonuses and extra dice. You'll start the game with a 6-sided die, while the Boss will have a 100-sided one. You'll need to move around the board to find the bonus squares you need to better equip yourself before facing your opponents. The Boss is accompanied by 4 lieutenants who give him bonuses and strengthen him. But he can also count on the players who will take on one of the bad guy roles, among them: - The Reaper , who will cut off the heads of pawns who talk too much. - The Puppeteer , who will take control of another pawn and do whatever he likes with it. - Marc , who will mark your dice to make them explode in front of the Boss. The good guys won't be left out in the cold, either: - The Hero , who will have a more powerful die for his fights. - Urgle , who will defy death and make the Grim Reaper bow. All other players will be Simple Pawns . In short, gather your friends, log on to your favorite voice chat software, grab your dice and your investigative skills to find out who the bad guys are and defeat the Boss of ALFRED is a BAD GUY!
row.short_description: ALFRED is a BAD GUY is a multiplayer board game that combines dice duelling, lying and investigation. Each player has a secret role and a different objective in the game. Bring out your dice and your lying skills to win in ALFRED is a BAD GUY!

row.name: The Icarus Experiment
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Overview The Icarus Experiment is a narrative-driven, choice-based adventure game set aboard the UNE Hyperion, a spaceship that harbors deep secrets following a catastrophic experiment gone awry. In this tension-filled, sci-fi universe, players navigate through a series of puzzles, moral dilemmas, and hidden dangers, unraveling the mystery of what led to the ship's demise. Key Features Branching Narrative: Choose how you wish to proceed with different events throughout the game. Each decision can have an impact on what you learn throughout the game and can influence what you choose to do. Environmental Investigation: Discover what happened on the UNE Hyperion by inspecting terminals, reading ship logs, and discovering clues in the environment. Point & Click Puzzles: Players navigate the space station, interact with objects and solve puzzles through a simple 2D point-and-click interface. Customize your character: Choose from 3 distinct uniforms and access unique dialogue options based on what you choose. Solve the Mystery: Find out what the mission of the UNE Hyperion is, who you are, and what happened to the ship. Story You wake from hypersleep on the seemingly deserted UNC Hyperion, with no memory of your identity or your mission. Discover the truth behind the disaster that befell the ship and its crew. What is The Icarus Experiment and what happened to it? Explore 4 distinct areas within the UNC Hyperion: The Hypersleep Chamber, Crew Quarters, Engine Room, and The Bridge.
row.short_description: Plumb the depths of a doomed leviathan on a mission to save a dying solar system. Unravel a mystery that could alter the fate of humanity. Created with Adventure Forge, this showcases the power of the no-code tool that lets you craft your own narrative-rich experiences.

row.name: Crony Corp
row.detailed_description: Step into the cutthroat world of Crony Corp, where building factories is only the beginning. Build Factories, craft goods, upgrade your operations, and manipulate a live market shaped by every player’s choices. Whether you’re climbing the ladder or pulling it out from under someone else, it’s all part of the game. Sabotage rivals, exploit loopholes, and make your mark — just don’t expect to play fair. You're the Boss: Control every decision and grow your business empire. Crafting & Building: Upgrade factories, craft hundreds of products, and outplay your competitors. Live Economy: The market shifts with your actions—trade smart and dominate. PvP Mode: Undercut, disrupt, and outmaneuver your rivals in a world where sabotage is just another business strategy. Your success depends on making money, and lots of it. You’ll upgrade factories, purchase new ones, and craft hundreds of products in a vast product tree that allows for endless gameplay strategies. Upgrade everything: Factories, products, and your reputation as the boss everyone loves to hate. Craft and compete: Choose your industry, maximize your profits, and prove you’ve got the business chops to beat out your rivals. Espionage on the side: Sabotage is just another tool in the corporate toolbox. Use it wisely. Crony Corp features a live economy where the market is constantly shifting. Your choices directly impact the price of goods, so keep an eye on those supply and demand curves, and react fast to market changes. Global marketplace: Hundreds of products to trade in real-time, all impacted by your decisions. Dynamic prices: Your actions influence the entire economy, making you a true market player. Seize opportunities: Stay sharp and exploit every market fluctuation to ensure your profits soar. In Crony Corp, the market isn't your only enemy. Other players are out to ruin you, too. In PvP Mode, sabotage is just another tool in your business arsenal. Outsmart, disrupt, and retaliate as you climb the corporate ladder by any means necessary. Disrupt rival operations: Interfere with production lines, trigger delays, and cause chaos when it hurts most. Target key personnel: Cripple Managerial performance with… unfortunate mishaps. Play dirty, rise fast. Sabotage isn’t just allowed, it’s a core part of your strategy. After all, it’s not personal. It’s just business. Mostly.
row.short_description: Build your empire in a competitive world shaped by supply, demand, & shady deals. In Crony Corp, you’ll buy & manufacture goods in a live market that responds to every player’s actions. Trade smart, undercut rivals, bend the rules, and climb the corporate ladder. Just don’t expect fair play.

row.name: Streamer's Journey 💖
row.detailed_description: STORY Tania is a young streamer with low self-esteem who, manipulated by her friend Eidzoku, dives into the world of explicit photo shoots and online exploitation. In search of validation and confidence, she receives a flood of attention, but her life gradually spirals out of balance. Her dependence on online approval deepens, and her real-life relationships fall apart. As Tania becomes entangled in manipulative, toxic relationships and subjected to humiliation by a group known as 'The Aristocrats,' she is victimized by violence. However, her inner traumas and deviant tendencies only intensify. As she sinks further into this dark world, Tania loses control of her life, becoming a victim of her own insecurities and destructive desires. GAMEPLAY This story-driven visual novel delves deep into the emotional and psychological journey of the protagonist, Tania. The game focuses on exploring her inner struggles, insecurities, and the impact of toxic relationships through a captivating narrative. Players will experience detailed and explicit sexual scenes that are integral to revealing Tania’s state of mind, reflecting her complex emotions and evolving psychological state. The linear storyline emphasizes the character’s development, offering a raw and immersive exploration of her life. The game also features a wealth of high-quality artwork, ensuring that every scene, whether intimate or emotional, is depicted with careful attention to detail and artistry. FEATURES • Exciting story • Thrilling art
row.short_description: Streaming for attention seemed harmless at first... but Tania’s dive into online fame quickly spirals into a dangerous world of exploitation and desire. Will she find herself, or lose everything? 😈
row.notes: All character depicted are over the age of 18. This game contains scenes of sexual acts, rough sex, violence, forced sex, group sex, anal sex and humiliation. Also please make sure you are in the right place to avoid any unnecessary attention.

row.detailed_description: Game Introduction Duck Eggs is an electronic pet currency trading game that will lay eggs for you when placed on your desktop! These eggs can be traded on the Steam marketplace for real currency! Duck Eggs can also serve as your electronic pet, placed on your desktop without any unnecessary pages obstructing your view, with a pure lace design that allows you to change the size of the duck at any time. Every 3 hours, the duck will lay an egg, increasing your collection of various types of eggs, making your Duck Eggs egg collection more diverse. The drop probability of each level egg: Common egg: probability of obtaining 60% Premium egg: probability of obtaining 39% Rare egg: probability of obtaining 0.99% Legendary egg: probability of obtaining 0.01% Game Features: The duck lays eggs, increasing your collection of various types of eggs Won't take up too much of the screen, with a lace-in design that allows you to place it on your desktop, giving you your own electronic pet. At the same time, we will continuously update and add various new types of eggs, so that you can continuously obtain a variety of Duck's egg eggs. Story Introduction: Li Yaya is the younger sister of Li Haoya, a popular live streamer. One day, she followed her usual routine and traveled to the forest for a trip, but on her trip, Li Yaya got lost and accidentally traveled to the cyberspace, getting trapped as a desktop pet here. Li Yaya cannot leave, but she gained a strange ability, that is, randomly summoning items from other worlds, but the items summoned by Li Yaya will all turn into eggs and be born by her, this power is uncontrollable, Li Yaya will unconsciously lay an egg every three hours. Originally, she was troubled by this, until she found out that these eggs can be sold for money, and with money, it seems that she can trade with the cyberspace god and leave here. To leave here, Li Yaya asks for your help, as long as you help her sell the eggs, she will share her profits with you and serve as your electronic pet always
row.short_description: Welcome to 《Duck Eggs》, an innovative game that mixes desktop pet, collection, trading, clicking and surprise elements together. In this world, you'll collect all kinds of rare and fantastic duck eggs . Eventually, you can exchange them for money to help the duck go back to her original world.

row.name: IdleTale
row.detailed_description: Idletale Is An Incremental/clicker Rpg Game. You'll find yourself in a world where everything can only get bigger - specifically talking about numbers! Kill enemies to gain Gold, use it to produce even more Gold while you're not playing and complete quests, explore dungeons, collect loot to gear up and improve your character with all the Talent trees and the further Ascension Upgrades! All of this will only lead to your power skyrocketing like you would never imagine. Start this journey slowly, and day by day unlock more features until there's nothing left to achieve - or so you'll think. Then you'll reset your progress. But for good! This will only multiply your next game's numbers and experiences by a LOT! (And unlock even MORE features) The basic mechanic isn't much different from any other incremental game - tap the screen, get resources. Use those resources to buy more resources that will exponentially generate more of that same resource, breaking the barrier of the thousands, millions, billions or quintillions.The way you get resources (in this case, Gold) is by killing monsters. You tap the screen, you land a hit. Enemies have HP, you deal damage. Enough hits, the enemy will die. Then there's a respawn time, which is affected by upgrades too. You can, like in any other incremental game, buy passive income upgrades (a.k.a. gains per second), which will grant you Gold each second, depending on the upgrades you bought and the number you have. There's also the other type of upgrades - the one that boosts everything else, such as 'enemies drop more gold', 'this thing gives you more gold per second', or 'you deal more damage with each attack'. Then there's the Skills tab - your character will progress through these. More Strength, more raw damage. There's a number of factors that alter the value of Strength that you will discover along the game. Agility increases your critical strike chance, and Wisdom increases the damage bonus each critical hit benefits from. Then there's the Gear tab. Like in any other RPG, you will loot gear and equip it to benefit from its stats. Mostly addressed towards combat, but remember combat is your main Gold source. There's the Dungeons , which are small instances with a few waves of enemies and then a final boss. Kill the boss, get XP and loot. Ez pz. You won't be able to spam dungeons to level up, as your character will have another resource called 'Stamina' and you will run out of it rather quickly. Stamina is also used to travel between places. Codex . Here you'll gather information about all the enemies you come across. You can level those enemies up to make them drop more gold, XP and loot (but they'll also have more HP!). Talents . They will be your bread and butter as you progress through the game. Not only they will look cool and make you feel you're rushing through the content, but also they'll synergize with other features to skyrocket your power. There'll be three different trees. Glory (Ascension) . Just like in any Incremental game, there's an Ascension system, which will boost your stats by a LOT and unlock interesting features. Raids . We talked about Dungeons before, and now there's Raids! Some sort of Dungeons but with several floors, way harder and intended for end-game content. Their rewards are stronger than most items, and you can defeat a raid once a day. There's also an Achievements system!
row.short_description: IdleTale is an incremental clicker RPG game. Kill enemies to gain Gold, use it to produce even more Gold while you're not playing and complete quests, explore dungeons, collect loot to gear up and improve your character with all the Talent trees and the further Ascension Upgrades!

row.name: Skylax! The Lab Runner
row.detailed_description: (IT'S ONLY WINDOWS SUPPORTED FOR NOW. YOU MAY ENCOUNTER UNEXPECTED BUGS WITH LINUX & MACOS) Skylax! The Lab Runner is an FPS game. The game presents you a tight gameplay and a little story behind. If you like run and gun games with good graphics, you are in the right place! The story begins when people realize that the evolving and powerful artificial intelligence is somewhat out of control. Robots that do every human job 100 times more efficiently and better than humans are now starting to take over the world in terms of population. In this case, while humanity is trying to cope with both increasing unemployment and corruption, it decides that robots should be taken under control and if necessary, they should regress to the technological level of 100 years ago. For this reason, the robots are now politely blocked and locked in laboratories. When the robots realize this situation, they search for a life source that they can be self-sufficient in. In the meantime, they create an artificial life source called a life sphere, which is similar to the soul in humans. The robots that integrate these into themselves also now have human emotions compared to normal robots. Here, our main character, SKYLAX-#0001, is the robot that has opened its human emotions the most among all robots. In fact, it has reached a level that can be called half-human - half-robot in terms of feelings. The main purpose of conducting tests in the laboratory is to create a useful but also controlled robot prototype. Skylax, the last test subject of the laboratory, is subjected to a final test for both humanity and himself due to the resources that are now running out. An offer is made to Skylax in the laboratory. If he passes the test, the life resources that have been taken from the robots by humans so far will be given back to them and all robots of the same race as Skylax will be reorganized and offered to come back to life, and thus the adventure begins.
row.short_description: Skylax! The Lab Runner is an FPS game that presents you with tight gameplay and good mechanics. In the game, you can pass levels either by hiding using the invisible mechanic or by fighting against enemies. And after each level you will upgrade your weapons and utilities!
