Manage your resources and use machines to change notes to the correct pitch and length before the conveyor belts lead them to the instrument.  Assemble-Ensemble offers 4 machines, that all change a note in a different way fo you to play around with.  And 4 Instruments to play the sounds!  There is also a fun sandbox mode for you to compose your own little song!  Have fun!
row.short_description: Assemble Ensemble is a music-themed factory-building game, that offers a variety of fun melodies, for you to recreate by cleverly placing machines and conveyors!

row.name: Mythos Interactive Game Collection
row.detailed_description: Mythos Interactive Game Collection is a curated anthology of 9 diverse and captivating indie games, brought to you by the creative minds at Mythos Interactive. This collection showcases the studio's unique approach to game design, offering a variety of genres and experiences that cater to all types of players. Whether you're seeking the thrill of fast-paced action, the challenge of mind-bending puzzles, or the joy of immersive storytelling, the Mythos Interactive Game Collection has something for everyone. Each title is a labor of love, crafted with attention to detail and a passion for innovation, ensuring hours of entertainment and discovery. Key Features: 9 Unique Games: Dive into a wide range of genres, including action, puzzle, adventure, and more. Each game offers a distinct experience, with its own unique mechanics, art style, and narrative. Engaging Gameplay: From strategic challenges to heart-pounding action, these games are designed to keep you engaged, whether you prefer solo play or competitive fun. Creative Freedom: Explore worlds and stories brought to life by passionate developers, with original concepts and fresh takes on classic genres. Indie Spirit: Support an indie studio dedicated to pushing the boundaries of game design and delivering high-quality experiences without the constraints of mainstream development. hether you're a long-time fan of Mythos Interactive or discovering their games for the first time, this collection is a must-have for any gaming enthusiast. Join the adventure, explore new worlds, and experience the magic of indie game development with the Mythos Interactive Game Collection! Game Included in this collection: Hefty Heights - Test your stacking skills and precision as you carefully balance everyday objects to hit the perfect weight. Every move counts in this thrilling challenge of balance and strategy! To The Last - Dice are your biggest weapon. The Dice-slinger is a fearsome cowboy who uses magical dice as ammunition. Reload your shotgun with dice and blast your demonic enemies right back to Hell, but be warned, if you run out of dice, it's Game Over. 25 Vikings - Fight to the bitter, icy end as you control a clan of desperate Vikings captured by the hordes of Helheim. Brave the cold and free your warrior brothers and sisters as you battle the enemies of the All Father. Internal Medicine - Play as a young professional in the medical industry as she struggles with the taking care of her ailing patients, while attempting to maintain a modicum of sanity. The Case of the Deviant Detective - Follow the case work of Charlie, a new detective on the force, whose Uncle happens to be a part of the mafia, and needs a few favors. Are you ready to REWIND the tapes in this puzzling Noir mystery, and set the fate of these suspects forever? Runaway Robot - Aid a mad scientist as he attempts to regain control of an army of little robots. Help these little robots find their way in the world. Test your smarts in this cute and cuddly robotic adventure! What could go wrong? Terminal Charge - Take on the role of a desperate air-traveler as they zig-zag through a bustling airport while attempting to reach their gate and keep their phone alive. Rush from outlet to outlet and evade your fellow pedestrians as you make your way to your gate. But beware, gate changes are frequent and this airport was built by a madman! Kinoko Dash - A short, fast-paced casual game about clicking and dashing around while chopping angry mushroom enemies into tiny bits. Keep your enemies at a distance while timing your clicks just right to execute a SUPER DASH! Prepare to Re-Pair! - Help these cute robot friends find their way back together in this charming and hectic puzzle action game.
row.short_description: Mythos Interactive Game Collection is a diverse anthology of 9 indie games, each offering unique gameplay experiences across various genres. From thrilling action to mind-bending puzzles, this collection showcases the creative spirit of Mythos Interactive.

row.name: Mariana
row.detailed_description: Mariana is an underwater exploration and Metroidvania indie game. In this game you are dropped into an unknown trench to explore. You will find fantastical creatures and rare artifacts. Fight bosses and mini-bosses in order to dive as deep as possible and uncover the mystery of the trench. Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition. Features: Fight in adrenaline filled boss battles against giant sea creatures. Explore strange worlds and discover fantastical creatures. Customize your character with fun equipment. Tame and fight alongside a pet catfish. Original Art and Soundtrack. Horror elements with a sprinkle of humor. An original (hot) character with trades and dialogue. Hidden lore and mysteries to be uncovered.
row.short_description: In Mariana you are dropped into an unknown trench to explore. You will find fantastical creatures and rare artifacts. Fight bosses and mini-bosses in order to dive as deep as possible and uncover the mystery of the trench.
row.notes: There is killing and death. Blood can be turned off but is on by default.

row.name: Demonophobia Company
row.detailed_description: WELCOME TO DEMONOPHOBIA COMPANY! Demonophobia Company is a RPG + Visual Novel game that shows 'Angel of glory, Gloria' experiences after she disguises herself as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary' and joined the company. Synopsis 'Angel of glory, Gloria' got a mission to disguise as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary' and joined 'Demonophobia Company' to find the hell's significant secrets, since hell's atmosphere will be much relaxed due to the big festival. Burbary tried to pretend like a normal demon, however, she met 'red eyes' and fainted. Seven Deadly Sins department's manager 'Teressa' says that she will help Burbary, but the strange demon 'Fey' also joins as an unexpected guest... Help Burbary and find this company's top secrets! Make attractive demon friends! (Or you don't have to.) Enjoy 9 amounts of endings! Find 30 achievements that are included in-game! (10 of them are hidden!) Finally, wait for your show :) Nobody will blame about your choices. How to control Arrow keys - move Spacebar - OK ESC - Menu open / cancel SHIFT - run CTRL - Skip dialog F5 - Reset game * Demonophobia Company is not suitable for under age 15. * This game's first language is not English. Some translation might be not smooth. I ask for your understanding.
row.short_description: 'Angel of glory, Gloria' joined the 'Demonophobia Company' with disguising herself as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary.' Could Burbary finish her mission and go back to her home?

row.name: Aye Leon
row.detailed_description: Game Features Quick & Addictive Gameplay Aye Leon is a bite-sized blast of fun! With a full play through clocking in at around 20 minutes, it's perfect for quick breaks or replayable marathons. Easy to pick up, tough to put down. 7 Unlockable Achievements Turn a 20-minute run into a full-on challenge! Test your reflexes, find every hidden gem, and snag all 7 achievements. Quick game, lasting bragging rights. Original Soundtrack by Jetset2one6 Immerse yourself in a unique audio experience with exclusive tracks crafted by music producer Jetset2one6. Two Distinct Game Modes Choose your challenge: Lives Mode : How long can you last with limited lives? Timed Mode : Race against the clock. Can you finish the game before time runs out? Gravity called. Leon declined.... GO LEON!
row.short_description: Glide your way to victory in this enchanting 2D platformer. Master your jetpack’s smooth glide through colorful, floating worlds packed with collectables. A full playthrough takes around 20 minutes, perfect for a quick burst of platforming adventure.

row.name: Under the blue horizon - Aquarium
row.detailed_description: Create your own aquarium and collect fish. Swimming in a comfortable environment, the fish will bring you peace and happiness. You can do other tasks or whatever you want. As time passes, the fish will begin to fill the sea. You can't stop the flowing waves. The fish may leave. Have you found a new type of fish? Is there a fish with a special color? Is there a fish you want to put in your aquarium? If so, catch it. The fish will gladly enter your aquarium. Relax. Listen to music and clear your mind. Enjoy watching your fish!
row.short_description: 'Under the blue horizon - Aquarium' is a game for those who want to enjoy watching fish. Observe fish in the sea and in aquariums. Discover more types of special fish. Enjoy it while working, relax, or clear your mind.

row.name: Deathblossom
row.detailed_description: A hard-boiled private eye finds herself stranded in a forgotten corner of New Mexico after following a mysterious paranormal lead. All seems lost until the case finds her instead - and once the truth is revealed, there's nothing holding back the lusty desires of the dead. Deathblossom is an action / kinetic novel hybrid about love and mortality. Enjoy visual novel-style written scenes and high-octane top-down action as you shoot, kick and blast your way through an erotic revenge thriller! In Deathblossom, get ready to: Experience a fully illustrated story by Zoquete Reach a variety of lewd scenes with different situations, noncon and occasional bondage Enjoy custom SFX mixed with the help of the OpenNSFW project Wield your revolver and kick some undead ass in bullet time with challenging but accessible action gameplay Explore a supernatural Western noir setting with existential themes Meet a colorful cast of period-inspired characters And don't forget the spectacular soundtrack by the underground musicians of Newgrounds: featuring Creo, Tanger, JamesHeart, Demonicity, AriaLowo, the Lemons, and many more amazing artists! There's no going back from a deal with Death itself. If you enjoyed this free project and want to get some behind-the-scenes content, consider buying the supporter pack, available as DLC on Steam! This is an optional way to support the solo developer if you want to see more fun, unique NSFW projects in the future. Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!
row.short_description: Deathblossom is an action / kinetic novel hybrid about love and mortality. Enjoy visual novel-style written scenes and high-octane top-down action as you shoot, kick and blast your way through an erotic revenge thriller. Featuring a fully illustrated story by Zoquete!
row.notes: Deathblossom features depictions of non-consensual sex, female-presenting characters with male genitalia, furry characters, violence, and mature themes. The game primarily caters to non- and dubcon fetishes from a submissive POV but NSFW scenes can be skipped.

row.name: Kato Pirato
row.detailed_description: Join Pirate Cat in an endless runner adventure like no other! ~ Sail through the jungle in a makeshift box-boat, collecting coins and unlocking special bonuses. ~ Navigate through rune gates to gain unique powers and gather various collectibles along the way. FEATURES : • Exciting Jungle Setting: Explore vibrant jungle landscapes. • Collect Coins: Gather coins to unlock special abilities and items. • Rune Gates: Pass through rune gates to gain unique powers. • Fun Collectibles: Discover and collect various items to enhance your adventure. • Endless Fun: Keep running and exploring for as long as you can! Join the adventure and see how far you can sail with Kato Pirato!
row.short_description: Set sail & embark on an endless jungle adventure!

row.name: The Tower of Aether
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Tower of Aether —a sprawling labyrinth filled with countless doors, each one leading to untold mysteries and treasures. At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether , an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize. In Tower of Aether , players must navigate this ever-changing maze, learning the hidden lore of the Tower and uncovering its ancient secrets,. Will you forge alliances and collaborate with others, or betray your companions to secure your own path to the final door? The choice is yours. Key Features: Open one door per hour in the mysterious Tower, each leading to hidden realms—choose wisely, as every decision could bring you closer to the ultimate goal or further from it. Work with or deceive players from around the world, as only one correct door exists on each floor—cooperation or betrayal could be the key to finding it first. Discover and trade ancient relics, mysterious artifacts, and powerful tokens tied to the Tower's factions, each revealing deeper secrets about its hidden lore. Only one player will claim the ultimate victory—will it be you?
row.short_description: Welcome to the Tower of Aether—a labyrinth filled with countless doors, At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether, an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize.

row.name: Small Dragon Big Appetite
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a world where bunnies aren't just cute—they're your key to victory! In this fast-paced, score-chasing adventure, your goal is simple: eat as many bunnies as you can to rack up points and dominate the leader board. But beware—these bunnies get stronger the deeper you go, offering greater rewards but also tougher challenges. Will you rise to the top by devouring the fiercest bunnies and claiming the highest score? It’s time to find out—happy hunting! Hunt as many bunnies you can before the day cycle ends. Avoid incoming attacks from stronger bunnies, survive as long as possible during your hunt runs. Find potions that aid you with abilities such as invisibility and faster movement.
row.short_description: 'Join Chompie as he explores the enchanted bunny kingdom, hunting down bunnies to satisfy his insatiable appetite! How many days can you go without starving?'

row.name: Monster Grid
row.detailed_description: Assemble and customize your own team of powerful monsters and strategically place them on the grid, watch them battle through intense challenges, and compete against other players. This auto-battler comes with several single-player challenges, an infinite play mode and a multi-player option to face against the monsters of other players.
row.short_description: Assemble and customize your own team of powerful monsters and strategically place them on the grid, watch them battle through intense challenges, and compete against other players.

row.name: Knuckle Knockout
row.detailed_description: Knuckle Knockout is an action-packed 2D platformer fighting game for 2-4 players. Brawl with friends across three unique maps: clash in the lush greenery of Misty Mountains, battle amidst the rotating chaos of Pinwheel Pyramid, and face off atop the towering heights of Zero Hour Tower. Be the first to win three rounds and claim the crown! Master Knuckle Knockout’s unique Extend-o fist mechanic to punch opponents or launch yourself for thrilling platforming maneuvers. Customize your play style with 8 distinct emotes —4 for your character's face and 4 for their fist. Supports 2-4 gamepads , including Xbox One and PS4 controllers, for an engaging multiplayer experience. Designed for accessibility , the game offers features to support players with color blindness, dyslexia, and motion sickness. Everyone can join the fight! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: An action-packed 2D platformer fighting game for 2-4 players. Brawl with friends across three unique maps with the first player to win three rounds taking the crown!

row.name: keycode
row.detailed_description: It's a game where you can clear stages using a keyboard. In this game, if you play the stage, the character walks to the right. It's a simple game where you press the alphabet key on the keyboard to safely let the character pass through before you reach this character. If the character passes through, the word clear will appear in the background. If so, well done, you cleared one stage. If you can't press the right alphabet key on the keyboard, the game won't be able to clear.
row.short_description: It's a game where you can clear the stage by pressing the key code on the keyboard

row.name: Play Together
row.detailed_description: It's the most popular social networking game chosen by players worldwide with over 200 million downloads! Play Together offers more convenience by letting you link your mobile device with Steam. Log in and start making friends with various people from all over the world in Play Together! Key Features Create a character that is uniquely you and make all kinds of friends. Customize your character from head to toe in your unique style. The possibilities are endless with a variety of skin tones, hairstyles, body types, and costumes to choose from. Maybe, you'll find that special someone in your life as you chat with and befriend various people from around the world! Turn your humble abode into the home of your dreams and invite friends over for a Home Party! Choose a house from a wide range of styles and concepts and a countless number of furniture pieces to make your dream home fantasy a reality right before your eyes. Invite friends over or visit their homes to catch fish, play games, chit-chat, and role-play together for hours of fun! Have a blast playing fun-filled minigames with friends. Demonstrate your mad gaming skills in minigames such as Game Party, where the last one standing from 30 players wins, Zombie Virus, Obby Race, Tower of Infinity, Fashion Star Runway, Snowball Fight, Sky High, as well as an assortment of additional minigames found only in school. Go around various fishing spots to catch new species of fish and show them off to others! Catch over 600 species of fish in places such as a pond, the sea, and even a swimming pool. It's never a dull moment as new fish to catch are constantly added to the game. Every fishing spot has fish not found in other spots, so visit them all to complete the collections listed in the Illustrated Book and show people what you've caught! Catch insects and lizards with your friends in various locations or go excavate rare ores and fossils. Over 300 species of insects are thriving throughout the in-game world! Also, look forward to a unique and fun experience digging up dinosaur fossils and rare diamonds. Sell your findings directly or show off your accomplishments to your friends by beautifully displaying them for double the satisfaction. Take good care of pets of all shapes and sizes. Add a spoonful of happiness to your life in Play Together with one of many adorable and ever-present pets that follow you around, such as puppies, kittens, ponies, and more. Take walks with your critter friend or cruise the streets together in your dream car. Also, don't miss your chance to own special limited-time pets available only during specific periods.
row.short_description: Play Together is a popular casual social networking game enjoyed by players worldwide. Express yourself through character customization, decorate your home and host Home Parties for a fun time with friends. Enjoy tons of content with friends from all across the globe!

row.name: The Demon's Bride
row.detailed_description: You must save your niece, Nina, while escaping the merciless the Demon Bride You have 5 days to find her and escape before it’s too late. Will you survive or become her next victim? Hide and outsmart the Demon Bride. Watch your step! Every move counts to stay alive. Uncover the mystery to help you escape. Use the items around you! Enjoy retro graphics reminiscent of classic games, delivering a deep sense of nostalgia and a chilling horror atmosphere. Experience a gripping horror atmosphere inspired by local Indonesian folklore and stories. Choose from three characters, each with unique abilities and strategies. Can you save Nina and escape in time?
row.short_description: Run from the Demon Bride, where you must outwit and escape from the clutch of the Demon Bride to save your niece, Nina. Solve challenging puzzles while hiding from the relentless Demon Bride in the world of Indonesian cult horror experience.

row.name: Countdown
row.detailed_description: Game Description Countdown is a short visual novel that tells the story of an ordinary individual's journey through their thoughts and emotions as their life approaches its end. The second playthrough of this game is intended for revisiting the story. The content is exactly the same as the initial playthrough, with no changes whatsoever. Experience Emotional Interaction: Although the game does not have branching choices, players can connect with the protagonist's emotional journey through reading the text, enjoying background music, and viewing beautiful illustrations. Immersive Storytelling: Every page is carefully designed to ensure that players are fully immersed in the protagonist's world. Reflection and Contemplation: The narrative includes critical reflections and discussions on societal issues such as life, family, workplace, and healthcare systems.
row.short_description: Countdown is a short visual novel that tells the story of an ordinary individual's journey through their thoughts and emotions as their life approaches its end. The plot includes critiques and discussions of social issues such as life, family, the workplace, and the healthcare system.
row.notes: Some character materials in the game are dressed in a more revealing manner, but do not involve nudity or excessive sexualization.

row.name: Veil Transfer
row.detailed_description: 'Congratulations and welcome onboard as a new enforcer of the NVTP, the New Veil Termination Program! Feel proud as we work together to protect our country from this unforeseen threat.' Veils are a rising threat as they hide within human bodies in order to carry out malevolent will. As an NVTP enforcer, your job is to pick out and execute any Veils who hide among the human population. You may interrogate, threaten, torture - whatever it takes for you to determine someone's innocence. If you accidentally let a Veil through, you'll have to make sure they don't get their revenge on you while you continue your job. A short, replayable horror experience I made for fun. First person gameplay PSX + Analog horror styled graphics AI generated dialogue for unique interactions Deduce someone's innocence by carrying out your own tests Carry out your own executions with your trusty shotgun Resource management - carry out your tests while dealing with any intruding Veils. You only have a few shells, shall you save them for executions or defend yourself? Infinite, replayable gameplay Upgrade system Unique yet simple Veil types to discover and learn Hidden mechanics to discover and learn
row.short_description: An atmospheric, arcade first-person horror game where your sole job is to root out the Veils who take on the identity of humans. Interrogate and execute monsters that hide within people, and protect yourself while managing your ammunition and transfers.
row.notes: Acts of violence including executions are carried out on human characters. This includes the use of a shotgun and a shock system which may be disturbing and/or frightening to some individuals.

row.name: Blood Strike
row.detailed_description: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between. Customize your weapons to your liking and get ready to prove that you have what it takes to come out on top! Adrenaline Packed Combat Having the guts to pounce on your enemies and pursue them in tense firefights is key to your success in Blood Strike. Tactical decisions matter, but don’t expect to camp a spot unchallenged! Meet The Strikers & Their Deadly Abilities Pick your favorite hero each with their unique active and passive skill and bring defeat to your opponents! Enhance Your Arsenal Take it to the next level by customizing your weapons and selecting unique loadouts. Team Up For The Perfect Strike Blood Strike lets you team up and play team-based modes quickly. Finding your friends, adding them to your squad and jumping in a firefight as a team couldn't be easier! Intuitive Controls. World Class Precision. Blood Strike offers the smoothest aiming, shooting, running, and gliding experience. Enjoy smooth graphics and responsive controls, even on low-end machines, and fully immerse yourself in the action without hardware worries. Let nothing stand between you and that perfect victory.
row.short_description: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between.

row.name: Steel Swarm: APOCALYPSE
row.detailed_description: - ONLY A USERNAME IS NEEDED FOR ACCOUNT CREATION; NO OTHER INFO IS REQUIRED - Move Swiftly, Strike Vigorously You command a mighty Xalium Battle Tank (XBT) with WASD controls. Click to move is possible too, but swift positioning is vital because XBTs take more damage from the sides and even more from the back. That makes positioning key to landing your shots. In fact, you must aim well with every shot, because every shot is a skill shot! Battlefield of Swarms With 100+ minions per team, per avenue, per minute , the battlefield is teeming with thousands. Whether you are obliterating minions in clusters, swarming heroes, or overwhelming turrets, once you adapt to this new scale of war, no other MOBA will compare. Mission Dictates the Plan Danger and riches abound in the streets of Rotnor. The city is divided into two halves, each with four neighborhoods inhabited by neutral factions: police, military, pirates, and Xorm. Decide who to ally with, undertake missions for them, and secure vital upgrades that can shift the balance of power. Once you’re strong enough, rally your team to challenge mighty Mantis , the rogue XBT, for a reward that could change the outcome. Tactical Commander Select the battle tank and pilot that align with your team role from an ever-growing pool of options. Every five levels, enhance your skills with modifications . Acquire upgrades and gears  to tailor your tank to your distinctive playing style. Every Obstacle is a Road You have the  power to destroy anything in your path. Create new routes between lanes through the jungle, ambush enemies from behind, or surprise them with backdoor attacks just when they think they’ve won. Stop the APOCALYPSE Gear up, Commander! The swarm is relentless, the city is yours to reshape, and victory demands TRUE SKILL . Assemble your team, strategize your build, and carve your path through the chaos to stop the Apocalypse!
row.short_description: SSA is a 5v5 twin-stick shooter MOBA with vehicular combat in a fully destructible city. Fight huge swarms, complete missions, and blast through buildings to ambush your enemies. Positioning matters and every shot is a skill shot!

row.name: Security: Stories by the fans
row.detailed_description: In this prologue to Security: The Horrible Nights , you take on the role of a security guard at a hospital. From your small office, your job is to watch the entire hospital through security cameras. If you see a problem, you must run out and fix it! You can fix nearly every problem by pointing your flashlight at it and yell! But some problems can be deadly, so you have to be careful if you want to survive all the stories in this anthology horror game. All the stories are based on fan-submitted ideas. It is still possible to get your idea included in a free DLC for the main game if you visit the Security: The Horrible Nights Steam page. There is a thread called: 'Make a Story for the Game.' You get 4 unique stories based on fan ideas. You will encounter ghosts, monsters, and other horrible beings while trying to keep the hospital safe. The main game, Security: The Horrible Nights , will be released later in 2024.
row.short_description: Every time you die, a new story begins. In this prologue to Security: The Horrible Nights your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale based on fans’ ideas will unfold.
row.notes: Even though the game has cartoon-like graphics, it's still a horror game. So there will be murder and gore throughout the game.

row.name: Legends of Boom
row.detailed_description: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced RTS-Lite Battle game, designed for players who crave quick, intense matches where you strategically place bases, weapons, defenses, and events on one of 24 different battle maps. Dive into the single-player Path of Boom to earn experience, upgrade your cards, and unlock powerful strategies. Or, take your finely tuned deck-building skills online to face off against opponents while the puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod (voiced Tim Kitzrow, legendary NBA JAM announcer), delivers play-by-play of every match.
row.short_description: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced RTS-Lite Battle game. Collect and upgrade cards, and challenge both human and AI opponents online, all while experiencing over 4 hours of commentary by our vice-laden puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod (voiced Tim Kitzrow, legendary NBA JAM announcer)
row.notes: This game contains lots of comic related profanity. Not for young audiences where there are lots of jokes around criminal activity, drinking, smoking and identity. If you are easily offended and/are younger than 18 years old this game is not for you. Adults can expect the kind of humor and profanity that one might expect to hear from a comedian at a comedy club.

row.name: Mirrored Phantoms
row.detailed_description: Prepare to be consumed by Mirrored Phantoms , a chilling descent into a decaying mannequin factory where reality itself has fractured. This first-person psychological horror experience preys on your deepest fears, immersing you in an unsettling atmosphere where the line between what is real and what is imagined blurs with every haunting step on your journey to escape.   The decaying walls whisper secrets of a dark past, while the lifeless eyes of countless mannequins follow your every move. Explore the oppressive corridors, piecing together the mystery of the shattered mirror shards that hold the key to your escape. But be warned, the silence is deceptive. There are things that lurk in these halls that never want you to leave, and they are always listening.   Steel your nerves for chilling encounters that will test your sanity. Uncover the sinister history of the factory, decipher the clues etched into its decaying walls, and confront the phantoms that haunt your every waking moment. Dare to escape the clutches of this nightmarish reality, or risk being forever trapped within its mirrored depths.   Key Features: A  Shattered Reality : Descend into a nightmarish mannequin factory where the walls warp and reality itself is a twisted reflection. Prepare for an unsettling experience where your senses will be challenged and your sanity strained. Psychological Terror : Confront the chilling dread that seeps from every corner of this decaying world.  The ever-present gaze of lifeless eyes, the unsettling silence, and the unnerving feeling of being constantly watched will prey on your deepest fears. Unveiling the Mystery : Explore the oppressive environment, piecing together the dark history of the factory and the curse that binds you to it. Search for clues hidden within the shadows, solve the enigma of the mirror shards, and uncover the truth behind the horrors that haunt you.
row.short_description: Trapped in a nightmarish mannequin factory where reality itself is shattered, unravel the secrets of Mirrored Phantoms. Explore a deeply atmospheric world, solve the mystery of the mirror shards, and survive the terrors that await in this slow-burning, first-person horror experience.
row.notes: Visually, Mirrored Phantoms contains depictions of manneqins without clothing, which can appear as nudity. Thematically, the game is intended to scare and startle players and attempts to make the player feel anxious and scared throughout the game.

row.name: Imvi: Echoes of Harmony
row.detailed_description: Soar among the stars in  Imvi: Echoes of Harmony,  a third-person open-world experience from SMU Guildhall that invites you to slow down. Harness the attractive & repulsive forces of Black & White Singularities to traverse and explore an ancient, wonder-filled world as you collect and revel in the memories of those who came before Overview Soar among the stars in  Imvi: Echoes of Harmony,  a third-person, single-player, open-world experience developed by students at SMU Guildhall Cohort 33. In  Imvi , harness the attractive & repulsive energies of Black & White Singularities to sling yourself across & interact with an alien, wonder-filled, shattered world. Waking up with no memories, Imvi must learn to navigate an unfamiliar world while guided by an unknown mentor. By collecting Memory Shards scattered across a sweeping landscape of floating islands, Imvi embarks on an odyssey to discover the world…and herself. Features: Explore a Wonder-Filled World Linger among the serenity and soft sadness of a shattered alien world, featuring floating islands and a unique blend of vegetation, creatures, and landscapes in an experience that invites you to slow down Unique Movement & Gravity Mechanics Harness the attractive & repulsive energies of Black & White Singularities to navigate and traverse a broken world, with gravity twists that will always keep you seeing the world in new ways Fully Localized with Original VO & Soundtrack Explore the lost stories of the world and discover your own in English, Spanish, or Simplified Chinese, supported by an intimate original soundtrack
row.short_description: Imvi: Echoes of Harmony is a third-person experience where you use the attractive and repulsive forces of black and white singularities to explore an ancient alien civilization to recover your lost memories.

row.name: Blood X Thirsty
row.detailed_description: Blood X Thirsty is a bartending roguelike made as a submission for Pirate Software Game Jam 15 with the theme Shadows and Alchemy Fill Your Brew With Strange Ingredients Serve Drinks to Impatient Monster customers Choose Perks to Improve Your Bartending Skills See how many nights you can run your bar before you're overwhelmed by angry customers!
row.short_description: Serve drinks, enhance your brew, and fight off unruly customers in this fast-paced bartending sim!

row.name: Saga of Guardians
row.detailed_description: About Saga of Guardians Saga of Guardians is a unique collectible card game and auto battler. Build YOUR deck, place your cards strategically and climb the ranks in the PVP Arena. Build the most powerful deck Collect cards from 3 unique factions and discover the most powerful synergies to overcome your opponents. Place your cards strategically Assemble and power up your team, predict your opponents move and defeat their Guardian. Battle phase auto resolves Once you have given your commands it's up to your team. Watch the fight play out and use that information to play out your next turn. Collect cards Collect over 150 unique cards from 3 different factions! Prove yourself Play in the arena against player from all over the world and climb the ladder!
row.short_description: Saga of Guardians is a unique collectible card game and auto battler. Build YOUR deck, place your cards strategically and climb the ranks in the PVP Arena.

row.name: Gripshot
row.detailed_description: Equip your Gripshot and jetpack to soar high, using speed and momentum to outmaneuver your opponents for aerial supremacy and blast all who stand below you. The Grappling Hook will give you the upper-hand in combat, but it is the tool of elite operatives and your reflexes must be as sharp as your wits! Reliable and effective, the Jetpack will save you many times and may give you the upper hand in combat. Your weapons are the Machinegun and the Rocket Launcher designed for maximum aggression and control of the arena. In Gripshot , every match is a fast-paced test of aerial precision and tactical thinking, as you grapple between structures, dodge incoming fire, and seize high ground for the ultimate advantage.
row.short_description: Master the grapnel and jet into action in Gripshot, a skill-driven movement shooter that will challenge your coordination and reflexes as you strive for air supremacy.

row.name: WeightWare
row.detailed_description: WeightWare. A game of games. Testing both new gamers and skilled gamers alike. A game that will make you laugh and rage quit consecutively. A game that contains multiple different weird minigames to complete! ⬤ Made for the 'Unexpected Outcomes' Gain Jam ⬤ FEATURES Cute girls with big bellies 14 minigames Hand-drawn art 3 different modes Infinite replayability
row.short_description: WeightWare. A game of games. Testing both new gamers and skilled gamers alike. A game that will make you laugh and rage quit consecutively. A game that contains multiple different weird minigames to complete.
row.notes: Contains expansive female nudity, sexual content and fetishes.

row.name: Deathly Dominion
row.detailed_description: Deathly Dominion is an action-packed survival game that pits players against endless hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. In this grim setting, players must use all their skills and resources to fend off increasingly challenging waves of the undead. Each horde brings new dangers and challenges, requiring quick reflexes and well-thought-out strategies to survive. With a tense atmosphere and intense combat, Deathly Dominion offers an immersive and challenging experience for fans of survival games.
row.short_description: Deathly Dominion is an intense survival game where players face endless hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. Each wave brings new challenges, requiring quick skills and well-thought-out strategies to survive. An immersive and challenging game for fans of the genre.

row.name: The Night Of The Full Moon Playtest
Slimepocalypse
row.detailed_description: In this 2D arcade shooter, you will play as Lemonhead while he fights to defend his home as it's invaded by evil enemy slimes. Survive as long as you can and go for a high score along the way!! The more slimes you blast the higher your score. You will encounter a variety of enemies who have their own way of getting to you and stopping you from getting a high score. Do your best to prevent this with a selection of futuristic weapons; A ray-gun Assault Rifle, An ungodly laser and a cool little shotgun.
row.short_description: Blast your way through oncoming hordes of slimes in this run and gun, slime blasting shoot 'em up! Arm yourself with an arsenal of futuristic weapons and defend your home as its invaded by a disgusting infestation of slime scum. Run, Blast, Survive! and whatever you do...DON'T GET SLIMED

row.name: 审判日：血战太平洋 Playtest
Beast Brawl
row.detailed_description: BEAST BRAWL is a strategic roguelike auto-battler which pits teams of primal beasts against one another in a battle for survival. Thousands of Combos – Choose from over 30 unique beasts to form your champion team. Mix and match from 15 traits and over 15 upgrades to empower your team with new abilities. Discover overpowered combos and more! Survival of the Fittest – New beasts enter the fray every round, you must upgrade and be on your toes or be left behind! Chill or Tryhard – Wanna just chill? There’s a chill mode for you! Want to really test your skills? There’s a tryhard mode with advanced difficulty for you too! SELLING POINTS FOR NERDS Like to geek out about game systems and math out the optimal strats? Then this section is for you! Deterministic Battles – Zero randomness in the battle system, every battle and its results can be recreated with the exact same inputs and outputs. See someone else’s team that looks strong? Replicate it with the exact same results! Superposition Turn-Based System – Despite the visuals, beasts do not take “turns” acting in battle. Everyone acts at the same time during a turn and every action is resolved simultaneously in our unique superposition battle system. Emergent Systems – Beast Brawl is designed around letting players discover new and broken combos, evolving their teams into the ultimate apex beasts. JOIN OUR COMMUNITY DISCORD Discuss strategies and share your victories, join with the link in the sidebar on the right! 🢂🢂🢂🢂
row.short_description: Beast Brawl is a unique rougelike which pits teams of primal beasts against one another in a battle for survival. Thousands of combos and strategies to try and evolve your team into the apex beasts of the kingdom.

row.name: KAZEKAO
row.detailed_description: KAZEKAO is a fast-paced, challenging 2D platformer that will put your precision and speed to the test. Step into the paws of the blue cat Kazekao on a mission to retrieve Grandma Miauko's lost cakes scattered across 8 uniquely designed levels. Each level demands quick reflexes and perfect timing as you dash, jump, and maneuver through obstacles and enemies. The game combines tight controls with increasingly difficult levels, creating a satisfying experience for those who love a good test of skill. Can you find all the cakes and return them to Grandma Miauko before time runs out? Prepare to dive into a world where every second counts, and every move matters. Precision Platforming Navigate through tight spaces with smooth, responsive controls. Speedrun Challenge yourself to beat your best times. 8 Unique Levels Each level presents obstacles and challenges to master. Charming Pixel Art Enjoy a retro-inspired game with charming pixel art graphics. Achievements Challenge yourself by trying to unlock more than 20 achievements!

row.name: Jumping Jack
row.detailed_description: One morning, Jack was torn from his ordinary life and trapped in a strange world. Armed with nothing but an old pogo stick, he began his ascent through the mysterious dimension's unknown heights. In this realm where gravity behaves oddly and the ground is unreliable, Jack's only goal is to climb higher. But no one knows what awaits at the top—a way out or an even greater mystery? The only thing he’s sure of is that he’ll never find out unless he reaches the end. One mistake is all it takes! In Jack’s world, there are no second chances. With no save button or checkpoints, a single misstep can send you crashing back to the beginning. This unforgiving challenge will push your patience to its limits, testing your ability to bounce back—literally. Overcome the unpredictable! The world around Jack isn't just a backdrop; it's full of elements that can either help or hinder your progress. From unexpected aids that give you a boost, to traps designed to knock you off course, you'll need quick reflexes and a sharp mind to make it through. Laugh, cry, rage—repeat! Jack’s journey is not just about climbing but about the emotions you’ll feel along the way. The game's difficulty curve is punishing by design, giving you a true sense of accomplishment with every hard-earned victory—and plenty of frustration along the way. Key Features: No saves—each mistake sends you back to the start. Built-in speedrun timer and height tracker for competitive play. Both helpful elements and hazards make every climb unique. A surreal, gravity-defying world full of unpredictable challenges. A challenging difficulty curve that will test your perseverance.

row.name: Latent Leftovers
row.detailed_description: Latent Leftovers is an enchanting arcade game that combines Tetris-inspired mechanics with a whimsical tale of magical mischief. Step into the shoes of a struggling wizard, living in the shadow of a more successful rival, and embark on a quest to prove your worth. Just outside the grand wizard tower, you’ll find yourself crafting potions from leftover reagents tossed out of the open window. But not all hope is lost—a mysterious benefactor sees your hidden potential and offers a helping hand. Master the art of potion brewing across 9 unique scenarios as you climb your way to the prestigious title of Arch Wizard! Key features: Tetris-Inspired Potion Brewing : Engage in fast-paced, puzzle-based gameplay where you combine discarded magical reagents to brew powerful potions. Charming Narrative : Follow the story of an underdog wizard striving to prove his worth and rise to the top of the magical world. 9 Unique Scenarios : Challenge yourself with a variety of levels. Free to Play : Enjoy the full experience without spending a dime—Latent Leftovers is completely free to download and play. Step into the enchanting world of Latent Leftovers. Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast, a lover of magical adventures, or simply looking for a fun and engaging experience, this game offers something for everyone. Ready to brew your way to greatness?
row.short_description: Latent Leftovers is an arcade puzzle game where you play as an underdog wizard crafting potions from leftover reagents. With help from a mysterious benefactor, master 9 unique scenarios and rise to the rank of Arch Wizard—all for free!

row.name: Condo Desires

As the new trustee of the condo, it’s up to you to navigate complex relationships with the diverse and alluring female residents, uncovering their hidden fantasies and fulfilling their deepest cravings. Your choices throughout the day impact relationships, unlock scenes, and progress different character arcs. Relationship Development : Each female resident has a unique personality and backstory, with individual routes that can lead to different outcomes. You can deepen relationships through dialogue, gifts, completing specific tasks, and making the right choices. As trust and intimacy build, more explicit scenes and unique events become available. Task and Condo Management : Take on responsibilities as the condo’s trustee. Completing daily tasks, solving minor problems, and keeping the condo running smoothly aren’t just for appearances; they directly influence your relationships with the residents and unlock further opportunities to engage with them. Adult Content : Condo Desires offers a wide range of adult content, including intimate and explicit H-scenes, voyeuristic moments, and playful encounters. The scenes range from light-hearted and flirtatious to intense and passionate, all with fully developed, unique character interactions. Multiple Characters, Unique Stories : Interact with a diverse group of women, each with her own secrets and personality: Emily - A sweet and slightly naive waitress. Luna - A bold and outgoing streamer with a penchant for exhibitionism. Sophie - A nurturing yoga instructor who values mindfulness. Valerie - A strong-willed doctor who hides her softer side. Mia - A powerful CEO who is confident and in control. Customization : Earn in-game currency to buy outfits and accessories, such as maid outfits and school uniforms, for the residents. Use these outfits to explore different sides of each character and unlock unique dialogue and interactions. Exploration and Events : Spy on the residents through spy cameras, peek into private bathroom moments, or discover secrets while they sleep. The game offers a mix of light-hearted voyeurism and deeper, consensual experiences, providing a range of content that evolves as your relationships grow. Dive into Condo Desires and explore the seductive, mysterious lives of the condo’s residents. With a blend of story-driven experiences, erotic content, and engaging decision-making, Condo Desires offers players the chance to indulge in a game that doesn’t shy away from provocative themes. Every choice you make will shape your journey. Explore, engage, and enjoy every tantalizing moment.

As the new trustee, create relationships, uncover secrets, and trigger in intimate encounters. Will you master the art of seduction, or will you crave more? Your choices, your desires.

row.detailed_description: Darkness hides in the recesses of everyone's mind... A normal man finds himself trapped in an alternate reality enveloped in darkness and twisted, bloodthirsty creatures. Explore and uncover secrets about this aberrant world as you find your way back home. Features A unique take on old-school 3D RPGs, drawing elements from FPS and Parkour games. Find arcane abilities scattered throughout the world and channel the powers of chaos through your sword! Dash and slice through your foes, teleport around the battlefield, and harness the strength of lightning! 10 otherworldly bosses to discover and overcome! row.name: Shallow Blue（浅蓝计划）
row.detailed_description: Shallow Blue is a 2D pixel-style Metroidvania game, featuring multiple freely explorable environments and hidden storylines waiting to be uncovered by players. You will play as Tester No. 13, controlling a mech in the game, using platforming skills and combat abilities to defeat various enemies and clear levels. While immersing yourself in the mech action, don’t forget to ensure that No. 13 maintains a balanced diet and adequate sleep for optimal performance. Levels and Combat: Control your mech as you run and jump through industrial sci-fi-style environments, exploring scenes and uncovering the storyline. Defeat a wide variety of enemies and face the final boss in epic confrontations. Build Your Own Mecha: Purchase powerful equipment in the module shop and freely customize your mech. Combine modules to create a mech warrior that suits your playstyle, enhancing mobility, offensive power, and defensive capabilities to dominate the battlefield. Role-Playing: Players take on the role of Tester No. 13, living in a closed-off base filled with rooms and public spaces to explore freely. The base is rich with interactive environmental objects and NPCs, offering a deep and immersive experience as you uncover secrets and progress through the game. Game Features:: -Pixel Art -Realistic Time and Health System -Hidden Storylines and Easter Eggs It is known that some computers may experience screen flickering when playing the game. This issue involves overall performance optimization and cannot be resolved for the time being. We are very sorry if this situation causes players to have a bad experience.
row.short_description: You are No. 13, a new game tester joining the Shallow Blue project. Following orders from your superiors, complete the testing of this mech game. But don't forget to maintain a healthy life and take care of the essential tasks that must be done.

row.name: The Short Bread Game
row.detailed_description: Being a piece of bread, you naturally crave a stack of pancakes for breakfast. To start off your day and, more importantly, fill your stomach, you set off on a journey to get the best pancakes in town. However, you soon realize you have no clue where the bakery is. Thankfully, it seems like an intruder in your house may just know where you can find it... In this casual platformer, you explore environments ranging from your home to space. Though getting to your end goal doesn't seem hard at first, you soon find that the path there is a tad convoluted, with enemy desserts jumping around at every turn, trying to stop you. Not to mention, your new friend seems to enjoy messing around with you a bit.  If you're looking for a low-stress way to take a break, this may just be the game for you. :)
row.short_description: The Short Bread Game is a cozy platformer where you help a piece of bread get to the bakery for breakfast. row.name: Magic Sword
row.detailed_description: Magic Sword is a captivating CRPG that thrusts you into a richly detailed medieval world where strategy and skill are your greatest assets. Choose from one of 14 unique cities as the birthplace of your hero, and step into the role of a Swordsman, Wizard, Musketman, or Mage. Whether you prefer to wield physical might, arcane power, or the disciplined force of a trooper, your journey will be defined by the choices you make and the path you carve. Compete in a dynamic, synchronous turn-based strategy environment, where all players take their turns simultaneously, pushing the limits of your tactical thinking. You can play singe-player or up to 14 players- play within your household or port-forward to host the game to the world. Victory is achieved by mastering five key aptitudes: Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowship. But it doesn’t stop there—collect rare Magic Sword fragments, earn prestigious Titles, and outmaneuver your rivals to accumulate the most victory points before the game concludes. As you explore vast maps and engage in quests, you'll develop your character, forge alliances, and test different strategies. Will you dominate through sheer force, outsmart your opponents with knowledge, or rise through the ranks by gaining influence and wealth? The choice is yours in this intricate and competitive world. Key Features: 14 Diverse Cities : Each city offers unique benefits and challenges, influencing your character’s journey from the start. Four Playable Classes : Choose between the Swordsman, Wizard, Musketman, or Mage, each with distinct abilities and combat styles. Multiplayer Option : Experience the thrill of simultaneous turns in a strategic, turn-based environment, competing against others or refining your solo strategies. Five Aptitudes to Master : Gain victory points in Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowships to prove your superiority. Magic Sword Fragments : Discover and collect rare fragments to increase your power and tip the scales in your favor. Title System : Earn prestigious Titles to boost your victory points and showcase your achievements. Strategic Map Exploration : Navigate and explore diverse terrains, uncover secrets, and plan your moves with precision. Magic Sword offers endless possibilities and strategies, encouraging you to experiment and find your path to victory. Will you rise to become the ultimate champion? The choice is yours—dare to resurrect the Magic Sword.
row.short_description: Magic Sword is a medieval CRPG with synchronous turn-based strategy where you develop your character, explore the map, and compete for victory points in Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowships.

Increase the females depravity value to get different animations and facial expressions Raid locations Get potions, materials, and random females, just raid locations with your army, and in the meantime collect all the Unique Females available in the various raid spots.
row.short_description: MudBlood Prologue is an adult sandbox and management game set in a medieval fantasy world, where the player is in control of a goblin tribe that lives inside a cave. Perform raids on neighbouring roads, villages and cities, grow your army to expand your control over the territory.
row.notes: This game contains the following content not intended for all ages. Nudity, sexual content, hardcore sex. All characters in this game are 21 years of age or older.

row.name: Beyond the Marion
row.detailed_description: Take charge of the Polaris Mk 0 and repair your damaged ship, learn from your crewmates, and discover the true nature of what lies beyond existence… before you do it all over again. Follow the core tenants of the Sectorian Collective as you: Seek Knowledge Each loop in the game will offer you new insights into how to efficiently rectify the Polaris Mk 0’s many misfortunes whilst traveling through the Marion. Along the way, you’ll pick up tools that persist through your runs and aid you in your quest to save your crewmates. Solve Problems As you breach the Marion, your crew’s situation becomes more dangerous. It’s your job to fix mechanical failures and keep everyone alive! You’ll need to solve puzzling crises, assist your crewmates, and reach the bridge in time to save your ship. Always Put the Crew First Meet a colorful cast of aliens from all over the universe whom you get to call your crewmates. You’ll help each other as you make choices that will affect the success of the mission and your survival. Join us… Beyond the Marion!
row.short_description: A 3D First Person walking simulator and puzzle game. You will interact with your alien crewmates and repair your spaceship in order to escape a time loop. Explore space in a ship straight from the 70’s, and meet your companions - brought to life with a funky claymated style!

row.name: The Stairway
row.detailed_description: Built as a 3D platformer, The Stairway invites you to ascend through a floating world that feels both strange and familiar. Puzzling paths twist around impossible architecture; distant structures drift like memories on the horizon. Each surface is shaded as if by hand, blurring the line between dream and drawing. There are no enemies or dialogue. It's just you and yourself, and the climb which you endure. For you, The Stairway  could mean parkouring with precision through challenging and exciting obstacles. It could also mean something deeper. That's for you to find out. Atmosphere Unique graphics and atmosphere Shading resembling a colored pencil drawing, like the memories from childhood Story Indirect storytelling Meaning unfolds through the climb itself Large objects in the distance...a hidden meaning Gameplay Multiple checkpoints, quiet moments of rests. No need to stress :) Gameplay is easily paused at any point to be resumed later Choose whether you play casually or competitively through your own pace Speedrun for the fastest time
row.short_description: A 3D parkour game through the memories of a life. The goal is to reach the top, sometimes the way forward is not obvious.

row.name: Block Dude Deluxe
row.detailed_description: In Block Dude Deluxe, your mission is simple—reach the exit in each level. But to do that, you'll need to strategically stack and move blocks to create pathways, staircases, and bridges to navigate complex environments. Every level presents a unique puzzle that will challenge your problem-solving skills and test your ability to think ahead. Features: Challenging Puzzles: Each level is designed to push your strategic thinking with increasing difficulty as you progress. Block Manipulation Mechanics: Move, stack, and reposition blocks to solve intricate puzzles. Varied Environments: Explore different settings that add new twists and obstacles to your path. Simple Controls, Complex Challenges: Easy to pick up but difficult to master, Block Dude Deluxe is accessible to all players while offering deep puzzle gameplay for those who seek a challenge. Level Progression: Unlock new, more difficult levels as you master the mechanics and solve earlier puzzles. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun puzzle experience or a dedicated gamer seeking to master intricate levels, Block Dude Deluxe offers an engaging and rewarding challenge.
row.short_description: Your primary goal is to reach the exit door in each level. stack blocks strategically, creating pathways and staircases that allow you to traverse the environment. Each level presents a unique puzzle, requiring careful planning and precise execution

row.name: Impersonal
row.detailed_description: Impersonal is a game about light, relationships, and how those relationships can influence people. In the game, you control a ball of colored light navigating through a maze. Your goal is to explore how different lights and colors interact with one another, discovering multiple potential endings. The core of the game lies in understanding these interactions, making choices, and unraveling the maze of possibilities in this cyclical experience. This game was created in 2014, inspired by a talk from Jonathan Blow (the renowned game designer behind Braid and The Witness). In that talk, Blow discussed the concept of dynamical meaning in games, referencing The Marriage by Rod Humble as an example. In The Marriage, the game is filled with obscure interactions and symbols that only begin to make sense through exploration, it kind of have a narrative shaped by its mechanics. Though Rod states that he feels it is flawed from his own perspective because people don't seem to really get how the rules explains marriage. This approach to storytelling captivated me. Although I too recognize Impersonal has its flaws in narrative delivery (the same way rod said), I believe it still offers an intriguing and unconventional way to tell stories—one rooted in interactions. To me, this is how games should convey their stories: through the player's engagement with the world and its systems. At the end of the day It's a pretentious game, with minimal and experimental art. It's not a game made with the idea of ​​being a good game, in fact the attempt here was to focus on dynamical meaning. Where the game mechanics are responsible for telling a story and not the art or story embedded in the game itself. The game contains: 4 different endings an open map where you can explore some puzzles Thank you for playing.
row.short_description: Impersonal is a game about lights, about relationships and how these relationships can affect people.
